artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × height 75 cm x width 105 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met wuivend gras of koren, in de verte een bergketen.

artworks.title: River View by Moonlight
artworks.artist: Aert van der Neer (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 55.7 cm x width 102.6 cm
artworks.description: Van der Neer was a painter with two specialities: winter scenes and nocturnal moonlit landscapes. With a limited range of colours, Van der Neer here created the perfect illusion of a moonlit night. The chilly moonlight is reflected in the water, glances off the windowpanes of the houses at left, and lights up the white feathers of the ducks in the foreground.

artworks.title: Still Life with Apples in a Delft Blue Bowl
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 48.5 cm x width 79 cm × depth 8 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met appels op een Delfts blauwe of Chinese schaal op een wit laken op een tafel.

artworks.title: Stilleven
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: height 60 cm x width 82.5 cm × depth 5 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven. Op een tafel met een wit laken staan een tinnen schaal met een krab, een Chinees bordje, een halfgeschilde citroen, een roemer met witte wijn, een pasglas, een zilveren beker, een bord met noten en een bord met een broodje. Links vooraan een opgerold papier met peper.

artworks.title: Woman at a Mirror
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 34.5 cm x width 26 cm
artworks.description: A young boy holds up a mirror for the woman in the satin gown, who gazes upward at a far more plainly dressed woman. In the 17th century, mirrors symbolized vanity and the transience of life. This painting serves as a cautionary reminder: youth and beauty are fleeting. Ter Borch’s sister, Gesina, also an artist, probably modelled for both women, and his brother Moses for the boy.

artworks.title: Windmill beside a frozen river
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 47 cm x width 72.5 cm × depth 7.5 cm
artworks.description: IJsgezicht met molen. Winterlandschap met drie figuren rond een slede op het ijs, rechts een molen. In de verte bevinden zich op het ijs schaatsers.

artworks.title: The Temptation of St Anthony
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 61.8 cm x width 79.7 cm
artworks.description: Verzoeking van de heilige Antonius. Op de voorgrond de biddende kluizenaar. Rechts een herberg met een dak in de vorm van de kop van een oude vrouw, voor de deur staat een verleidelijke jonge naakte vrouw. Op de achtergrond links een brandende klooster, door de lucht vliegen allerlei monsters.

artworks.title: Cows in a Meadow near a Farm
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 58 cm x width 66.5 cm × depth 10.5 cm
artworks.description:
Paulus Potter favoured painting animals in the countryside and at farms. He rendered the typical Dutch
landscape – the pollard willows, the meadow, and the pond in the background –with great precision. In this painting the sun hangs low, calling to mind the late afternoon, when the languid cows and sheep take their rest.

artworks.title: The Battle of Livorno (Leghorn)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, biological material, materials by function, panel, ink
artworks.dimensions: height 114 cm x width 160 cm
artworks.description: In 1653 the English ship the Samson went up in flames off the coast of Italy after an encounter with Cornelis Tromp’s warship the Halve Maan. Van de Velde represented both vessels at the centre of this pen painting. Tromp commissioned the picture to honour and glorify himself. The work is still in its original frame with the Tromp family coat of arms.

artworks.title: The Hunter’s Present
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 51 cm x width 48 cm
artworks.description:
This woman, engaged in handiwork, ponders a romantic proposition. She looks thoughtfully at the bird presented to her by a hopeful hunter. In the 17th century, ‘birding’ was a euphemism for making love. Hence, the statuette of Cupid, the god of love,
graces the cupboard. Caught between faith and pleasure, she hesitates – her eyes on the fowl, yet reaches for the prayer book on the table.

artworks.title: Javanese Court Officials
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), textile materials, inorganic material, cotton (textile), paper, oil paint (paint), gilding (material)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.5 × height 196.8 cm x width 74.3 cm
artworks.description: These five figures are representatives of the Javanese elite. The accurately depicted clothing and batik motifs signal where they come from and what their rank and status are. Knowledge of their etiquette and appearance was of great political importance to the colonial administration. The Javanese elite was increasingly deployed to control and exploit the colony in the first half of the 19th century.

artworks.title: View of Istanbul from the Dutch Embassy at Pera
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 142 cm x width 214 cm
artworks.description: The Palais d’Hollande, the Dutch embassy in Istanbul, has always been located on a hill in the diplomatic district of Pera (now Beyoğlu). Vanmour painted the view from the dining room, with the Asiatic section of Istanbul at left and the European area, with the Topkapı Sarayı (sultan’s palace), on a hill at right. The inlet in the fore-ground is the Golden Horn, with the Ottoman fleet. At left is the Bosporus.

artworks.title: The Seven Works of Mercy
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 103.5 cm x width 55 cm
artworks.description: A Dutch city is the backdrop to this narrative that shows how a good Christian should help those in need. Christ stands among the spectators in almost every panel. The scenes give an impression of urban society around 1500. The work was badly damaged during the Iconoclasm of 1566, when Roman Catholic churches were vandalized by Protestants.

artworks.title: The Cascades at Tivoli, with a Storm Approaching
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 101.5 cm x width 143 cm
artworks.description: The cascades (cascatelle in Italian) at Tivoli were already a tourist attraction in Teerlink’s time. The artist incorporated this contemporary activity in a view of the famous waterfalls. Beneath a menacing, stormy sky, a company of travellers ascends the hill opposite the falls. The man on the white horse is a painter, whose portfolio of sketches is carried by the guide at the front of the group.

artworks.title: Portrait of Willem III, Prince of Orange, King of England and Stadtholder
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 76.5 cm x width 65 cm
artworks.description: This striking painting is a portrait of a ruler lit only by the flame of a candle. The candle has a symbolic meaning. It serves others with its light, while burning itself out. In other words, self-denial is a noble virtue. William wears a suit of armour with an ermine cloak around his neck as a sign of royalty.

artworks.title: Dienstmeisjes op de Leidsegracht
artworks.medium: paper, paint (coating), pasteboard, cardboard, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 41 cm x width 56 cm
artworks.description: Twee Amsterdamse dienstmeisjes, met schort en tulen muts, staan op de Leidsegracht met elkaar te praten. Van rechts naar links de nummers 10-14.

artworks.title: The Serenade
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 47 cm x width 34.5 cm
artworks.description: Judith Leyster was the first woman to become a master painter in the Netherlands in the 17th century. She received this title in 1633 after being admitted to the Haarlem Guild of St Luke. This high status allowed Leyster to open her own studio in Haarlem and take on pupils. Her talent is on display in the effects of light and dark and her use of colour in this painting of a singing lute player. The bright red of his breeches forms a fine contrast with the greenish background.

artworks.title: Vanitas Still Life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.5 cm × height 47 cm x width 40.5 cm
artworks.description: Vanitas stilleven met een schedel, een lantaarn met kaars, een zandloper en een geopend boek op een houten tafel. In het boek tekst en verzen met de titel Pael-Steen.

artworks.title: Gezicht op de Gouden Bocht in de Herengracht vanuit het oosten
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 53 cm x width 62 cm
artworks.description: De bocht van de Herengracht te Amsterdam. Gezien vanaf de kant van de Vijzelstraat.

artworks.title: Girl Knitting in the Dunes
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 30 cm x width 20.7 cm
artworks.description: Breiend meisje zittend op een duin. In de verte de zee.

artworks.title: In the Bois de Boulogne near Paris
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 33 cm x width 46 cm
artworks.description: Israels knew Paris well and lived there for many years. This family picnic in the Bois de Boulogne, probably on a Sunday or public holiday, is typical of Israels’ subject matter. He was not inclined to gloominess and in Paris painted primarily urban pastimes, in particular those of women: parks, fashion houses, restaurants and cafés.

artworks.title: Meadow with Cows by the Water
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 32 kg × depth 13.5 cm × height 87 cm x width 108 cm
artworks.description: A vast polder, cows in the meadow and – in the background – a windmill: these have been the hallmarks of the Dutch countryside since the 17th century. Such landscapes with cows near a ditch were Willem Maris’ speciality. He especially lavished attention on the atmosphere; and, indeed, the warmth of a summer day is almost palpable in this painting.

artworks.title: Paul healing a man who could not walk
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 179 cm x width 139 cm x depth 9 cm × height 204 cm x width 165 cm x thickness 8 cm
artworks.description: Du Jardin not only painted landscapes with Italian flair, but also large history paintings inspired by Italian examples. Here, the Apostle Paul towers above a group of sick people. When he heals the feet of a man in the name of the Christian god in Lystra, a city in contemporary Turkey, the onlookers take him to be the heathen god Mercury. Du Jardin understood the art of using figural gestures to enhance the pathos and drama of a scene.

artworks.title: Portrait of Johanna le Maire (c. 1601-60)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 105.2 cm x width 77.7 cm × outer size: depth 8.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Nicolaes Eliasz, named Pickenoy (1588 - 1650/56). Johanna Le Maire, wife of Pieter van Son, 1622. Purchase made possible by the SponsorBingo Lottery.

artworks.title: Paard
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 25.5 cm x width 33 cm × depth 11.6 cm
artworks.description: Een oud paard, staand in een wei bij een hek.

artworks.title: The Temptation of St Anthony
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 68.7 cm x width 86.9 cm × frame: height 89 cm x width 107.5 cm x thickness 5 cm
artworks.description: Verzoeking van de heilige Antonius. De knielend biddende kluizenaar wordt bezocht door een verleidelijke vrouw en allerlei gedrochten. Op de achtergrond een brandende stad. Middendeel van een drieluik.

artworks.title: The Nave and Choir of the Mariakerk in Utrecht
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 121.5 cm x width 95 cm × outer size: depth 7.3 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description:
In the young Dutch Republic only Reformed Protestant services were still held in the former Catholic churches. Statues and paintings of saints were prohibited. The 11th-century Mariakerk preserved the decorations of the piers, which Saenredam here rendered in great detail – even applying gold leaf. At the left visitors look at an image of a bull on one of the piers: according to legend, this column continued to sink during
construction until it was grounded on a bull’s hide.

artworks.title: Whaling Grounds in the Arctic Ocean
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 61.5 cm x width 77 cm × depth 6 cm × height 50.5 cm x width 66.5 cm
artworks.description: Three Dutch whalers navigate the Arctic Ocean amid walruses and ice floes. The crewmen are hunting whales, while simultaneously trying to fight off polar bears. The demand for train oil (oil from the blubber of whales, walruses and seals) had increased greatly in Europe because it proved to be a good alternative to vegetable oils, from which candles, lubricants, lamp oil and soap were made.

artworks.title: Still Life with Books, Sheet Music, Violin, Celestial Globe and an Owl
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), wood board, biological material, panel, particle board, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 105 cm x width 89 cm × height 102 cm x width 85.3 cm
artworks.description: Deel van negendelige kamerbeschildering voor het huis Beekhoven, later het Hoogerhuis genoemd, bij Randenbroek bij Amersfoort, het buitenhuis van Jacob van Campen.

artworks.title: The Marriage at Cana
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 66.5 cm x width 85 cm
artworks.description: In this night scene – a novelty in painting at the time – Vermeyen succeeded in creating a dramatic effect. Candlelight plays over the faces and casts dark shadows. For the flames, Vermeyen used gold leaf. He was well ahead of his time: only around 1600 did the nocturn as a genre become more widely known through the Italian artist Caravaggio.

artworks.title: Blossoming Tree in an Orchard
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.4 cm × height 18.5 cm x width 23.5 cm
artworks.description: Bloeiende fruitbomen in een boomgaard, grenzende aan een schuur of boerderij.

artworks.title: Portrait of Duijfje van Gerwen (1618-1658)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 81.5 cm x width 68 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Duifje van Gerwen (1618-1658), jongste dochter van een rijke Amsterdamse wijnhandelaar aan de Warmoesstraat, echtgenote van Jan van de Poll. Borstbeeld naar links, met een grote plooikraag. Pendant van SK-A-1246.

artworks.title: The Man-of-War Brielle on the River Maas off Rotterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 130 cm x width 197 cm × depth 12.5 cm
artworks.description: In 1688 this ship carried Prince William III to England to drive the Catholic King James II from power and to safeguard the Protestant faith. The Latin inscription on the red flag translates as ‘for faith and freedom’. Bakhuysen painted this picture in 1689, the year in which William III and Mary Stuart were crowned king and queen regnant of England.

artworks.title: River View near Deventer
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 107.5 cm x width 148.7 cm x thickness 5.4 cm (support incl. backboard) × outersize: depth 8.9 cm (support incl. SK-L-6173)
artworks.description: Riviergezicht bij Deventer. Op het water van de IJssel varen enkele roeiboten en zeilscheepjes. Rechts zijn enkele huizen en een kerk zichtbaar tussen bomen, in de verte het profiel van de stad Deventer.

artworks.title: Portrait of Anne of Austria (1601-1666), Queen of France
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 13 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 104.8 cm x width 73.7 cm
artworks.description: School of Peter Paul Rubens (1577 - 1640). Portrait of Anne of Austria, c. 1622. Every detail of this portrait of Anne of Austria radiates power and importance. The woman is wearing a richly decorated gown embroidered in gold. She is laden with jewels and is seated in front of a red drapery, with a Corinthian column in the background. Anne (1601 - 1666) was the daughter of the Spanish king Philip III. At the age of 14 she married the son of the French king. Their son, who was born in 1638, became the 'Sun King', Louis XIV. The Rubens atelier did several different versions of this portrait. Bequest of A. van der Hoop, 1854. On loan from the city of Amsterdam, 1885.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 110.5 cm x width 88 cm
artworks.description: Nicolaes van Gelder (1625/35 - 1675/77). Still life.

artworks.title: Wilgebomen
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8 cm × height 30.1 cm x width 34.2 cm x thickness 1 cm
artworks.description: Studie van wilgebomen bij een sloot aan de rand van een weiland. In de verte vee, op de voorgrond een weg.

artworks.title: A Couple
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 86.6 cm x width 66.2 cm × frame: height 101 cm x width 83 cm x thickness 5.5 cm
artworks.description: The woman is depicted as an industrious, virtuous housewife. The basket on the wall holds the yarn she has already spun. It has recently been suggested that the sitters are the Amsterdam draper Hubert Pietersz and his wife Trijn Jacobsdr, partly because the ledger on his table reads: ‘Betaelt Hubrecht [= Hubert] boucs.’ It is not clear why she occupies the side usually reserved for men. This important position was traditionally associated with purity and power.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Woman Holding a Flower
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 7.5 cm (support incl. SK-L-1988) × support: height 87 cm x width 71.5 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een jonge vrouw, ten halven lijve met een bloem in de linkerhand.

artworks.title: Vanitas Still Life
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 53.5 cm x width 41.4 cm × outer size: depth 7 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: A document with the Dutch lion featuring prominently in the attached seal, a songbook, a flute, dice, a globe, an oil lamp, bubbles, and a skull: much in this still life reminds us of the frailty and transience of life. With the inclusion of the red seal, moreover, this painting seems to be a warning to treat the Republic’s existence with care: after all, nothing is certain!

artworks.title: Abraham Entertaining the Three Angels
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 404 cm x width 282.5 cm
artworks.description: Abraham ontvangt de drie engelen. Rechts een tafel waaraan twee engelen gezeten zijn. Links knielt Abraham met een vergulde schenkkan in de hand. Achter luistert Sara in de deuropening naar de voorspelling. Onderdeel van een groep van vijf werken vervaardigd voor het huis aan de Nieuwegracht 6 te Utrecht.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fish, Sea Food and Flowers
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 25 cm x width 34.8 cm × outer size: depth 4.5 cm (support incl. frame and climate box)
artworks.description: The gleaming carp, the slippery eel, and the shiny glaze of the earthenware bowl: they seem almost tangible. With her still lifes, Peeters seamlessly tapped into the era’s fascination with plants, flowers, and ‘art cabinets’ in which wealthy collectors gathered special objects. In this instance, she combines fish, shells, and oysters from all over the world.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8 cm × height 127 cm x width 104 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een vrouw. Kniestuk, staande met een roos in de rechterhand. Op de achtergrond een tuin. Pendant van SK-C-24.

artworks.title: The Town Hall on Dam Square, Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 53 cm x width 63.5 cm
artworks.description: The Amsterdam Town Hall (now the Royal Palace) on Dam Square counts as the most important historical and cultural monument of the Dutch Golden Age. The building symbolizes the tremendous growth and development that the city experienced during the 17th century. Gerrit Berckheyde here portrayed the Town Hall in all its glory, while simultaneously conveying the hustle and bustle of the city’s main square.

artworks.title: Peasants in an Interior
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 36.5 cm x width 46.5 cm
artworks.description: Three men and a woman discuss daily matters, and a child eats soup or porridge while a dog looks on. Peasant life does not seem at all bad. In Van Ostade’s early works, peasants regularly tumble over one another brawling, but in his later paintings, like this one, they are usually calmer and much more collected.

artworks.title: Still Life with Flowers and Fruit
artworks.artist: Gerardina Jacoba van de Sande Bakhuyzen
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10 cm × height 68.5 cm x width 93 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met bloemen en vruchten. In een tuin onder de takken van een struik liggen op een tafel pompoenen, druiven en wat ander fruit samen met stokrozen en andere bloemen.

artworks.title: Distant View with Cottages along a Road
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 13 cm × height 134 cm x width 167.5 cm
artworks.description: A few dunes provide the only relief in this otherwise sweeping landscape stretching out under a vast sky. Koninck specialized in flat landscapes, which he built up with countless dots, like the knots in a tapestry. His palette and loose painting style reveal the influence of Rembrandt. The three cottages at the left are based on an etching by Rembrandt from 1650.

artworks.title: Vanitas Still Life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 5.2 kg × depth 7 cm × height 45 cm x width 52 cm
artworks.description: Vanitas stilleven. Op de hoek van een tafel staan een viool, schedel, Goudse pijp, boeken, zandloper, kaars in kandelaar, kistje en twee flessen.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.7 cm × height 48.7 cm x width 57.6 cm x thickness 3.5 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven. Op een tafel met een rood kleed liggen enige boeken, een omgevallen Chinese vaas, een glazen kruik met openstaande deksel en een blauw porseleinen bord met een mes, een appel, een kannetje en een glas.

artworks.title: Still Life with Flowers and Fruits
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10 cm × height 70.6 cm x width 54.6 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven van vruchten en enkele bloemen. Centraal enkele trossen druiven met daaromheen een halve meloen, perziken, pruimen, bramen, aalbessen en een stokroos.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit and a Beaker on a Cock's Foot
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 77 cm x width 62 cm × depth 6.7 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met vruchten en een bokaal op hanenpoot. Op een Wan Li-schaal liggen druiven, granaatappels, perziken en maïs. Links een geschilde citroen en een roemer met wijn. Op de achtergrond een gouden bokaal op een hanenpoot, druiven en een kalebas op een houten doos. Tussen het fruit slakken en vlinders, links bij het raam een kever.

artworks.title: The Willow
artworks.medium: paper, paint (coating), pasteboard, cardboard, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 3 kg × height 26 cm x width 22 cm × depth 8 cm
artworks.description: Schuinstaande knotwilg aan de slootrand van een weide.

artworks.title: The Butterflies
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5 cm × height 35 cm x width 50 cm
artworks.description: Voorstelling getiteld 'De Vlinders'. Twee kinderen liggen in het gras en kijken naar vlinders. Linksachter een kip met kuikens.

artworks.title: Still Life with Roemer, Salt Cellar, Tobacco, Lemon, and Olives
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 70.5 cm x width 91 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: This painting showcases the wealth of products brought to the Netherlands by various trading companies. Tobacco and salt were obtained by the Dutch West India Company (WIC). Tobacco came mainly from South America, while salt was initially imported from Spain and Portugal until the Eighty Years’ War and thereafter from Cape Verde and Brazil. Trade, often accompanied by colonial aggression, was the primary driver of Dutch prosperity during this time.

artworks.title: Two Donkeys
artworks.medium: paper, paint (coating), pasteboard, cardboard, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.4 cm × height 46 cm x width 61 cm
artworks.description: Scheveningen’s donkeys were not just entertainment for seaside visitors; Israels made grateful use of them in his paintings. He portrayed them a few times, either with children riding or a boy leading, or as here, waiting for the next ride. Their keeper lies in the foreground, on the sand. Unlike the more colourful version, left, here the cool hues of the sea and beach predominate.

artworks.title: Helena van der Schalcke
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 34 cm x width 28.5 cm × height 59 cm x width 52 cm x thickness 6.5 cm
artworks.description: Helena van der Schalck, a merchant's daughter was no more than three years old when she was portrayed here. Her silk dress adorned with bows and her straw purse resemble adult attire. However, just visible on her back is a bit of her walking reins, used to keep children safe. The red carnation in her hand symbolizes hope for eternal life. Sadly, Helena died at the age of 24.

artworks.title: Allegory on the Abdication of Emperor Charles v in Brussels
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: support: height 132.6 cm x height 132.8 cm x width 170.7 cm
artworks.description: Charles V is enthroned at centre. Battle weary and wracked by illness, in 1555 he divided up his empire. He gave his brother Ferdinand (left of the throne) the Holy Roman Empire, while his son Phillip (at the right) became King of Spain and Lord of the Netherlands. The three figures in the right foreground personify the continents America, Africa and Asia over which Charles’s vast empire also stretched. Neptune (left) symbolizes his power at sea.

artworks.title: Lane of Oaks in Late Summer
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 54 cm x width 76 cm × depth 11.7 cm
artworks.description: Marie Bilders-van Bosse likely painted this picture in the vicinity of Oosterbeek, where she moved after her marriage. She was a member of the Hague School, a group of painters who focussed on capturing the atmosphere and light of nature. In this painting, three full-grown trees dominate the composition. It is only upon closer inspection that one notices the countrylane and the figure of a woman.

artworks.title: Landscape in the Environs of The Hague
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 48 cm x width 75 cm
artworks.description: Together with Jozef Israëls, Roelofs is considered the doyen of the Hague School, even though he lived in Brussels. During the summer he made oil sketches in the environs of The Hague, which he worked up into paintings during the winter in his Brussels studio. Depicted here is the road from The Hague to the village of Stompwijk. The swing bridge across the canal is open to prevent the cattle from escaping.

artworks.title: Landscape with two Trees
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.8 cm × height 13.2 cm x width 18.5 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met een vrouw bij twee bomen op een pad langs het water.

artworks.title: Ships at Anchor on the Coast
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 56.5 cm x width 64 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: Schepen onder de kust voor anker, met op de voorgrond een admiraliteitsschip met op de witte baan van de Nederlandse vlag op het achterschip de initialen  ('W.v.V.') van de schilder. Daarachter een fluitschip. Links en rechts kleine vrachtschepen, een spiegeljacht en roeiboten.

artworks.title: Portrait of Ephraim Bueno
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), hardwood, biological material, oak (wood), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 19 cm x width 15 cm
artworks.description: Ephraim Bueno (1599–1665), a Jewish physician, poet and translator from Portugal, probably belonged to Rembrandt’s circle of friends. Rembrandt painted his portrait as a preparatory study for a print. He concentrated on the face and the division of light and dark; the rest was less important for the purposes of this sketch. This explains the fairly coarse brushstrokes for the clothing and hands.

artworks.title: Portrait of Catherine Behaghel
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 152 cm x width 118 cm
artworks.description:
Catharina Behaghel was a member of Antwerp’s wealthy bourgeoisie. Her clothes and accessories, such as the fan, reflect her status. She was probably pregnant when she and her husband were portrayed by Jordaens. Their frontal depiction was unusual for
companion portraits of the time. Interestingly, the herm figure in the golden pillar next to Catharina is female, while the one next to her husband is male.

artworks.title: Enjoying the Ice
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 38.5 cm x width 51 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: IJsvermaak buiten de wallen van een stad. Vooraan enkele mannen met kolfstokken. In het midden een arrenslede en schaatsers.

artworks.title: Beach Scene
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.1 cm × height 17.9 cm x width 24.8 cm x thickness 1.4 cm
artworks.description: Strandgezicht met enkele kleine vissersscheepjes op het water, een visser loopt over het strand.

artworks.title: Rembrandt as a Shepherd with a Staff and Flute
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 11.2 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 75.1 cm x width 64.4 cm x thickness 4.1 cm (incl. backboard)
artworks.description: Depictions of shepherds and shepherdesses were popular in the 17th century. They show an idyllic world, one full of simple pleasures. Busy city dwellers could dream away while looking at such paintings. Govert Flinck here portrayed his teacher Rembrandt in the guise of a shepherd. The companion to this picture, of Rembrandt’s wife Saskia as a shepherdess, is in the museum in Braunschweig.

artworks.title: Hungry Wolves Attacking a Party of Riders
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 256 cm x width 363 cm
artworks.description: Hongerige wolven overvallen een groep ruiters. Op de voorgrond doden wolven een op de grond liggend paard.

artworks.title: Rotterdam in the Moonlight
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.5 cm × height 34 cm x width 46 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op een gracht te Rotterdam bij avond, boven breekt de maan door de wolken. Aan de wal liggen verschillende grote en kleinere zeilschepen en bootjes. In de verte een kerktoren.

artworks.title: Wreath of Flowers encircling a Niche
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 128 cm x width 113 cm x depth 10 cm × height 119 cm x width 104 cm x thickness 3.8 cm
artworks.description: Bloemenkrans rond een nis waarin een glas of bokaal staat. Tussen de bloemen en het klimop ook enkele vlinders.

artworks.title: The Battle of Dunkirk
artworks.medium: textile materials, materials by function, canvas, ink
artworks.dimensions: height 123 cm x width 185 cm
artworks.description: In 1639 Maerten Harpertsz Tromp prevented the Spanish fleet from leaving the harbour at Dunkirk with a blockade of twelve ships. Van de Velde has depicted most of the Dutch vessels with their prows pointing towards the enemy armada. With a remarkable eye for detail, he rendered in pen the ships’ counters or transoms – the stern carvings from which the individual vessels can be identified.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 100 cm x width 142 cm × depth 7.5 cm
artworks.description: Het laatste avondmaal. Christus met zijn discipelen gezeten rond een tafel in een vertrek verlicht met kaarsen.

artworks.title: The Frederiksplein, Amsterdam, during the Entry of Queen Wilhelmina, 5 September 1898
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 139 cm x width 195 cm × weight 80 kg × depth 19.5 cm
artworks.description: The Royal Procession in Amsterdam, 5 September 1898, by O. Eerelman, before 1900. On 5 September 1898 Queen Wilhelmina (1880 - 1962) arrived with her mother Queen-Regent Emma (1858 - 1934) by train at Amsterdam's Weesperpoort station. The next day Emma was to abdicate the regency and her eighteen-year-old daughter was to be invested as queen in the New Church. Otto Eerelman (1839 - 1926) painted the procession towards the Palace on Dam Square as it passed Frederiksplein. In the background is the Palace of National Industry (Paleis voor Volksvlijt). The artist probably painted the picture without a commission. In 1900 a group of art enthusiasts donated the work to the Rijksmuseum.

artworks.title: Portrait of Marie de Médicis (1575-1642), Queen of France, in Robes of State
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 9 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 282 cm x width 215 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Maria de' Medici (1573-1642), echtgenote van Hendrik IV, koning van Frankrijk. Staande, ten voeten uit onder een baldakijn, in een gewaad versierd met Franse lelies en afgezet met hermelijn. Herhaling van het origineel in het Louvre.

artworks.title: The Night School
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 53.8 cm x height 74 cm x width 42 cm × width 64 cm x thickness 5.5 cm
artworks.description:
Light and dark, virtue and vice are juxtaposed here. Bathed in bright candlelight, a girl earnestly recites her lesson, while in the shadows the schoolmaster admonishes a boy. In the foreground, a second pupil, candle in hand, helps another with his schoolwork.
The candlelight here symbolizes reason.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Woman, Possibly Susanna Reael
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 99 cm x width 82 cm
artworks.description: The woman portrayed may be Susanna Reael at the age of 18, who later married Hiob de Wildt. She died when she was only 25, shortly after giving birth to their son David. The portrait was owned by the De Wildt family for centuries. Therefore, it still has the original frame, decorated with auricular shapes and flowers.

artworks.title: The Gein River, near Abcoude
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 45 cm x width 68 cm × depth 9.5 cm
artworks.description: Rivierlandschap met 't Gein bij Abcoude. Twee hengelaars vissen in een boot tussen de waterlelies. Op de voorgrond een molen bij een huis, in de verte weilanden.

artworks.title: Winter Scene on the Ice with Wood Gatherers
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.5 cm × height 18.3 cm x width 26.3 cm x thickness 0.5 cm
artworks.description: Winterlandschap met twee houtsprokkelaars met een slede met takken bij een in het ijs gevroren roeiboot. Links in de verte rijden schaatsers.

artworks.title: Witte eend met kiekens
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 55.5 cm x width 89.5 cm × depth 12.2 cm
artworks.description: Een witte eend met zeven kuikens bij de slootkant.

artworks.title: Javanese Court Officials
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), textile materials, inorganic material, cotton (textile), paper, oil paint (paint), gilding (material)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.5 cm × height 196.8 cm x width 74.3 cm
artworks.description: These five figures are representatives of the Javanese elite. The accurately depicted clothing and batik motifs signal where they come from and what their rank and status are. Knowledge of their etiquette and appearance was of great political importance to the colonial administration. The Javanese elite was increasingly deployed to control and exploit the colony in the first half of the 19th century.

artworks.title: Sunday Morning
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.5 cm × height 55 cm x width 66.5 cm
artworks.description: Zondagmorgen. In een zeventiende-eeuwse interieur leest een jonge vrouw voor uit een bijbel voor een oude vrouw die links voor de haard in een stoel zit. Op de schouw een fries met putti. Aan de muur een schilderij met mansportret.

artworks.title: Girl with an Oil Lamp at a Window
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 3.5 cm × height 18.8 cm x height 18.5 cm x width 17.2 cm x width 17.1 cm x thickness 0.7 cm
artworks.description: Meisje met brandende olielamp, uit een venster geleund.

artworks.title: Missing Title
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × height 64.5 cm x width 59 cm
artworks.description: The porcelain dish is surrounded by other objects that bear witness to Dutch taste in the 17th century. It holds pepper, an expensive product that not everyone could afford. A hallmark in the form of the arms of Amsterdam is stamped on the lid of the jug, alluding to the city’s key role as a centre of trade.

artworks.title: The Kitchen
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.8 cm × height 62.5 cm x width 53 cm
artworks.description: Interieur van een keuken, in het midden zit een jonge vrouw bij een mand een patrijs te plukken. Rechts komt een keukenmeid aangelopen met een dienblad met vissen. Links zit een kind in een stoel met een hondje te spelen. Rechtsvoor een koperen ketel met verschillende soorten groente en een gebroken kruik. Rechtsachter een haard waarboven een schilderij hangt. Tegen de achterwand een plank met borden en kruiken. Links bij het geopende venster een koperen melkbus en ander huisraad. Aan het plafond hangt een wildkroon met patrijs.

artworks.title: Battle between Dutch and Spanish Ships on the Haarlemmermeer
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 190 cm x width 268 cm
artworks.description: When Haarlem sided with the Dutch Revolt in 1572, the Spanish lay siege to the city. In May 1573, the rebels attempted to recapture the Haarlemmermeer, which was a major supply channel to the city. They were defeated by a fleet of Spanish and Amsterdam ships (Amsterdam was then still loyal to Spain). Haarlem was ultimately forced to surrender to the Spanish.

artworks.title: River Landscape
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 92.5 cm x width 112 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht in vogelvlucht over een uitgestrekt, enigszins heuvelachtig rivierlandschap. Op de voorgrond reizigers op een weg die naar een rivier leidt, op het water een pleziervaartuig.

artworks.title: Kitchen Scene
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 100 cm x width 122 cm
artworks.description: The appreciation of everyday objects was reinforced by the ever-increasing role that realism began to play in 17th-century art. Glass, porcelain, silver, the texture of fruit, dead animals, hanging or lying on a table: all of these elements were readily found in domestic surroundings and represented a veritable challenge by means of which painters could convince the public of their artistic merits.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit and a Goldfinch
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 78 cm x width 67 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met vruchten en een puttertje. Links vooraan een bord met een citroen naast een roemer met witte wijn. In het midden een grote mand met trossen witte en blauwe druiven, kastanjes, bessen, maïs en perziken. Op de achtergrond een kreeft, een sierbokaal en een hoge glas. Links bij het venster haalt een puttertje een bakje met water op. Tussen de vruchten door wijnranken met hier en daar vlinders.

artworks.title: Iconoclasm in a Church
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), hardwood, biological material, oak (wood), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 50 cm x width 67 cm
artworks.description: A man on a ladder has placed a noose around the neck of a statue of a saint, while below three men stand ready to topple it from its socle. At the right a statue has been brutally hacked in half. In August 1566 fanatic Protestants destroyed altarpieces, statues and sacred vessels used for the Catholic Mass in countless churches throughout the Netherlands. It was a black day in Dutch history, and one rarely depicted in art.

artworks.title: A Hen with Peacocks and a Turkey
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 11.5 cm × height 134 cm x width 174.5 cm
artworks.description: Hondecoeter enlivened his bird paintings with little vignettes. Here the focus is on the hen taking care for her chicks, surrounded by large and intimidating birds.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Boar Hunt
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 121 cm x width 196.5 cm × depth 9 cm × weight 0 kg
artworks.description: Joos de Momper (1564 - 1635). River landscape with wild boar hunt, c. 1600. In this work the artist has created an impressive landscape. As was common at the time, the artist has added human figures: several men who are in the process of subduing a wild boar. The landscapes dating from this period were usually imaginary, although the artist always included a number of elements which actually existed. By around 1600 this type of landscape had evolved into a separate genre. De Momper even had someone else - Sebastiaan Vrancx - painting the figures. Joos de Momper composed his painting according to a fixed colourscheme: the foreground in brown, with the middleground in green fading into blue and becoming steadily lighter, creating the effect of depth. This illusion of depth is enhanced by the fact that various parts of the composition function as 'wings', almost as if the landscape is a stage. Purchased in 1958, with the support of the Jubileum-Fonds.

artworks.title: Portrait of an African Man (Christophle le More?)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), hardwood, biological material, oak (wood), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: painted surface: height 30 cm x width 20.3 cm × support: height 30.8 cm x width 21.2 cm
artworks.description: This is the only known portrait of a black man in early European painting. He may have served at the Brussels court of Emperor Charles V, who had a black archer called Christophle le More among his bodyguards. The badge of the Virgin on his cap is a souvenir of a pilgrimage to Halle (Brabant), a favourite destination of pilgrims from the Brussels court.

artworks.title: Jar with Cotton Grass
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 44 cm x width 37 cm × depth 6.9 cm
artworks.description: Witsen convincingly rendered the brilliant light reflection on the shiny earthenware jug with only a few touches of white paint, while the  woolly grass and fern leaves appear soft and cuddly. Witsen began painting still lifes, like this one, when his cityscapes and landscapes found fewer buyers after the outbreak of World War i.

artworks.title: Princes Maurice and Frederick Henry at the Valkenburg Horse Fair
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 54.2 cm x width 133.5 cm
artworks.description: Van de Venne uses the arrival of Prince Maurice and his younger brother Frederick Henry – in a carriage drawn by six grey horses – to underscore the contrast between the elegant conduct of Hague courtiers and the boorish manners of the peasants. The artist captures the atmosphere of the fair with vignettes of a singer and a woman selling fruit and vegetables whose purse is being picked.

artworks.title: Self-portrait
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 95 cm x width 85.5 cm x thickness 9 cm × height 73 cm x width 62 cm
artworks.description: A distinguished citizen dressed in decorous black is seated before a red curtain and tassel. Jan Steen, known primarily for his humorous scenes with simple folk, portrayed himself here as utterly self-assured. He also regularly included himself in other paintings, but then usually in a comic role.

artworks.title: Women’s Skating Competition on Stadsgracht, Leeuwarden, 21 January 1809
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 59.7 cm x width 74.9 cm
artworks.description: Thousands of people have flocked to see the final of a women’s skating competition. Houkje Gerrits Bouma crosses the finish line first. Elated, she throws up her arms in triumph. A boy has even climbed a tree to follow the event. During the winter season, everyone went out on the ice, and women commonly participated in speed skating as well.

artworks.title: Girl Resting
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.5 cm × height 65.5 cm x width 53 cm
artworks.description: Studie van jonge vrouw, glimlachend voorovergeleund met de armen op een stenen balustrade. Rechts een bundel met een fles wijn, in een doek geknoopt.

artworks.title: The Lutenist
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 51.5 cm x width 38.5 cm × thickness 6 cm
artworks.description: A young man is singing and playing the lute on an open veranda. Where the woman’s thoughts have wandered is a mystery. The music and the theme of the paramours Pyramus and Thisbe in the painting in the background suggest that harmonious love is the subject. Yet the work may also be a warning against impulsive lust. Both interpretations are equally valid.

artworks.title: The Explosion of Gunboat nr 2, under Command of Jan van Speyk, off Antwerp, 5 February 1831
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 53 cm x width 76 cm
artworks.description: The explosion of Dutch Gunboat No. 2 under command of Jan van Speyk on the Scheldt at Antwerp, 5 February 1831, by M. Schouman, 1832. To avoid falling in Belgian hands Van Speyk blew up his own ship. In Holland this created a sensation. There was a massive demand for pictures. Many different artists portrayed the event. Rather than show the dramatic moment when Van Speyk set the powder alight, Schouman portrayed the fatal result.

artworks.title: Scenes from the life of Christ
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 33.2 kg × support: height 110.1 cm x width 173.3 cm x height 33 cm x width 27.5 cm
artworks.description: Unfolding before us like a cartoon strip are eighteen scenes from the life of Christ. The painting thus becomes a visual résumé of Christian redemption: the salvation of mankind through the death and resurrection of God’s son. It begins at top left with the Annunciation and the Nativity and finishes at bottom right with the Crucifixion and the Resurrection.

artworks.title: Boy and Girl on Donkeys
artworks.medium: paper, paint (coating), pasteboard, cardboard, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: thickness 7 cm × height 46 cm x width 54 cm
artworks.description: Een jongen en een meisje maken op het strand een ritje op ezeltjes. Rechts een staande jongen die de ezels leidt.

artworks.title: Cows in a Soggy Meadow
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 25 kg × depth 14.5 cm × height 48.5 cm x width 100 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met grazende koeien in een drassig weiland.

artworks.title: Satyr and Nymph
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 104 cm x width 131 cm
artworks.description: A smiling nymph playfully tugs a satyr towards her by his goatee, clearly asserting control over him. Van Honthorst draws attention to her bare torso; her brightly illuminated white skin contrasts sharply with the satyr’s muscular physique and red head. By portraying the mythological figures up close, Van Honthorst draws us into this intimate scene.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fish and Fruit
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.5 cm × height 23 cm x width 27 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met vier vissen op een vergiet, een tak perziken, een emmer, enkele bessen en een komkommer. Pendant van SK-A-1528.

artworks.title: The Entrance to the Woods
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9 cm × height 138 cm x width 164.5 cm
artworks.description: A vast watery view dotted with numerous mills – at first sight this is a typical Dutch landscape. The purplish mountains on the horizon, however, sooner recall Italy. To convey the wide panorama, Philips Koninck – a pupil of Rembrandt – adopted a high vantage point. In the foreground he placed some majestic trees rendered in a brownish-green impasto. Farther back, a meandering river leads the eye into the distance dominated by cooler colours.

artworks.title: Still Life with a Broken Glass
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 7.8 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 58.8 cm x width 68 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven op de hoek van een houten tafel: een omgevallen drinkschaal, een roemer met wijn, een omgevallen en gebroken roemer, twee tinnen borden met een mes en olijven. Op de hoek ligt een geschilde citroen.

artworks.title: Joseph Telling his Dreams
artworks.medium: paint (coating), pasteboard, paper, cardboard, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 69 cm x width 55.9 cm × height 51 cm x width 39 cm × depth 4.5 cm
artworks.description: Using loose brushstrokes, Rembrandt sketched Joseph telling his dreams to his parents and brothers. That they do not believe him is clear from their poses and facial expressions. Rembrandt made this rough oil sketch as a preparatory study for a large print, which, however, was never executed. The fact that this study has been preserved is remarkable, since much working material was lost over the course of time.

artworks.title: A Watermill
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.2 cm × height 62 cm x width 85.5 cm
artworks.description: Hobbema painted more than thirty ‘portraits’ of watermills, based on drawings he had made in the east of the Netherlands. He drew the same mill from various angles, so that one could see exactly how it was assembled. Here he was interested primarily in the technical construction of the wooden water channel, rendered in grey, which stands out against the landscape.

artworks.title: The Tailor’s Workshop
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 66 cm x width 53.5 cm
artworks.description: A woman runs errands with a market bucket on her arm. Inside the tailor’s workshop, she deliberates over a coat. The tailors are seated on a raised platform to make the most of the daylight. A hank of thread hangs at the ready above the table. Hanging on the wall is a river landscape, dispelling the notion that only affluent individuals could afford to have paintings in their homes in the 17th century.

artworks.title: Amsterdam Orphan Girl
artworks.artist: Nicolaas van der Waay (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 69 cm x width 43.5 cm × depth 11 cm
artworks.description: Een Amsterdams weesmeisje. Kniestuk, in profiel naar links, staande lezend in een boek voor een venster. Achter haar een sofa en een tafel waarop meer boeken liggen.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Christ Child
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint), tempera
artworks.dimensions: diameter 114.5 cm
artworks.description:
Cosimo Rosselli was a successful independent master and teacher whose work is typical of artistic production in Florence during the second half of the 15th century. This Nativity scene, which has survived in remarkably good condition, is representative of the Florentine feel for design and colouration, while also showing Rosselli’s reaction to recently imported
works by Flemish painters.

artworks.title: An Amsterdam Canal House Garden
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 66 cm x width 56 cm
artworks.description: The garden of this Amsterdam canal house radiates tranquillity and prosperity. At centre is a gilded statue of Fortuna, symbol of the family’s good fortune. In the bright sunlight, the master of the house picks grapes with his daughter, while in the foreground in the shade a maidservant cleans vegetables. A tame parrot looks on, hoping for a tasty tidbit.

artworks.title: Strand bij avond
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10.7 cm × height 49 cm x width 91 cm x thickness 3.4 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht over een strand bij avond, in het midden een schelpenvisser met paard en wagen.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 135 cm x width 115 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven. Op een tafel versierd met een leeuw liggen fruit en kostbaar vaatwerk uitgestald. Op tafel liggen een halve meloen, perziken, druiven en een granaatappel, een Wan Li-schaal met druiven, een pronkbokaal met deksel, een roemer met een citroenschil, een schenkkan, mes en horloge. Rechts op de zuil afbeeldingen van soldaten.

artworks.title: Forest Floor with a Snake, Lizards, Butterflies and other Insects
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 76 cm x width 62 cm × depth 11.5 cm
artworks.description: Bosgrond met verschillende dieren tussen de planten. Bij de voet van een boom lopen twee hagedissen, links hapt een slang naar een vlinder, een kikker kijkt toe. Op grashalmen zitten en in de lucht vliegen vinders en een libel.

artworks.title: Margarita Trip as Minerva, Instructing her Sister Anna Maria Trip
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 44.8 kg × height 208 cm x width 179 cm × height 224.2 cm x width 194.8 cm x thickness 8 cm
artworks.description:
In 1662 the fabulously wealthy Trip family moved into the stateliest private residence in all of Amsterdam. Hanging above a mantelpiece in one of the private rooms was this portrait of two of the Trip daughters: Margarita, wearing a helmet and a breastplate, represents Minerva (goddess of art and science), and the eager student kneeling by her side is her eleven-yearold
sister Anna Maria. In reality, Anna Maria received instruction from a private tutor.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.4 cm × height 64 cm x width 55 cm
artworks.description: Italiaans landschap. Op een bergpad onder enkele bomen maken een herder en een man te paard een praatje met elkaar. Links een bergstroom, in de verte bergpieken en een kasteel.

artworks.title: The Incredulity of Thomas
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 108.8 cm x width 136.5 cm
artworks.description:
Thomas simply could not believe that Christ had actually risen from the dead. His doubts were dispelled only when he had seen and touched the wounds in Christ’s side and hands himself. Emulating his great model Caravaggio, Ter Brugghen portrayed
Christ and his followers with craggy faces and wrinkled, rough hands.

artworks.title: Maurits, Prince of Orange (1567-1625)
artworks.artist: Michiel Jansz van Mierevelt (signed by artist)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: sight size: height 218.2 cm x width 141.7 cm × support: height 220.3 cm x width 143.5 cm
artworks.description: Prince Maurits was stadholder and military commander of the Republic of the Seven United Netherlands. He sired eight children with six different mistresses. As he refused to marry he had no legal successor. Maurits stands proud in a ceremonial gilded suit of armour, his helmet and gloves are on the table. This design had been the norm for state portraits since 1551, when it was first devised by the Italian painter Titian.

artworks.title: Afrikaantjes in een blauw vaasje
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 39.5 cm x width 31 cm x thickness 2.8 cm × depth 3.9 cm
artworks.description: Een boeket afrikaantjes in een blauw vaasje.

artworks.title: The Goatherdess
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 10 kg × height 61.5 cm x width 53 cm × depth 9.2 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met een geitenhoedster die met haar kudde in de schaduw van enige bomen rust.

artworks.title: Boslandschap met reizigers
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: weight 14 cm × height 68 cm x width 101.2 cm x thickness 3.1 cm × depth 8.9 cm
artworks.description: In een bosrijk zomers landschap zijn twee staande reizigers in gesprek met een langs het pad zittende man. Rechts een beek.

artworks.title: Pieter Cnoll, Cornelia van Nijenrode, their Daughters and Two Enslaved Servants
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 23 kg × height 132 cm x width 190.5 cm × height 141.5 cm x width 201.5 cm x thickness 7.5 cm
artworks.description: Cornelia van Nijenrode was the daughter of a Japanese courtesan and a Dutch East India Company (VOC) merchant. She was married to the wealthy senior VOC merchant Cnoll. In the background is Surapati, one of their servants. He fled slavery several years after he was portrayed here. First, he fought in the service of the VOC, but later against it. Surapati then became a monarch in East Java and centuries later was proclaimed Indonesia’s national hero.

artworks.title: Monk Meditating near a Ruin by Moonlight
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), linen (material)
artworks.dimensions: height 78 cm x width 64 cm
artworks.description: In the right foreground of this nocturnal scene a monk meditates near an overgrown ruin. This is the abbey in Villers-la-Ville near Brussels, the city where the painter lived for a while. The subject and the frame embellished with sheaves of wheat were inspired by the German Romantic painter Caspar David Friedrich’s famous Tetschen Altarpiece depicting a cross atop a mountain.

artworks.title: Girl at the Mirror
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 87 cm x width 73 cm × outer size: depth 8.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Dit geheimzinnige schilderij lijkt hoop te geven - maar het werpt meer vragen op dan het beantwoordt. Het oppervlak van het schilderij werkt als het oppervlak van de spiegel. Met een warme blik kijkt zij ons aan, maar haar spiegelbeeld doet ons beseffen dat de tijd verstrijkt en dat er geen weg terug is. Wij voelen ons oppermachtig omdat we meer van haar zien dan zijzelf. Wie is zij, waarom is zij zo blij?

artworks.title: Hunter’s Bag on a Terrace
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 211 cm x width 137 cm
artworks.description: Together, the two paintings hanging side by side here tell a story. In this one, a magnificent peacock wants to be king of the birds. Meanwhile, the magpie taking centre stage in the other painting voices its objection. The point is that being a worthy ruler is not solely about attractive appearances: he must be able to defend his people. Here, the right king is already present, symbolized by an orange: William III of Orange.

artworks.title: Still Life with Nautilus Cup
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 66 cm x width 56.5 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven op een marmeren tafelblad met een teruggeschoven Perzisch kleed waarop een zilveren schaal met een halfgeschilde citroen en sinaasappel, een omgevallen drinkschaal, een façon-de-venise glas, een opgerold stuk papier met peper en een nautiliusbeker. Rechtsboven een vlinder.

artworks.title: Portrait of Jan Pranger and an Enslaved Servant
artworks.artist: Frans van der Mijn (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 210 cm x width 154.5 cm
artworks.description: This scene is set at Fort Elmina, the headquarters of the Dutch slave trade in Western Africa, where Jan Pranger was director from 1730 to 1742. After his directorship, he travelled back via Suriname with ‘170 Slaves, coming from the coast of Guinea’ on board. The enslaved people remained behind in Paramaribo, except for one who accompanied him to Amsterdam as a servant, where this portrait was painted.

artworks.title: A Dog and a Cat near a partially disembowelled Deer
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 180 cm x width 162 cm × depth 12 cm × weight 46 kg
artworks.description: Jan Baptist Weenix, 1621 - 1660. A dog and a cat near a disembowelled deer, c. 1650. A roebuck, the result of a successful hunt, has been hung by one leg and cut open. The knife is still lying on the table, alongside the entrails. The scene is enlivened by the dog, who springs forward in the direction of the hissing cat. While Jan Baptist W eenix painted mainly landscapes and townscapes with figures, he also did a small number of still lifes, some of which focused on the hunt. In the museum since 1800, among the earliest works purchased

artworks.title: The Vijverberg, The Hague, in Winter, with Prince Maurits and his Retinue in the Foreground
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 8 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 71 cm x width 131.8 cm
artworks.description:
Tegen de achtergrond van de Haagse hofvijver passeert Maurits met zijn lijfwacht en gevolg. De figuur rechts naast hem is zijn jongere broer en opvolger Frederik Hendrik. Direct achter hen staan de belangrijkste hofdienaren. Allen dragen elegante, modieuze kleding.
De rijk geklede vrouw links is mogelijk Maurits’ geliefde Margaretha van Mechelen.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 113 cm x width 94.5 cm × depth 5 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven op een tafel met een Perzisch kleed. Op een vergulde zilveren schotel liggen suikergoed en koekjes, rechts een Chinese schotel met perziken. Vooraan een geschilde citroen. Achter verschillende glazen, rechts een glas met bier, in het midden een nautilusbeker.

artworks.title: View in a Forest, Outer Left Wing of a Triptych
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 89.8 cm x width 30.8 cm × sight size: height 88.2 cm x width 29.2 cm × frame: height 98 cm x width 39 cm
artworks.description: Bosgezicht. Eén van de twee bosgezichten op de buitenzijde van de twee zijpanelen van een drieluik (zie ook SK-A-3135). Het betreft hier het linkerzijpaneel met een poortgebouw. De binnenzijden van deze zijpanelen en het middenpaneel (met een aanbidding van het kind) bevinden zich in het Metropolitan Musuem of Art in New York.

artworks.title: Elegant Couples Courting
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 56.3 cm x width 70.5 cm
artworks.description:
The seated woman tries to entice the young man by offering him rosebuds. He turns away from her, resting
his hand on the head of his dog, his wise mentor. No harm will come to this young man. The other couple,
however, choose wanton love; they leave the glove – a symbol of marriage – lying on the ground.

artworks.title: Spanish Warhorse
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.2 cm × height 228 cm x width 269 cm
artworks.description: This Spanish stallion belonged to the Spanish military commander Albert of Austria in 1600. During the Battle of Nieuwpoort the horse was seized and subsequently presented to Prince Maurice. Three years later Maurice had the horse grandly portrayed as a war trophy and a sign of triumph. At some point the painting lost this meaning and was folded up; the resulting damage is still visible.

artworks.title: Boatmen Moored on the Shore of an Italian Lake
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 97.5 cm x width 85.5 cm
artworks.description: Dark tree trunks in the foreground frame the softly lit scene in the centre. Our attention is drawn to two boatmen busy loading and unloading their boats. A mother and her child are seated on the shore: her yellow jacket partly open, the woman is about to breastfeed the fussy infant.

artworks.title: The Battle of Livorno
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 142 cm x width 225 cm
artworks.description: A painted sheet of paper at the lower left describes the subject: the battle between the Dutch and English fleets off the Italian port of Livorno (Leghorn). Victory brought the Dutch control over trade in the Mediterranean. Nooms almost certainly painted the canvas for the Chamber of Levantine Trade in Amsterdam.

artworks.title: Portrait of Emperor Napoleon I
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 226.5 cm x width 146 cm
artworks.description: After having seized power through a coup d’état in 1799, General Napoleon proclaimed himself emperor in 1804. In the meanwhile, he conquered large parts of Europe. The year 1812 was a turning point. His invasion of Russia failed and his forces lost the Battle of the Nations near Leipzig. In 1814 Napoleon was exiled to the island of Elba. He escaped, but was definitively defeated 100 days later at the Battle of Waterloo.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Goldsmith, Probably Bartholomeus Jansz van Assendelft
artworks.artist: Werner van den Valckert (signed by artist)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 66 cm x width 49.5 cm
artworks.description: The man leans out of a window. In his right hand he holds up a gold ring set with a stone. His left hand rests on a touchstone, an instrument for assessing the purity of gold and silver objects. The sitter might be the goldsmith Bartholomeus Jansz van Assendelft. In 1617, the year the portrait was painted, he was appointed assay-master of the Leiden goldsmiths’ guild, which would explain the inclusion of the touchstone.

artworks.title: Portrait of Clara Alewijn
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 121.5 cm x width 89.5 cm × outer size: depth 7.8 cm (support incl. SK-L-2105)
artworks.description: Clara Alewijn was only nine years old when she sat for this painting. It is the pendant of the portrait of her brother Martinus. Mirroring him, Clara is portrayed as shepherdess sitting beneath a tree and surrounded by sheep. She holds a staff and flowers in her right hand. The bow and quiver in the foreground refer to hunting. Her festive fantasy gown lends the scene a timeless character.

artworks.title: Man and Woman at a Spinning Wheel
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 3.5 cm × height 76 cm x width 63 cm
artworks.description: The man holding an open jug attempts to seduce the woman, who, however, looks the other way. In her right hand, she holds a spindle wrapped with yarn, which, together with the spinning wheel, signals her virtue. Yet in her other hand, she holds a yarn winder, representing temptation. The choice between the two is hers.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Cows
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 43 cm x width 72.5 cm x thickness 1.5 cm × outer size: depth 7 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Albert Cuyp (1620 - 1691). River landscape with cows, c. 1650. Purchased in 1958, with aid of the N.V. Philips (Eindhoven) to the Jubilee Fund.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape in Tirol with Chamois
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.7 cm × height 26 cm x width 23 cm x thickness 1 cm
artworks.description:
A landscape with towering mountains and insignificant human figures and animals in the foreground are typical elements of a Romantic composition. Tavenraat fell under the spell of the landscape while travelling through Tirol and made countless drawings and oil sketches of it.
Here he painted the morning mist in bold gradations of violet. The small mountain hut and the miniscule group of shepherds with their flock make the mountains seem even higher.

artworks.title: A rooster with Hens and Chicks
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 61.3 cm x width 80 cm x thickness 2.5 cm × height 69.9 cm x width 88.6 cm x depth 9.8 cm
artworks.description: Kippen: een haan met hennen en kuikens in het gras. De hen links kijkt naar een kikker.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.8 cm × height 68 cm x width 63 cm
artworks.description: Various types of fruit are arranged in a basket on a stone table. These include bunches of red and white grapes, currents, apricots, peaches, chestnuts, cherries and raspberries. Insects are crawling among the fruit and there is even a snail. Van Walscapelle employed a marvellously colourful pallet and rendered the fruit with remarkable feeling for texture.

artworks.title: The Love Letter
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 131 cm x width 108 cm
artworks.description: Dutch artists of the 19th century drew inspiration from the 17th century, the Golden Age of Dutch art. In this picture, Van der Kooi reprised a typically 17th-century theme, the delivery of a love letter. The tension between the lady and the young messenger is almost palpable. Yet The Love Letter is also highly contemporary, for the interior, hairstyles and clothing are entirely in keeping with the fashions of 1808.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 76.5 cm x width 64.5 cm × depth 7.5 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met een kreeft, oesters, brood, sinaasappels, een citroen, een glas, een pepervat en een mandfles met wijn.

artworks.title: Tulip Fields
artworks.medium: paper, paint (coating), textile materials, pasteboard, canvas, cardboard, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 26.3 cm x width 41.6 cm x thickness 1.3 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: Bollenvelden. Veld met bloeiende gele en witte tulpen omzoomd door bomen.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Wounded KNIL soldier
artworks.medium: plant material, paint (coating), wood board, biological material, hardboard, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 37 cm x width 23 cm
artworks.description: After joining the Royal Netherlands East Indies Army (KNIL) in the former slave fortress of Elmina, Ghana, this man was called Kees Pop. His own name is unknown, but his parents were known as Kwamena and Ekoerva. ‘Pop’ served twelve years and fought in the Aceh War in Indonesia. Israëls painted him – with medals – while he was on sick leave in the Netherlands shortly before he returned to Africa.

artworks.title: Summer Day
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 19 cm x width 31 cm
artworks.description: Instead of a traditional mill, Weissenbruch now painted a modern pumping engine, which regulated the level of the water in the polder. He probably made this oil sketch somewhere outside of The Hague. Weissenbruch tacked the sheet of paper onto the lid of his paintbox: the tiny holes are still visible in the corners. Back in his studio, he incorporated the motif into one of his completed paintings.

artworks.title: Still Life with Apples
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 85.5 cm x width 74.5 cm x thickness 10 cm × height 59 cm x width 48 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met appels.

artworks.title: The Courtyard of a house in Cairo
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 84 cm x width 62 cm x depth 11 cm x height 115 cm x width 92.5 cm
