artworks.description: Binnenplaats van een huis te Caïro in Egypte. In de deuropening van een oud huis zit een gesluierde moeder met kind in gesprek met een man met een paard. Enkele kinderen kijken toe.

artworks.title: Lunchtime at the Building Site on the Van Diemenstraat in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 12 cm × height 78 cm x width 115 cm
artworks.description: When the North Sea Canal was finished in 1876, the Amsterdam IJ became navigable for large oceanliners. New streets with warehouses – such as the Van Die-menstraat seen in this painting – were built along the banks of the canal. Breitner depicted construction workers on their lunch break, seen from the back. They are painted with the same rough, angular volumes as the planks on which they sit and the tents and sails in the background.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outersize: depth 13 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 190 cm x width 137 cm
artworks.description: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo (1618 - 1682). Virgin and Child in Glory, c. 1650. Purchased by King Willem I, 1818. On loan from the Mauritshuis, The Hague, 1948.

artworks.title: Stilleven met gitaar en rozen
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 60.5 cm x width 120.5 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met een krans van witte rozen, liggend op een gitaar.

artworks.title: The IJ near Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.3 cm × height 81 cm x width 67 cm
artworks.description: The IJ in Amsterdam was a bustling hub of activity, where diverse people converged – sailors and other seafarers, traders, ship owners and loaders, as well as relatives bidding farewell to the sailors and street urchins in search of adventure. A man aboard of this ship deftly maneuvers the vessel along the shore with a boat hook, while two other crew members nearby lower the sprit sail.

artworks.title: Portrait of Cornelia, Clara and Johanna Veth
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 90.2 cm x width 109.6 cm × depth 5.5 cm
artworks.description: Veth was twenty and still living at home when he portrayed his three sisters, who appear unhappy in the painting. At the time their mother was struggling with depression and would die just three years later. Although their father thought the portrait was a good likeness, he would have preferred their facial features to be slightly softer, likely referencing both the painting style and the sorrow that his daughters were experiencing.

artworks.title: Animals and Plants
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 62 cm x width 49 cm
artworks.description: Dieren en planten. Een bunzing heeft een ei veroverd, rechts een slang tussen paddestoelen. Tussen de planten zitten vlinders, een vogel, slakken en rupsen.

artworks.title: Portrait of Charlotta Beatrix Strick van Linschoten
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 206 cm x width 122 cm
artworks.description: Strick van Linschoten had herself portrayed in a gown adorned with golden and brightly coloured flowers. Behind her is a country estate, probably Eemwijck, located opposite Essesteijn, before which her husband poses. Upon his death, she inherited both manors and commissioned the construction of a new farmhouse, with her initials on the gable. In this portrait, the family coat of arms on the balustrade make it clear who the patrons are.

artworks.title: Vrouw voor haar huis
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 48 cm x width 42.2 cm x depth 6.2 cm × height 24.7 cm x width 20 cm
artworks.description: Een vrouw zit voor haar huis te handwerken, links een poort waarnaast een emmer staat. Op de achtergrond bomen.

artworks.title: Winter op het IJ voor Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 81 cm x width 114 cm × depth 10 cm
artworks.description: Wintergezicht met Amsterdam in de verte. Links een huis en een schuur, rechts op het ijs verschillende schaatsers en personen met sleden.

artworks.title: The Painter’s Studio
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 36.5 cm x width 34.5 cm × frame: height 54 cm x width 51 cm x depth 8 cm
artworks.description: This painter is hardly rich: his workshop is located in an old, dark building. His artistic ambitions are not high, for on the easel is a modest landscape. Nevertheless, he has two apprentices. Van Ostade is here poking gentle fun at his own specialization. He did not portray his own studio, but invented the workshop of an ordinary painter who could have painted all of his (Van Ostade’s) peasant scenes.

artworks.title: Landscape near Abcoude
artworks.artist: Paul Joseph Constantin Gabriël (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.8 cm × height 16.5 cm x width 42 cm
artworks.description: Landschap bij Abcoude. In weilanden naast oude vestingswallen grazen enige koeien, in de verte een kerktoren.

artworks.title: Democritus
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 85.7 cm x width 70 cm
artworks.description: The Greek philosophers Democritus and Heraclitus were considered to be polar opposites. In contrast to the old, melancholy Heraclitus (the nearby pendant), Democritus appears as a young, laughing hedonist. He points to the distance, as though that is where the folly of mankind is found. Together, the pair of paintings conveys a moralizing message: whether you laugh or cry, the world remains incurably foolish.

artworks.title: The Westernmost Bays of the South Aisle of the Mariakerk in Utrecht
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 39 cm x width 30 cm × outer size: depth 5.7 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Gezicht in de westelijke traveeën van de zuidelijke beuk van de Mariakerk te Utrecht. Bij het venster maken drie mannen een praatje.

artworks.title: The Fishwife
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 6.1 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 35.9 cm x width 40 cm
artworks.description: Een vrouw achter een viskraam toont ons een mooie verse vis. Het licht valt rechtstreeks op haar gezicht en handen. De vrouw kijkt het schilderij uit en spreekt zo de toeschouwer direct aan. De band tussen toeschouwer en visvrouw wordt nog versterkt door de compositie: door de afsnijding van de marktkraam lijkt de kijker als het ware ín de kraam te staan.

artworks.title: The Expulsion from Paradise
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: support: height 29.8 cm x width 38.4 cm
artworks.description: Although God forbade Adam and Eve to eat the fruit of the ‘tree of the knowledge of good and evil’, they did so anyway. As punishment, they were driven out of Paradise by an angel with a flaming sword. They fled into the barren mountain landscape. Van Poelenburch, after returning to the Netherlands from Italy, produced this type of highly refined, painstakingly painted landscape throughout the rest of his career.

artworks.title: The Y at Amsterdam, with the Frigate 'De Ploeg'
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 68 cm x width 81 cm × weight 6.6 kg × depth 4.9 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op het IJ voor Amsterdam met het oorlogsschip 'De Ploeg'. Verschillende personen op de voorgrond, rechts een steiger.

artworks.title: The Old Drinker
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 22 cm x width 19.5 cm
artworks.description: This old man holding a beer tankard looks out at us somewhat drowsily. The tally of the drinks he has consumed is chalked up on the slate behind him. The beer barrel at the left bears the mark of Het Rode Hert (The Red Hart), an Amsterdam brewery on the Prinsengracht. Metsu was living next door to it around 1650.

artworks.title: Brook in the Woods near Oosterbeek
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, paper, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × height 30 cm x width 23.4 cm
artworks.description: This sketch dates from Matthijs Maris’s formative years, when he spent summers working together with his brother Jacob in the vicinity of Oosterbeek. The wooded hills on the edge of the Rhine Valley were full of picturesque spots. This idyllic scene strikes one as still Romantic, but Maris took great pains to observe and render accurately the fall of sunlight on the flowing water.

artworks.title: Dancing Couple
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 38.3 cm x width 52.2 cm
artworks.description: Het dansende paar. Herberginterieur met een boer en boerin die dansen op de muziek van een vioolspeler staande op een ton. Rechts een roker en een man die drinkt uit een pasglas.

artworks.title: Frolicking on a Frozen Canal in a Town
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 11 cm × height 74 cm x width 100 cm
artworks.description: IJsvermaak op een stadsgracht. Schaatsers en mensen met sledes op het ijs, rechts een molen, in de verte een kathedraal.

artworks.title: Jacob’s Dream
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 22 cm x width 29.5 cm
artworks.description: The Bible recounts how one night Jacob lay down on a stone to sleep. He dreamt that he saw a ladder reaching up to heaven with God’s angels going up and down. When he awoke, Jacob vowed to use the stone to build an altar in that place, which he called Bethel (‘House of God’). De Vois painted Jacob’s almost naked body as smooth as porcelain. The once green leaves have turned blue because the yellow pigment in them has disappeared over time.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman (previously identified as Queen Elizabeth I)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5 cm × height 43.7 cm x width 32.2 cm x thickness 0.8 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een vrouw. Vroeger geïdentificeerd als Elisabeth I (1533-1603), koningin van Engeland. Buste, iets naar links, met bloemen in het haar en een parelsnoer om de hals.

artworks.title: Winter Landscape near a Town with Kolf Players and Horse-Drawn Sleighs
artworks.artist: Aert van der Neer (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 63.2 cm x width 77.7 cm × outer size: depth 8.7 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description:
Een typisch Hollands wintergezicht: op het ijs vermaken mensen zich met schaatsen en sleeën. Rechts wordt paling gestoken in een wak.
Een groepje mensen speelt ‘kolf’. Dit spel, dat op land en ijs werd gespeeld, was sinds de Middeleeuwen de populairste volkssport van Nederland. Het doel was om met ballen en een soort golfstick de palen van de kolfbaan te raken.

artworks.title: Park with Country House
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × weight 55.8 kg × height 308 cm x width 220 cm
artworks.description: Park met buitenhuis. Gezicht vanaf een terras met tegelvloer waarop een stoel staat met daartegenaan een viola da gamba. Iets naar achteren een wandelend paar met een hond. Aan weerszijden van het terras staan potten met sinaasappelboompjes. Op de rand van de linker pot zit een hop, op de rand van de rechter pot een pestvogel. Rechts een muur met beelden en een langwerpige vijver, op de achtergrond een landhuis. Boven het terras zit een blauw-gele ara (Ara ararauna) op een stok, verder ook andere vogels waaronder een zwarte kroonkraanvogel en een pauw. Deel van een zesdelige kamerbeschildering waarvan een ander deel bewaard wordt in de collectie van Musée de la Chartreuse, Douai.

artworks.title: De aanbidding van de drie koningen
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 84.1 cm x width 55.2 cm x height 82.2 cm x width 23.6 cm x height 82.2 cm x width 23.6 cm
artworks.description: The three kings worship the baby Jesus on the central panel. The donors, their children and patron saints appear on the wings: the father with his six sons and Saint Jerome (left), and the mother with her seven daughters and Saint Catherine (right). The two children in white shrouds had died. On the outer wings are Saint Christopher and Saint Anthony Abbot.

artworks.title: Portrait of Joseph Deutz
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 99.5 cm x width 74.5 cm
artworks.description: This is an unusual portrait: a young man direct engaging the viewer, as though he is about to speak. Sweerts portrayed Joseph Deutz in Rome, while he was sojourning there with his brothers. Deutz (1624–1684) was a member of one of the wealthiest families in Amsterdam. His art collection also included Sweerts’ paintings of the ‘Seven Works of Mercy’, four of which are presented in this gallery.

artworks.title: The Breach of the Saint Anthony’s Dike near Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, linen (material), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 85.5 cm x width 108.2 cm
artworks.description: During the night of 4-5 March 1651 the Saint Anthony’s Dike was breached near Amsterdam. Jan Asselijn portrayed the fiercely flowing water with a strong sense of drama. The billowing cloak of the man at the left shows that the storm is not yet over, however the squalls are already moving on at the right. The vivid red contrasts sharply with the bright blue of the parting clouds.

artworks.title: Portrait of Adriana Croes
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 8 cm (support incl. SK-L-4523) × support: height 92 cm x width 75.2 cm
artworks.description:
Adriana Croes had herself immortalized by Verspronck when she had been widowed for several years. She and her husband, the cloth merchant Hendrick Pietersz Strijp, had five daughters. Years later, one of them, Maria, and her husband, Eduard Wallis, were also portrayed by
Verspronck; their likenesses hang nearby. Adriana’s face is so realistically painted that it seems to reflect all her joys and sorrows.

artworks.title: Battle between Carnival and Lent
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 74.7 cm x width 240 cm
artworks.description: Het gevecht tussen Carnaval en Vasten. Bij een keuken wordt een doedelzakspeler naar binnen gedragen, hieromheen veel dansende en drinkende personen, waaronder een nar. Rechts draagt een figuur met een blad met vissen en speelt een man op een luit.

artworks.title: Landscape in the Dutch East Indies (Java?)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.5 cm × height 53.2 cm x width 48.2 cm x thickness 2.3 cm
artworks.description: In 1858, the then 28-year-old Dutch painter Maurits van den Kerkhoff moved to Java, an island in Indonesia, which was a Dutch colony at the time. Van den Kerkhoff painted Javanese landscapes in a European manner. All the elements are rendered in detail, but with little regard for reality. The light is evenly distributed, giving the scene an air of artificiality.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Ferry
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: height 116.5 cm x width 152 cm × height 91 cm x width 126 cm
artworks.description: With four horses, five dogs, two cows and eleven people on board, this slender ferry appears to be heavily loaded. The boats in the distance are also crowded with passengers. Salomon van Ruysdael was the interpreter par excellence of the flat, watery Dutch landscape. Here he used a dried-and-tested compositional formula: at right, a bank lined with tall trees, and at left, a body of water stretching out to the horizon.

artworks.title: Woman Peeling an Apple
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 70 cm x width 57 cm × depth 6.7 cm
artworks.description: A maidservant has kicked off her slipper and is peeling an apple, her broom leaning idly beside her. Bisschop placed her in the entrance hall, on the threshold between inside and outside. A tableau unfolds behind her: a glass rests on the table, two keys dangle from a cord, and paintings adorn the wall. There is also a small bird in a cage, forming a contrast with the birds fluttering about freely outside.

artworks.title: Officers and Other Civic Guardsmen of District XVIII in Amsterdam, under the Command of Captain Albert Dircksz Bas and Lieutenant Lucas Pietersz Conijn
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: total: weight 109 kg × outer size: height 365.5 cm (support incl. frame) x width 268.5 cm (support incl. frame) x depth 10.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 338.7 cm x width 242.5 cm
artworks.description: Govert Flinck (1615 - 1660). The company of Captain Alber t Bas, 1645. Gover t Flinck has arranged his subjects in a circle around Captain Albert Bas. He did not have a great deal of choice, due to the fixed dimensions of his painting. The size was dictated by the spot for which the work was intended: the relatively narrow space next to the fireplace in the Kloveniersdoelen. The Amsterdam civic guard had recently expanded its headquarters, and the walls of the enormous new doelenzaal or militia hall were decorated with six large civic guard paintings. In addition to this work by Flinck, they included the Night-watch by Rembrandt and civic guard works by Joachim von Sandrart and Bartholomeus van der Helst; all three are also hanging in this room. Painted for the Grand Hall of the Kloveniersdoelen (headquarters of the crossbowmen's civic guard), Amsterdam. On loan from the city of Amsterdam, 1885.

artworks.title: Girl at a Window, known as ‘The Daydreamer’
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.5 cm × height 123 cm x width 96 cm
artworks.description: Uit het venster leunende figuren vormden een populair onderwerp in de 17de eeuw. Hier staart een in gedachten verzonken jong meisje uit het raam, dat is omgeven door abrikozenranken. Haar gezicht en handen steken helder af tegen de donkere achtergrond. Dit licht-donkercontrast leerde Maes van zijn meester Rembrandt. Het warme rood is kenmerkend voor het werk van Maes zelf.

artworks.title: The Artist Painting a Cow in a Meadow
artworks.artist: Hendrikus van de Sande Bakhuyzen (signed by artist)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.5 cm × height 73.2 cm x width 96.7 cm
artworks.description: Zelfportret van Hendrikus van de Sande Bakhuyzen, schilderend in een weidelandschap met vee. De schilder zit op een boomstam met palet en penselen in de hand en de schilderskist met het schilderij op zijn knieën. Naast de boom liggen zijn hoed en kruk in het gras. Voor hem liggen schapen en een koe in de weide.

artworks.title: Two Young Women in the Snow
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 65 cm x width 36 cm
artworks.description: An everday scene in Amsterdam in the winter: two warmly dressed factory workers or studio models. Israels painted them as if, during their break, they had briefly, hesitatingly, stopped before him. However, appearances can be deceptive. The pose of both women is carefully considered, and the black and red passages of their shawls and coats are contrasted to create a well-balanced composition, despite looking like the record of a fleeting moment.

artworks.title: Still Life with Dead Game, Fruit and Vegetables
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 7.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 55.9 cm x width 87.3 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met wild en vruchten. Op een tafel liggen een haas, dode vogels, een artisjok, een bos asperges, een schaal met aardbeien, een tazza met druiven, perziken en pruimen, een façon-de-venise glas en een kan.

artworks.title: Portrait of a young Woman
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 45 cm x width 31 cm × depth 11 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een jonge vrouw. Buste, profiel naar links. Het haar in vlechten op het hoofd gevouwen.

artworks.title: Portrait of Swaddled Twins: The Early-Deceased Children of Jacob de Graeff and Aeltge Boelens
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: frame: height 90 cm x width 70.1 cm (support incl. frame) × sight size: height 71 cm x width 51 cm × support: height 71.6 cm x width 52.5 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een ingebakerde tweeling: de vroeg gestorven kinderen van Jacob de Graeff en Aeltge Boelens. Links- en rechtsboven het familiewapen.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 57 cm x width 52.5 cm x thickness 3.9 cm (support incl. protective backboard) × outer size: depth 7.8 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Abraham van Beyeren (1620/21 - 1690). Still life.

artworks.title: Still life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10.5 cm × height 74.1 cm x width 92.8 cm x thickness 3.6 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met fruit en gevogelte. In het midden een rietenmand met druiven, pruimen, perziken, een meloen, granaatappels en een tak stokroos. Hierbij liggen ook verschillende dode vogels, waaronder een fazant. Links op de voorgrond een jachtgeweer, linksachter een weitas.

artworks.title: Salome ontvangt het hoofd van Johannes de Doper
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 149 cm x width 121 cm
artworks.description: Attributed to Carel Fabritius (1622 - 1654). The beheading of John the Baptist, c. 1645. On the right we see Salomé who - according to the biblical account - is rewarded for her dancing with the head of John the Baptist on a platter. It is not certain who the artist was. The free painting style and the contrasts between light and dark point to one of Rembrandt's pupils, perhaps Carel Fabritius. Purchased in 1801 as a Rembrandt.

artworks.title: De Waag (Weighing House) and Crane on the Spaarne, Haarlem
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 35 cm x width 45.5 cm x depth 6.5 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op de Waag aan het Spaarne te Haarlem. Langs de kade staat een hijskraan en liggen kleine boten in het water, links in de verte de toren van de Bakenesserkerk.

artworks.title: 'Mystieke paden': bosgezicht
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.5 cm × height 129.5 cm x width 179 cm x thickness 3.4 cm
artworks.description: Voorstelling getiteld 'Mystieke paden'. Bosgezicht met dicht opeen groeiende bomen.

artworks.title: Tulip Fields
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 20 cm x width 35 cm
artworks.description: Tulpenvelden. Gezicht over tulpenvelden in de Bollenstreek. In de verte enkele arbeiders, aan de horizon windmolens.

artworks.title: Hera Hiding during the Battle of the Gods and Giants
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 87 cm x width 69.5 cm
artworks.description: Hera verbergt zich tijdens het gevecht van de goden met de giganten. Een jonge vrouw verbergt zich liggend onder een rotsblok en een parasol aan de waterkant. Op de rotsblok zitten twee pauwen. Links een hond. Herhaling van de versie in Moskou.

artworks.title: Geertruida den Dubbelde (1647-84), Wife of Aert van Nes
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 139 cm x width 125 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Geertruida den Dubbelde, de echtgenote van luitenant-admiraal Aert van Nes. Kniestuk, staand voor een balustrade met uitzicht op een haven met oorlogsschepen en mensen op de kade. Sieraden met parels in het haar en om de polsen. De rechterhand uitgestoken, de linker in de zij. Pendant van SK-A-140.

artworks.title: Portrait of Anna Boudaen Courten (1599-1622)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 94.6 cm x width 68.9 cm × outer size: depth 7 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Portret van Anna Boudaen Courten, echtgenote van Jacob Pergens. Staand, ten halven lijve, leunend met de linkerhand op een tafel. Op het hoofd een hoge zwarte hoed. Op de achterzijde, het familiewapen, een inscriptie en het cijfer 42. Pendant van SK-A-918.

artworks.title: View of Dordrecht at Sunset
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 67 cm x width 83.7 cm × outer size: depth 9 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Gezicht op Dordrecht bij zonsondergang. Anonieme kopie naar de linkerhelft van het grote schilderij van Cuyp in de verzameling van Anthony de Rothschild.

artworks.title: A Coastal Ruin in Italy
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 54.5 cm x width 48 cm × height 65.4 cm x width 59 cm x thickness 3.7 cm
artworks.description: A favourite motif of the Italianates was a small harbour on the Mediterranean Sea with a crumbling quay and a ruin. At right are an African man and a couple of Turkish traders. At the left, a man in northern European clothing gestures out to sea. Overseas trade stimulated an interest for such scenes among Dutch collectors, even though the views were imaginary.

artworks.title: Feeding Chickens
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.8 cm × height 33 cm x width 21 cm
artworks.description: Voorstelling getiteld 'Kippetjes voeren'. Een meisje is bezig in een tuintje de kippen te voeren, zij heeft de voorkant van haar rok omhoog gevouwen. Links en rechts zonnebloemen tegen een hek.

artworks.title: An Afternoon view of Snowy Woods
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 120.3 cm x width 90.5 cm × depth 14.5 cm
artworks.description: Boslandschap bij winter. In het midden een bevroren sloot, links en rechts hoge kale bomen. In de verte enkele figuren bij een schuit en een paard en wagen.

artworks.title: East Indiamen off a Coast
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 4.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 104 cm x width 199 cm
artworks.description: Departure of the fleet of Jacob van Neck, 1598 by Hendrick Cornelisz Vroom, 1599. After a fourteen-month voyage to Asia, in July 1599 Van Neck returned with a valuable cargo (mainly spices) to Amsterdam. It was the first successful Dutch trading expedition to the Indonesian archipelago. The voyage was financed by a group of Amsterdam merchants who combined to back the venture. Their example was soon emulated. Companies were formed in several cities. This was followed by the foundation of an umbrella enterprise. To be able to compete more effectively with foreign rivals, the grand pensionary, Johan van Oldenbarnevelt proposed that the different companies unite to form the Verenigde Oostindische Compagnie (Dutch East India Company or VOC) which was duly founded in 1602.

artworks.title: De schelpenvisser
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 40 cm x width 32 cm × depth 8.5 cm
artworks.description: De schelpenvisser. Een visser uit Domburg, staande ten voeten uit, met een juk met manden op de schouders en de zee op de achtergrond.

artworks.title: The Battle of the Downs
artworks.medium: textile materials, materials by function, canvas, ink
artworks.dimensions: height 124 cm x width 190 cm
artworks.description: In 1639 the Spanish attempted to transport troops and supplies to Flanders with a large fleet. The Spanish armada was intercepted in the English Channel by Maerten Harpertsz Tromp, who commanded a much smaller force. His spectacular victory and his capture of the Santa Teresa – the large Spanish warship burning on the left – established the Dutch fleet’s formidable reputation.

artworks.title: Still Life with a Hare and other Game
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 114.5 cm x width 96 cm
artworks.description: Weenix set this luxurious game still life in the park of a country estate. He rendered the soft fur of the hare and the stiff wings of the partridge with his finest brushes. At the right are a hunting horn and a bag. Weenix created the structure of the moss in the foreground by covering the wet paint with wood or paper, which he then immediately removed.

artworks.title: Ducks
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 19 cm x width 27 cm
artworks.description: The reeds seem to be rustling here. A mother duck watches her brood splash into the water. Their reflections show on the pond’s surface. Maris used quick strokes of paint to capture the moment. With the invention of the paint tube in 1841, it became much easier for artists, like Maris, to take their materials with them and paint outdoors. He would work upthe compositions back in his studio.

artworks.title: The Sand Bargeman
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 62 cm x width 90 cm
artworks.description: In 1871 Jozef Israëls moved into a modern villa on the Koninginnegracht in The Hague. From his sitting room, he could see the fishermen, sand bargemen and seaside visitors travelling by canal to and from Scheveningen. Here the sand bargeman is transport-ing sand from the levelled dunes to the new districts of The Hague. But he also personifies the difficult journey of human life. This is the central theme of Israëls’ work.

artworks.title: The Valkhof in Nijmegen
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 11 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 91.5 cm x width 130 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op het Valkhof, gelegen bij de Waal te Nijmegen. Op de voorgrond steekt een veerpont de rivier over.

artworks.title: Family scene
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 48.5 cm x width 40 cm × depth 8 cm
artworks.description: Dit kleurrijke gezelschap viert feest. Rechts achteraan zitten een heer en een dame wat stijfjes naar de levensgenieters te kijken. Merkwaardig is het uiltje boven hun hoofd. De uil was destijds een symbool voor domheid, dronkenschap en schijnheiligheid. Jan Steen dreef hier waarschijnlijk de spot met de zogenaamde vroomheid van zijn tijdgenoten.

artworks.title: View of Zoutelande
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 80 cm x width 159.5 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: At the beginning of the 20th century, painters were drawn to the North Sea coast of the province of Zeeland. Every summer an artists’ colony gathered in the charming seaside resort of Domburg on Walcheren. Hart Nibbrig even had a summer house built in nearby Zoutelande in 1911. From a high vantage point in the dunes he painted the sweltering summer light.

artworks.title: Landscape near Kortenhoef
artworks.artist: Paul Joseph Constantin Gabriël (signed by artist)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 20 kg × depth 14.5 cm × height 37 cm x width 57.5 cm
artworks.description: Cities expanded rapidly in the late 19th century. Within 50 years, Amsterdam’s population doubled. Many artists wanted to escape the modern cities and move to the country in search of peaceful nature. However, in the Netherlands, even the countryside had been intensively transformed by man. For centuries, vast strips of sea have been dried up to increase the land surface.

artworks.title: Building Site in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 52 cm x width 91 cm
artworks.description: Amsterdam underwent tremendous growth at the turn of the 20th century. The city expanded with new residential areas built on millions of piles. Breitner was fascinated by the modern metropolis and its many building sites. In this painting, we see new homes rising on the left, while a horse drags a pile into the construction pit in the foreground. On the right, another pile is driven into the ground with a steam hammer, a recent invention.

artworks.title: Lying Cow
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 17 cm x width 25 cm × depth 7.8 cm
artworks.description: Een liggende koe, van voren gezien.

artworks.title: Portret van een man
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 28 cm x width 23 cm × depth 3 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een man. Buste naar rechts met een grote zwart hoed, geschilderd in de trant van Gerard ter Borch.

artworks.title: Woman Playing the Virginal
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 38.6 cm x width 29.6 cm
artworks.description: During the 17th century, making music at home was very popular and many wealthy people played a musical instrument. Here, a woman plays a virginal while two children listen attentively. A man is just entering the room. The painting is full of love symbolism: making music was a common metaphor for love, while the chained monkey on the instrument serves as a warning against lust.

artworks.title: The Arrest of Diponegoro by Lieutenant General De Kock
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 111 cm x width 134 cm x thickness 14 cm × height 75.8 cm x width 98.7 cm x depth 3.3 cm
artworks.description: Prince Diponegoro was the main leader in the Java War (1825-1830). Although he had been promised safe conduct, he was arrested during the peace negotiations. Pieneman painted this picture on commission for De Kock, responsible for this betrayal. The painting therefore does not show the actual treachery, but rather Diponegoro ‘submitting’ to Dutch authority. The self-assured Dutch commanders stand tall on the veranda. The Dutch tricolour flutters at full mast.

artworks.title: Girl Knitting
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: thickness 9 cm × height 51 cm x width 40.5 cm
artworks.description: Het breistertje. Duinlandschap waarin een meisje zit te breien.

artworks.title: Portrait of Ambrogio Spinola
artworks.artist: Michiel Jansz van Mierevelt (signed by artist)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 119 cm x width 87.5 cm
artworks.description: Between 1601 and 1627 Ambrogio Spinola is by far the most important general of the Spanish army. During the Siege of Ostend, which lasts from 1601 to 1604, Spinola provides not only his services, but also his money for this cause. These additional means are most welcome, for now he can pay his troops should the funds from Spain be delayed. Under his command the Spanish army recaptures Oldenzaal and Groenlo, and in 1625 even the most important fortified city, Breda.

artworks.title: Amorous Couple
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 54.2 cm x width 42.7 cm × outer size: depth 7 cm (support incl. SK-L-4261)
artworks.description: Liefdespaar. Liefkozende naakte man en vrouw, zittend onder een boom.

artworks.title: The Letter Writer
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 25 cm x width 20 cm
artworks.description: We can only guess as to the content of the letter being composed by this woman. A lute, an instrument with amorous connotations, rests on the table. Writing love letters was wildly popular and highly regarded in that time. Compared to surrounding countries, many people in the Dutch Republic could read and write. The messenger standing behind the woman patiently awaits her to finish so that he can deliver the missive.

artworks.title: The Arms of the Dutch East India Company and of the Town of Batavia
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 63 cm x width 97 cm
artworks.description: These shields feature the arms of the Dutch East India Company, ornamented with Neptune and a mermaid, and those of Batavia, flanked by Dutch lions. According to the inscription on the latter, the city of Jacatra (now Jakarta) was ‘Conquered on 30 May in the year 1619’. That same year Governor-General Jan Pietersz Coen renamed it Batavia and built a castle with dockyards, warehouses and offices.

artworks.title: The Continence of Scipio
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 44 cm x width 79 cm
artworks.description:
The Roman general Scipio has just captured New Carthage. Standing among the prisoners of war is a young woman, part of Scipio’s spoils. However he displays magnanimity. When her family and fiancé come to buy her freedom, he lets her go for free and
unharmed. Van Mander created depth by painting the figures in the foreground in bright colours, while the background is less vivid.

artworks.title: Woman in Peasant Costume
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 28 cm x width 23 cm
artworks.description: Ter Borch probably depicted his half-sister Gesina ter Borch here. She, too, was an artist, and frequently modelled for him. In the 17th century, her appearance, with her gathered plaits and a red hairband, would immediately identify her as an unmarried country girl. She is holding a printed sheet of paper, from which she briefly glances up.

artworks.title: Orestes and Pylades Disputing at the Altar
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 6.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 83.2 cm x width 126.1 cm
artworks.description: This painting depicts a story from Greek antiquity. Orestes and Pylades (left) were caught trying to steal a statue of Diana from the temple (left background). One of them will have to die. At the altar, the friends argue over who will give his life for the other. Lastman’s densely composed compositions, his bright colours and the expressive gestures of his figures – all had an impact on the young Rembrandt.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 39.5 cm x width 34.2 cm
artworks.description: The types of fruit depicted here had been cultivated for thousands of years before they became known in the Netherlands. Grapes originated in Italy and Spain; peaches came from China; and melons from Persia, Southern Egypt, or India. Thanks to the global trade, newly introduced fruit made its way into the kitchens of affluent North European citizens, as well as into their still-life paintings.

artworks.title: View of the Dunes with the Ruins of Brederode Castle near Santpoort
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 70 cm x width 94.2 cm × depth 10 cm
artworks.description: The 17th-century landscapist Jacob van Ruisdael enjoyed painting views of Haarlem from the dunes. Schelfhout was inspired by Ruisdael’s work for this panorama of the dunes near Haarlem, with the ruins of Brederode Castle in the foreground. Not only did he paint in a 17th-century manner, this subject matter, the countryside around Haarlem, was also considered in the Romantic era to be ultra-Dutch and ‘historical’.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit and Vegetables, with Christ at Emmaus in the background
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 113 cm x width 200 cm × depth 10 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met vruchten en groenten met op de achtergrond Christus en de Emmaüsgangers. Op de voorgrond van een keuken liggen allerlei soorten groenten (asperges, tuinbonen, erwten, wortels, artisjokken, komkommers, bieten, een pompoen, groene kolen, uien en rapen) en fruit (appels, kersen, kruisbessen, abrikozen, peren, bessen, frambozen en druiven), in manden uitgestald. In de keuken zijn twee meiden aan het werk. Daarachter is door opgehaalde gordijnen het bijbelse tafereel te zien.

artworks.title: Summer
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: diameter 33.5 cm × sight size: diameter 32 cm × frame: height 43.6 cm x width 44.3 cm x depth 4 cm
artworks.description: Small round landscapes were in great demand among people who bought art. Van Goyen produced scores of them over the years. This little  painting not only depicts a village by the water, but also symbolizes summer. It accompanies a painting of winter, which is also on view in this  gallery.

artworks.title: The Doctor
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 49 cm x width 37 cm
artworks.description: De dokter. Staande in een venster bekijkt een dokter een flesje met urine. Voor hem staan op de vensterbank een metalen schaal, een sierkan en een medisch boek over de anatomie van de mens. Links achter de arts staat een vrouw met een emmer. Het venster is versierd met een reliëf met putti met een bok. Kopie naar het origineel van Dou in Wenen.

artworks.title: The Phoenix
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 112 cm x width 114 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: Cornelis Troost (1696 - 1750). The Phoenix. Dessus-de-porte.  Wall panel. Oak, painted white and gold. Paris, c. 1750 (?).

artworks.title: Landscape by Moonlight
artworks.artist: Aert van der Neer (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 31 cm x width 43 cm × outer size: depth 8 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Landschap bij maanlicht. Gezicht op een dorp aan het water. Aan de waterkant staan enkele koeien, rechts het dorp, links in de verte een molen. De maan schijnt door het wolkendek.

artworks.title: De Sirenen
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10 cm × height 67.8 cm x width 57.4 cm x thickness 3.2 cm
artworks.description: De Sirenen. Zwemmende en zittende naakte meisjes op de rotsen aan de oever van een zee, in de verte een schip met witte zeilen, in de lucht meeuwen.

artworks.title: The Lute Player
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 67 cm x width 60 cm
artworks.description: De nar. Lachende jongen met bonte kleding die op een luit speelt. Oude kopie naar het origineel in het Louvre te Parijs.

artworks.title: Windmills near Rotterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 43 cm x width 55 cm
artworks.description: Twee molens aan een vaart bij Rotterdam. Op de voorgrond een veerpontje, rechts wacht een moeder met kind, links een huis.

artworks.title: Old Woman Selling Eggs
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 11.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 76.5 cm x width 58 cm x thickness 4 cm (support incl. protective backboard)
artworks.description: De eierenkoopvrouw. Oude vrouw met een mand met eieren.

artworks.title: Portrait of Lysbeth van Duvenvoirde
artworks.medium: paint (coating), biological material, parchment (animal material), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 32 cm x width 20 cm × frame: height 42 cm x width 29.3 cm x thickness 5.9 cm
artworks.description: ‘Long have I yearned for the man who would open his heart.’ With these words, inscribed in Middle Dutch on the S-shaped banderole, Lysbeth van Duvenvoirde expressed her feelings for her husband. She was from a noble Dutch family and married the knight Simon van Adrichem in 1430. In this portrait she is wearing her wedding jewellery: a necklace, five rings, and a belt with little bells.

artworks.title: The Herepad in the Haagse Bos
artworks.artist: Paulus Constantijn la Fargue (signed by artist)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 23 cm x width 34 cm
artworks.description: La Fargue specialized in topographical views, that is, accurate illustrations of specific places. In this depiction of the Haagse Bos, a wooded area in The Hague, he depicted the main cart track at left, while giving centre stage to the Herepad – a footpath favoured by local residents.

artworks.title: Dune landscape
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 4 kg × depth 8.5 cm × height 21 cm x width 34 cm
artworks.description: Duinlandschap met op de voorgrond enige boerenhuizen en wat vee, aan de horizon enkele molens.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 73.1 cm x width 98 cm x thickness 2.8 cm × depth 4.8 cm
artworks.description: Heuvelachtig landschap. Links een dorp op een plateau.

artworks.title: Distant View of the Meadows at ’s-Graveland
artworks.artist: Pieter Gerardus van Os (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 111 cm x width 89.5 cm
artworks.description: At the time that Van Os made this painting and the one of the ’s-Graveland canal, not everyone was enthusiastic about such unadorned landscapes with their surprising perspectives. One critic even faulted Van Os for not rendering nature more beautifully. Now they are considered masterpieces of early 19th-century Dutch painting, precisely because of their modern and original vision of the landscape of Holland.

artworks.title: The Transept of the Mariakerk in Utrecht, Seen from the Northeast
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 7 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 58.8 cm x width 44.6 cm
artworks.description: Het transept van de Mariakerk te Utrecht, gezien vanuit het noordoosten. Op de voorgrond enkele bezoekers en bedelaars, waarvan sommigen op krukken.

artworks.title: Landscape with an Episode from the Conquest of America
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: height 86.5 cm x width 152.5 cm
artworks.description: Habsburg emperor Charles V reigned over a realm on which ‘the sun never set’. It encompassed much of Europe, including Spain and the Low Countries, parts of Central America and the Caribbean. This is the first painting to depict Spanish soldiers subduing the people who lived there. Mostaert added some elements to give his traditional European landscape an exotic ambience: a monkey, a porcupine and parrots.

artworks.title: ‘The Skaters’: Peasants in an Interior
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: frame: height 60.5 cm x width 52.2 cm x thickness 8.5 cm × support: height 44 cm x width 35.2 cm
artworks.description: Compared with the often ill-natured-looking drunkards of his teacher Adriaen Brouwer, the country folk in the paintings by Adriaen van Ostade are more mildmannered. They drink and smoke, but the atmosphere is generally peaceful. The pair of skates lying on the ground inspired the painting’s old, anecdotal title.

artworks.title: The Seven Works of Mercy
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 103.5 cm x width 56.8 cm
artworks.description: A Dutch city is the backdrop to this narrative that shows how a good Christian should help those in need. Christ stands among the spectators in almost every panel. The scenes give an impression of urban society around 1500. The work was badly damaged during the Iconoclasm of 1566, when Roman Catholic churches were vandalized by Protestants.

artworks.title: The Egyptian Widow
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 74.9 cm x width 99.1 cm
artworks.description: The Frisian artist Alma-Tadema was a great success in England, where he was even knighted. His representations of ancient Egyptian, Greek and Roman scenes made him one of the most popular 19th-century painters. In this picture, full of archaeological details, a woman is mourning beside the inner mummy case containing the body of her husband. His sarcophagus stands at left, while priests and singers lament the departed.

artworks.title: Pompeius Occo
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 66.5 cm x width 55.1 cm x height 65 cm x width 53.5 cm
artworks.description: Pompeius Occo developed into a key figure in the Northern European economy and was one of Amsterdam’s most prosperous residents. From around 1511, he represented the successful banking and trading house of the Augsburg Fuggers in this emerging metropolis. Occo’s portrait expresses the generally prevailing awareness that all worldly prosperity is transient. His left hand rests almost tenderly on a skull.

artworks.title: Portrait of Isabel Parreño y Arce, Marquise of Llano
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 161.3 cm x height 150 cm x width 113.7 cm x thickness 14 cm x thickness 8 cm × height 135 cm x width 98.5 cm
artworks.description:
This Spanish Marquise was a patron of the art and sciences from an early age. The castanets and mask in her hands refer to the dramatic arts and music, and the classical building behind her to architecture. Inspired by the traditional folk costume of her native
La Mancha, her attire demonstrates her pride in her homeland.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 167.5 cm x width 180 cm × weight 62 kg
artworks.description: This altarpiece, which originally had two wings, is dedicated to the adoration of the newborn baby Jesus by the three magi, each of whom was represented on one of the panels. This centre panel depicts only the oldest king.

artworks.title: Ships near the Coast in windy Weather
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.6 cm × height 28.7 cm x width 37 cm x thickness 1.1 cm
artworks.description: Schepen voor de kust bij flinke bries. Links een havenhoofd, op het water varen enkele kleinere schuiten en sloepen, in de verte liggen grotere schepen voor anker.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10 cm × height 30.2 cm x width 24 cm x thickness 1.3 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met vruchten (perzik, druiven, bramen en abrikozen) en bloemen (fuchsia en vergeet-mij-niet).

artworks.title: A Shepherdess
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 81.5 cm x width 64.5 cm
artworks.description:
This shepherdess comes straight out of Arcadia, a fairytale realm celebrated in 17th-century Dutch poems, inhabited by beautiful shepherds and shepherdesses. These verses glorified simple country life. Artists, including Paulus Moreelse, drew inspiration from
them. He painted several ‘Arcadian’ shepherds and shepherdesses, often semi-nude and adorned with flowers in their hair, like this rose-crowned shepherdess.

artworks.title: In the Orphanage at Katwijk-Binnen
artworks.artist: David Adolph Constant Artz (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 97 cm x width 130 cm
artworks.description: In het weeshuis te Katwijk-Binnen. Interieur met weesmeisjes aan het handwerken aan een tafel bij het raam. Aan de muur een klok.

artworks.title: Reclining Venus
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 116 cm x width 186 cm × weight 44 kg × depth 10.5 cm
artworks.description: Born in Amsterdam, Sustris spent most of his career in Italy. In Venice, he was a close associate of the leading painter Titian. In this work, Sustris used as a model one of Titian’s most celebrated paintings, the so-called Venus of Urbino, but he gave his figure an elegant, more mannered pose.

artworks.title: Mary Stuart, Princess of Orange, as Widow of William II
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 199.5 cm x width 170 cm
artworks.description: Princess of Orange Mary Stuart I is dressed in white, the traditional colour of mourning for a noble. Her husband, Stadholder William II, had died two years earlier. Mary was keen to secure the succession of her very young son. This portrait alludes to that claim to stadtholdership: she holds an orange, symbolizing the House of Orange. At the left is depicted the Stadtholders’ Gate of the Binnenhof (Inner Court) in The Hague.

artworks.title: Portrait of Elizabeth I, Queen of England
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.5 cm × height 34.5 cm x width 30.5 cm
artworks.description:
Elisabeth I, 1533-1603, koningin van Engeland. Door een onbekende Engelse schilder.
Deze grondlegster van de Engelse wereldmacht speelde een ondoorzichtig spel in haar politiek ten opzichte van de opstandige gewesten. Zij weigerde in 1585 de haar aangeboden souvereiniteit over de Republiek, maar na de val van Antwerpen zond zij geld en 5.000 man. Zij zond Leicester als bevelhebber, die door een eigen politiek zowel met zijn vorstin als met de Nederlanders in moeilijkheden kwam.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 41.2 cm x width 56.2 cm x thickness 1 cm × depth 3.2 cm
artworks.description: De aanbidding der koningen. Wintergezicht in een dorp, links de drie koningen bij de heilige familie in een stal, rechts de ruïne van een kerk.

artworks.title: Still Life with Flowers and Fruit
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.5 cm × height 91 cm x width 76 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met bloemen en vruchten. Op de voorgrond witte en blauwe druiven, perziken, pruimen, een meloen, frambozen en een tak Oostindische kers. Hierachter een siervaas versierd met spelende putti waarin wijnranken en druiven. Tussen het fruit zitten enkele vlinders .

artworks.title: Huisje aan een sloot
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 36 cm x width 49 cm × depth 12.1 cm × weight 9 kg
artworks.description: Enkele huizen aan het eind van een naar de achtergrond lopende sloot. Rechts enkele rijen bomen.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mertijntje van Ceters (1609-24)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 5.2 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 103.9 cm x width 76.5 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Mertijntje van Ceters (1609-24). Zuster van Johan van Ceters. Kniestuk, staande naar rechts. Handschoen in de rechterhand, een waaier in de linkerhand. Rechtsboven het familiewapen.

artworks.title: Aeneas Receiving a New Set of Armour from Venus
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 408 cm x width 413 cm
artworks.description: Aeneas ontvangt door voorspraak van Venus een nieuwe wapenrusting in de smidse van Vulcanus. In het midden knielt de held voor de godin. Een Cupido reikt hem de helm, vooraan liggen de andere delen van het harnas. Door de lucht buitelen putti, één met een lauwerkrans. Links werken vier smeden boven een vuur. Onderdeel van een groep van vijf werken vervaardigd voor het huis aan de Nieuwegracht 6 te Utrecht.

artworks.title: Winter in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 95 cm x width 192 cm
artworks.description: Winter te Amsterdam. Gezicht op de hoek Brouwersgracht - Korte Prinsengracht. Op de voorgrond enige schuiten.

artworks.title: A Violinist and a Flutist Playing Music together (The Musicians)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.2 cm × height 51 cm x width 41.5 cm
artworks.description: In een interieur maken een violist en een fluitist muziek. De twee muzikanten zijn gezeten aan een tafel waarop verschillende muziekboeken liggen; tegen een stoel staat een viola da gamba geleund.

artworks.title: The Shepherdess
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: sight size: height 110.5 cm x width 165.7 cm × support: height 114 cm x width 169 cm × frame: height 118.5 cm x width 173.5 cm
artworks.description: De herderin. Een herderin zit op de voorgrond met een kind op schoot. Het kind heeft een bosje bloemen in de hand en wijst naar zijn moeder. De vrouw wijst naar een zaaiende boer op een akker links op de achtergrond. Bij de figuren staan twee schapen en bokje en een hond.

artworks.title: Banquet Still Life
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 8.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 64.5 cm x width 115 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met pasteien, een taart, broodjes, schalen met bessen en druiven, fruit, glazen en een mes.

artworks.title: The Duet
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.7 cm × height 40.3 cm x width 35.6 cm x thickness 1 cm
artworks.description: Een meisje speelt op een citer en een heer op een violoncel.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Sciences
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 289 cm x width 161 cm
artworks.description: Textielmagnaat Philips de Flines was een ware kunstliefhebber. Zijn pand aan de Herengracht richtte hij in met een speciale kunstkamer, die hij liet decoreren door Gerard de Lairesse. De kunstenaar vervaardigde vijf schilderijen in zwart en wit - ‘grisailles’ - met verbeeldingen van positieve eigenschappen van De Flines. Het bevorderen van de wetenschappen was bijvoorbeeld een van de goede eigenschappen van een edelman.

artworks.title: Water Meadows on the River IJssel
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 27.2 cm x width 44 cm × weight 6 kg × depth 9.5 cm
artworks.description: In de uiterwaarden van de IJssel. Waterpartij met eenden en rietkragen. Links knotwilgen en weilanden met koeien.

artworks.title: Heraclitus
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 85.5 cm x width 70 cm
artworks.description: The Greek sage Heraclitus was known as the crying philosopher because he mourned the folly of mankind, while his opposite Democritus (the nearby pendant) could only laugh at it. Here Heraclitus looks like a melancholy old man. Downcast, he leans on a terrestrial globe and gestures dismissively with his left hand, as if to say: ‘All is for nought, the world will come to nothing.’

artworks.title: A Watermill
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 60.5 cm x width 85 cm
artworks.description: Hobbema learned to paint landscapes from Jacob van Ruisdael. While their works are similar in many respects, Hobbema’s paintings make a friendlier, lighter impression. Young tree tops stretch high up into the air, the foliage gleaming in the sun. A watermill that Hobbema had drawn in the eastern part of the Netherlands provided the subject of this painting.

artworks.title: Interior with a Mother Combing Her Child’s Hair, Known as ‘Maternal Care’
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 44.5 cm x width 38 cm x height 61 cm x width 53.5 cm x thickness 4.7 cm
artworks.description: These two children serve as examples of good and bad upbringing. Toys litter the floor in a dimly lit bedroom. A mother combs the long curls of her son, who obediently leans on her lap. Meanwhile, her daughter mischievously sticks out her tongue in the mirror – is it directed at her reflection or at the maid in the background?

artworks.title: Drie meisjes uit het Amsterdamse Burgerweeshuis
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 81.5 cm x width 96 cm
artworks.description: Drie meisjes uit het Amsterdamse Burgerweeshuis, één leest voor uit een boek terwijl een ander luistert en een ander bezig met verstelwerk is. Links een wasmand, rechts slaapt een kat op een bankje.

artworks.title: A Hunter’s Bag near a Tree Stump with a Magpie, Known as ‘The Contemplative Magpie’
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 215 cm x width 134 cm
artworks.description: Commissioned by King William III of Orange, d’Hondecoeter painted these two hunting still lifes for Soestdijk Palace. They hung facing one another in a corridor whereby the magpie in this painting ‘speaks’ to the peacock in the other one. Together they depict a fable in which the birds must choose a king. The magpie objects to the peacock. With its splendid plumage how can it effectively defend its fellow birds in times of peril?

artworks.title: De melkbocht
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 171 cm x width 115 cm × depth 6.5 cm
artworks.description: De melkbocht. Weidelandschap met koeien die door een boer langs een hek naar de melkbocht gedreven worden.

artworks.title: Winter Scene with the Sun Setting Behind Trees
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.5 cm × height 55.4 cm x width 92.8 cm x thickness 3 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met houten brug in winter. Rechts een bos, links een weide met hier en daar een boom.

artworks.title: Yellow Roses in a Carafe
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 11 cm × height 46.6 cm x width 34.3 cm x thickness 3.3 cm
artworks.description: Een boeket gele rozen in een karaf, daarachter een fles.

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Master of the Amsterdam Death of the Virgin
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.3 cm × support: height 57.5 cm x width 76.8 cm x height 56.6 cm (painted surface) x width 76.8 cm (painted surface)
artworks.description: In the late Middle Ages, the death of the Virgin was usually represented in a contemporary domestic set-ting. Gathered around her bed are the twelve apostles. At upper centre Peter is about to bless the dying Virgin with a holy water sprinkler, while others are praying and reading in preparation for her departure.

artworks.title: Kitchen Scene with the Parable of the Rich Man and Poor Lazarus
artworks.artist: attributed to Pieter Cornelisz. van Rijck
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 198 cm x width 272 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: Keukeninterieur met de gelijkenis van de rijke man en de arme Lazarus. In een keuken bereiden twee keukenmeiden een feestmaal. Links rijgt een meid een stuk vlees aan het spit, de andere meid heeft een koperen ketel in een hand en een dode haan in de ander. Uitgestald liggen stukken vlees, groente (kolen, rapen en wortels), gevogelte, een dode haas en vissen. Tussen de etenswaren blaft een hond naar een kat. Rechts een tafel waarop pasteien, kaas, brood, zilveren bekers en drinkschalen staan. Tegen de achterwand hangen kruiken aan een plank, op de plank staan borden en kandelaars. Rechts op de achtergrond de rijke man met zijn gezin aan een banket, bij de deur zit Lazarus op de vloer.

artworks.title: Prince Maurits, Accompanied by Prince Frederik Hendrik, Frederick V of Bohemia and his Wife Elizabeth Stuart, and Others, on the Buitenhof, The Hague
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 85 cm x width 117 cm
artworks.description: Prins Maurits in gezelschap van o.a. prins Frederik Hendrik, Frederik V en diens vrouw Elizabeth Stuart, koning en koningin van Bohemen, op het Buitenhof in Den Haag. Op de achtergrond het Hofvijver en het Binnenhof. Gezelschap te paard, met pages, officieren en honden.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with Waterfall
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 111 cm x width 99 cm
artworks.description: Berglandschap met een waterval tussen rotsen en boomstammen. De rivier stroomt door een dal tussen twee bergen waarop kastelen staan.

artworks.title: Cows at a pond
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 27 cm x width 35 cm × depth 7.8 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met koeien staande in een plas water bij een rij wilgen, rechts twee spelende kinderen.

artworks.title: Portrait of Magtilda Muilman
artworks.artist: Frans van der Mijn (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 210 cm x width 154.5 cm
artworks.description: Wearing a satin skirt and jacket trimmed with ermine tails, Magtilda Muilman gazes out confidently at the viewer. While her husband, Jan Pranger, is portrayed in the adjacent painting in his study overlooking the Elmina slave fort, Muilman finds herself in a more domestic setting, probably in their home on Amsterdam’s Singel Canal. The picture cabinet in the background features a portrait, possibly of one of Muilman’s ancestors.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Old Lady, possibly Elisabeth Bas
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 118 cm x width 91.5 cm × height 134 cm x width 106.5 cm
artworks.description: This portrait may depict Elisabeth Bas. Like many seafarers’ wives, Bas managed the provisioning of the fleet of her husband, Admiral Jochem Swartenhondt. Together with him, she also ran a distinguished inn, which she continued on her own after his demise. This painting was long attributed to Rembrandt, but it was painted in his style by one of his pupils, Ferdinand Bol.

artworks.title: Portraits of a Couple, possibly Pieter Gerritsz Bicker and Anna Codde
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 86.3 cm x width 66.5 cm × frame: height 101 cm x width 83.5 cm x thickness 5.5 cm
artworks.description: A man is working on his accounts, while a woman is seated at a spinning wheel. This pair of portraits was probably painted for the couple’s engagement or wedding. He is portrayed as a prudent merchant, she as a diligent housewife. These are two of the earliest portraits of Dutch citizens.

artworks.title: Meadow with Animals
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × height 96 cm x width 122 cm
artworks.description: Weide met vee. Weiland met grazende en rustende koeien en een jongen bij een geit en jonkies, links staan twee paarden onder bomen. In de verte meer weilanden met vee. Op de voorgrond eenden bij de waterkant.

artworks.title: Adriaan van der Hoop’s Trotter ‘De Rot’ at the Coach House
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 61 cm x width 54.5 cm
artworks.description: The prizewinning racehorse ‘De Rot’ wears a decorated bridle, and its tail is tied up and embellished with a rosette in the latest fashion à l’anglaise (in the English manner). In the coach house are no fewer than two carriages, one in fashionable yellow matching that of the horse-blanket on the animal’s back. The initials of its owner, Van der Hoop, are on the green bucket.

artworks.title: The Blauwpoort in Leiden in the Winter
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × height 90 cm x width 126 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op de Blauwpoort te Leiden in de winter. IJsvermaak op het ijs voor de poort: schaatsers, kolfspelers en sleden.

artworks.title: De Lauriergracht bij de Tweede Laurierdwarsstraat
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 41 cm x width 32.5 cm
artworks.description: De Lauriergracht bij de Tweede Laurierdwarsstraat. Bij de kruising van de twee straten loopt een vrouw met een kind op de arm.

artworks.title: Portraits of Sir Thomas Gresham and Anne Fernely
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 90 cm x width 75.5 cm
artworks.description: Sir Thomas Gresham (1519–1579) was the leading English merchant in Antwerp and also the English king’s financial agent in the Low Countries. He and his wife, Anne Fernely, are expensively, yet soberly dressed. Their status is also evident in their choice of painter: Anthonis Mor was one of the pre-eminent portraitists of his day and court painter to the Spanish king

artworks.title: Woman Reading Sheet Music
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 58.5 cm x width 57 cm x thickness 0.2 cm
artworks.description: A woman in a blue jacket is studying a sheet of paper with musical notes. Her lips are slightly parted. Could she be singing the melody? Light falls through a window at the left, right onto the paper. You often see this effect in paintings by the 17th-century artist Johannes Vermeer. He also frequently included the chairs, pearls and the jacket in his works. But did he also paint this Woman Reading Sheet Music?

artworks.title: The Dam in Amsterdam with the new Town Hall under Construction
artworks.artist: attributed to Jacob van der Ulft
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 81 cm x width 100 cm
artworks.description: Stadsgezicht met de Dam te Amsterdam met het nieuwe stadhuis in aanbouw, het Waaggebouw en de Nieuwe Kerk. Op de Dam en langs de kade verkopen handelaren hun waar.

artworks.title: Louis XIV Crossing into the Netherlands at Lobith
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 103 cm x width 159 cm
artworks.description: Leading a 120,000-strong army, the French king Louis XIV invaded the Netherlands on 12 June 1672. Glorifying Louis XIV, the Flemish painter Van der Meulen recorded the military manoeuvre. However, the artist took some liberties: at the time, the King – portrayed here on a grey horse – was actually staying at a nearby monastery.

artworks.title: Aeneas Crowning Cloanthus
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 218 cm x width 232 cm
artworks.description: Bol’s painting, made for the Amsterdam Admiralty, shows a scene from Virgil’s Aeneid. Aeneas congratulates one of four ships’ captains who competed in a race. All four were rewarded on their return, even the captain who threw his helmsman overboard for disobeying an order. The painting was accompanied by a poem by Vondel, stressing the importance of firmness and generosity in good government.

artworks.title: Portrait of La Duchessa Mancini Colonna (1646-1699)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 72.5 cm x width 62.5 cm × outer size: depth 6.7 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Portret ten halven lijve van Maria Mancini Colonna (1639-1715), prinses van Paliano en hertogin van Tagliacozzo.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: painted surface: height 48.5 cm x width 34 cm × thickness 1.3 cm × support: height 51 cm x width 36.5 cm
artworks.description: This painting ‘zooms in’ on the adoration of the magi to such an extent that, as a spectator, you feel almost present at the birth. The kings bring gifts for baby Jesus, who is not in a lowly stable, but in the ruins of a palace - that of King David, where, according to legend, Jesus was born many centuries later.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Little Boy, Possibly Louis of Nassau
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 90 cm x width 69 cm
artworks.description: This sitter is probably Louis of Nassau, an illegitimate son of Maurice. He is depicted wearing a gold medal bearing a portrait of his father. This medal was struck to celebrate the Capture of Grave in 1602. Louis was born at that time and is eighteen months old in this portrait. Did Maurice dedicate his victory to his youngest scion?

artworks.title: Pheasants
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.4 cm × height 99 cm x width 151 cm
artworks.description: Goudfazanten met kuikens en korhoenders in een landschap

artworks.title: Maria Theresa, Archduchess of Austria, Queen of Hungary and Bohemia, and Holy Roman Empress
artworks.medium: metal, inorganic material, materials by function, copper (metal), email
artworks.dimensions: height 62 cm x width 51 cm
artworks.description: Liotard made this enamel during a visit to Lyon, basing it on one of several portraits of the sovereign he had earlier done in Vienna. He was particularly proud of the ‘brilliance’ of the hard gem-like surface and colouring. It is one of the largest enamel paintings ever made, and the technique gave Liotard some difficulty: an inscription on the back records that this was the ‘second attempt.’

artworks.title: Autumn Day
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 19 cm x width 23 cm
