artworks.description: Najaarsdag. Landschap met struikgewas en enkele bomen onder een wolkenhemel. Een jager nadert met een hond.

artworks.title: Gold- and Silverfish in an Aquarium
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 32.5 cm x width 46 cm × depth 9.5 cm
artworks.description: Verschillende soorten vissen (goud- en zilvervisjes?) zwemmend in een aquarium.

artworks.title: Portrait of Hugo de Groot (1583-1645)
artworks.artist: workshop of Michiel Jansz van Mierevelt
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 63 cm x width 55 cm × outer size: depth 6.6 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Hugo de Groot (Grotius), copy after M.J. van Miereveld, 1631. In 1607 the internationally renowned jurist Hugo de Groot (1583-1645), known also by his Latinised name Grotius, published Mare liberum, in which he argued for free trade at sea. In a later work, De iure belli ac pacis (on the laws of war and peace) he laid what many consider to be the foundation of international law. Like Johan van Oldenbarnevelt, Hugo de Groot was arrested in 1618 after a confrontation with the stadholder, Prince Maurice. De Groot received a life sentence and was imprisoned in Loevestein castle. In 1621 he escaped and fled to France. During a short return to the Republic he posed for the painter Van Miereveld. This is one of the many copies of that portrait.

artworks.title: Isaac Blessing Jacob

artworks.dimensions: support: height 115.2 cm x width 140.2 cm × frame: height 141 cm x width 165.5 cm x depth 10 cm
artworks.description:
The Bible recounts how Jacob, pretending to be his brother Esau, tricked their blind father into bestowing Esau’s rightful blessing on him. The idea of imitating Esau’s hirsute arms by wearing animal-skin gloves came from their mother Rebecca, who looks on from behind the bed.
Flinck derived both this painting technique and narrative style from Rembrandt, by whom he was trained.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape with the Ponte Lucano over the Aniene River
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)

artworks.description: Jan Both (c. 1615 - 1652). Italian landscape with the Ponte Molle, c. 1650. The atmosphere of this idyllic landscape is typically Italian. The lush green of the trees and plants creates a lively impression, as does the small group of travellers by the river, bathed in warm sunlight. On the left we see the Ponte Molle, a well-known bridge in the Roman campagna. Both painted many of such scenes, in which a zigzag motion of river and roads leads the viewer's eye into the depths. On copper. Purchased in 1809, as part of the Van Heteren Gevers collection (The Hague)

artworks.title: Hunting and Fruit Still Life next to a Garden Vase, with a Monkey, Dog and two Doves, in the distance Rijksdorp near Wassenaar, Seat of Jacob Emmery, Baron of Wassenaar
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 172 cm x width 160 cm x depth 10 cm
artworks.description: Jan Weenix (1642 - 1719). Still life with the estate of Rijksdorp in the background, 1714. The game and the birds provide proof of a successful hunt. The estate in the background is the country house Rijksdorp, near Wassenaar. No doubt the painting was commissioned by the owner, Jonkheer Jacob Emmery van Wassenaer. Weenix was the son of Jan Baptist Weenix, a painter of landscapes and still lifes. The younger Weenix devoted himself mainly to hunt still lifes. He generally painted game and birds against the background of a garden-like landscape. Paintings of this sort were highly prized by wealthy art lovers; in this way outdoor life and the hunt could be enjoyed indoors as well. From 1800 in the National Konst-Gallery in Huis ten Bosch Palace in The Hague, the precursor of the Rijksmuseum.

Here, we see pollard willows at the right, and oaks next to them. The left foreground features a blooming lilac lining the path on which a herdsman drives his cattle. Ruisdael created depth by placing in the right foreground a bare pollard willow, accentuated by the erratic shape of its trunk and colour of its bark.

De Ruyter's glorious career as admiral brought him and his family social status in the Republic and abroad, as this family portrait shows. De Ruyter is holding his staff of office in his left hand. Around his neck is the insignia of the French Order of St. Michel. This was later added to the painting since he only received the chain from the French king, Louis XIV in 1666 (four years after completion of the painting). Seated next to De Ruyter is Anna van Gelder, his third wife. Extreme left is Engel, his son by an earlier marriage. Engel later became a vice-admiral, like his father.

artworks.title: Hollandse koopman met twee tot slaaf gemaakte mannen in heuvellandschap
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 48 cm x width 57.2 cm × depth 4.3 cm
artworks.description: Een Hollandse man en een Aziatische vrouw lopen naast elkaar, gevolgd door twee geboeide tot slaaf gemaakte mannen. De vrouw draagt een sarong en kebaja en houdt een doek in haar linkerhand. De man draagt een rode knielange jas die in Europa justaucorps wordt genoemd. De heel laag geplaatste zakken (zakkleppen) zijn typerend voor de mode in de vroege achttiende eeuw. De brede, teruggeslagen manchetten die dit soort jassen vaak hebben, ontbreken hier. De man draagt een ceintuur om zijn middel waaraan een kort zwaard hangt. Onder de jas draagt hij een lange indigokleurige broek met kousenbanden onder de knie. Verder draagt hij een hoed, halsdoek, een rattan wandelstok en als enige in het gezelschap schoenen, versierd met zilveren gespen. De twee tot slaaf gemaakte mannen dragen een omslagdoek om het middel, een van hen een omslagdoek en allebei een witte doek rondom het hoofd. Het is niet duidelijk of het om mannen van Afrikaanse of Aziatische oorsprong gaat. De stoet wordt afgesloten door drie Aziatische mannen die als bewakers van de tot slaaf gemaakte mannen optreden. De bewakers dragen blauwe kleding met aan de voorzijde een reeks knopen. Een kort zwaard hangt aan een leren ceintuur om hun middel. Een van de bewakers draagt een grote platte ronde zonnehoed en houdt een speer vast. De achterste bewaker wijst op iets dat achter het gezelschap ligt, mogelijk het huis op de achtergrond. Het gezelschap is afgebeeld in een tropisch berglandschap, mogelijk in Indonesië of India. Door de gezichten van de man en de vrouw is met een scherp voorwerp een kruis gekrast. Rondom is in donkergroen een kader geschilderd. In originele houten lijst.

To the left of the king: his brother Frederick and his son Alexander. To the right: his sons William and Henry. Delilah seduced Samson into telling her the secret of his superhuman strength, the source of which lay in his long hair. Lievens painted Samson asleep on Delilah’s lap. She hands a pair of scissors to the frightened man so that he can cut off Samson’s hair. In their early years, Lievens and Rembrandt – who shared a workshop – regularly looked at one another’s work. Rembrandt’s influence can be discerned in the
expressive rendering of the faces.

All of this proves him to be a master of Mannerism.

artworks.title: View of Batavia
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 14.8 kg × height 65.5 cm x width 84 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description:
Gezicht op Batavia, ca. 1650
Hendrick Jacobsz Dubbels 1620 - 1676
Gezicht vanuit zee op Batavia met Nederlandse schepen op de voorgrond. Tussen deze schepen vaart een Chinese jonk. Van de stad zelf zijn het stadhuis te zien met links daarvan de oude Hollandse kerk. De plaats van de bergen op de achtergrond, de sa;lak en gedeh, is gefantaseerd. Misschien heeft Dubbels zijn voorstelling ontleend aan een prent en de werkelijkheid aangepast aan een in zijn ogen fraaiere compositie.

artworks.title: Still Life

artworks.description: Two worlds meet in this painting: a crab from the Mediterranean lies next to a porcelain bowl from China. Before the 17th century, Chinese porcelain was rare in Europe. However, starting in 1602, the Dutch East India Company (VOC) began shipping large quantities of porcelain to the Netherlands and other parts of the world. Due to its high cost, a more affordable alternative soon emerged: Delftware.

artworks.title: Interior of the Oude Kerk in Delft
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 48.7 cm x width 40.2 cm
artworks.description: Gerrit Houckgeest specialized in church interiors and the use of perspective. With great attention to detail, he has here captured how the sunlight, pouring through the stained-glass windows, casts coloured dots on the column in the middle. The painted green curtain is a witty illusionistic device, imitating the 17th-century custom of protecting paintings from light and dust with a curtain.

artworks.title: The Famished People after the Relief of the Siege of Leiden
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)

artworks.description:
When a city is surrounded by enemies, its people find themselves in a tight corner. Food is scarce and disease easily breaks out. Reasons enough for Leiden to almost surrender in 1574. But the city is liberated by the Rebel army, the relief comes in the nick of time. Swarms of
famished and exhausted people await their liberators. The soldiers have brought food with them, mostly herring and white bread.

artworks.title: Christ on the Way to Calvary
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 73.9 cm x width 56 cm × outer size: depth 9.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Peter Paul Rubens (1577 - 1640). Christ Carrying the Cross, c. 1635. This quick sketch, painted with oil, is a design for a 5.5 metre high altarpiece made by Rubens between 1634 and 1637 for the Benedictine Abbey at Affligem in Flemish Brabant, and currently in a Brussels museum. Three oil sketches for the altar have survived. Rubens focused the viewer's attention on the centre of the composition. Jesus collapsing under the cross. Veronica wipes his face with a cloth. The figures are depicted in a diagonal composition that rises from the prisoners below right to the soldiers top left. This arrangement enabled Rubens to group the various characters in a convincing whole, creating a suggestion of movement and depth. Purchased in 1809, from the collection Van Heteren Gevers (The Hague).

artworks.title: A Town Gate in Leerdam

artworks.dimensions: height 77 cm x width 104 cm
artworks.description: Weissenbruch was partial to small Dutch towns where the 17th century was still palpable. The degree of detail in this townscape suggests that he painted it from life. However, because the exterior of the gate was more interesting, he simply turned it around. Moreover, the moment he portrayed was not chosen randomly. The sun shines brightly again after a rain shower, bathing everything in a crisp light.

artworks.description: Around 1810, Bonebakker and Bennewitz were the leading Amsterdam silversmiths. De Lelie portrayed both men in a domestic setting with Bonebakker’s wife, his five daughters and his only son. The family is drinking tea, presumably in their house on the corner of the Herengracht and the Reguliersgracht. Bennewitz holds a so-called chestnut vase, similar to the ones in the display case in this gallery.

From 1580, at the initiative of William of Orange, the old militia guilds were refashioned into civic guards organized along military lines. The officers were recruited from the upper levels of society. The dark muzzled dog at right contrasts comically with the jaunty little lapdog at centre jumping up on its owner’s legs.

artworks.description: Corot belonged to the Barbizon School, which was so widely admired by Hague School artists. Around 1840 several artists settled in the village of Barbizon. They worked en plein air (in the open air) and lived among the peasants. Corot made this painting after a trip to Les Landes, a region south of Bordeaux. It was thus formerly entitled Souvenir de Les Landes.

artworks.title: Rudolphina Wilhelmina Elizabeth de Sturler (1798-1873), second Wife of Count Johannes van den Bosch, with their Son Richard Leeuwenhart
artworks.artist: attributed to workshop of Cornelis Kruseman
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 12.5 cm × height 87 cm x width 70 cm
artworks.description: Cornelis Kruseman (1797 - 1857). Rudolphina Whilhelmina Elizabeth de Sturler (1798 - 1873), second wife of Count Johannes van den Bosch, with their son Richard Leeuwenhart.

artworks.title: Still life with fish
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 65.6 cm x width 78.9 cm x thickness 3.8 cm × depth 9.5 cm
artworks.description: Visstilleven. Stilleven met verschillende soorten vis (karper, baars) uitgestald op een visnet op de hoek van een tafel. Op de achtergrond een hengel met lijn en dobber en een emmer.

artworks.title: The Raree-show (’t Fraay Curieus)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 58 cm x width 49 cm
artworks.description: The old Dutch title (in parentheses) refers to the cries ‘beautiful!’ (fraai) and ‘extraordinary!’ (curieus) with which itinerant performers announced themselves. Here a performer shows a wooden triptych with characters from a chivalric romance, while undoubtedly recounting the tale to those gathered around. Willem van Mieris was a ‘fine painter’, meaning that he rendered the scene in a highly detailed and refined manner. The painting is actually also a kind of peepshow.

artworks.title: Cow
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 22.2 cm x width 28.8 cm x thickness 1 cm × depth 8.3 cm
artworks.description: Studie van een bonte koe, staande bij een paal in een weide.

artworks.title: The Night School
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.1 cm × height 60 cm x width 52 cm
artworks.description: De avondschool. Interieur met een klas van de avondschool bij kaarslicht. Leerlingen staan in de rij om hun werk door de schoolmeester te laten nakijken. Op de voorgrond rechts is een jongen aan het schrijven of tekenen, op de vloer staat een lantaarn.

artworks.title: Grapes, Flowers and Animals
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 65 cm x width 53 cm × depth 8.8 cm
artworks.description: Wijnranken met zware druiventrossen en enkele andere soorten fruit hangen laag bij de grond aan de oever van een water. Vogels pikken aan de druiven, een vis steekt zijn kop uit het water. Op de achtergrond laden twee mannen een bootje.

artworks.title: Shipwreck off a Rocky Coast
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 64.5 cm x width 85.2 cm (oval)
artworks.description: Those who went to sea played roulette with their lives. The wooden ships were small and fragile, and the very real dangers were exaggerated with horror stories of hideous creatures living in the unfathomable depths. Willaerts created an image of every seaman’s worst nightmare. One ship has been dashed on the rocks, and the other two are heeling over. The survivors at centre are threatened by a monstrous fish.

artworks.title: Interior with Woman Sewing
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 34.4 cm x width 29.3 cm
artworks.description: ‘The devil finds work for idle hands’ is the essence of the Dutch ethic of piety and hard work. As epitomised in this scene: a sober interior with a woman sewing a hem and at the same time reading a book. A thick volume of the Dutch authorised translation of the Bible lies on a folded tablecloth, ready to be opened. Meanwhile, a dog with a ball of wool is about to break her silent concentration.

artworks.title: Landscape with fields
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 33 cm x width 66 cm × depth 13 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met akkervelden, aan de horizon links een molen en rechts een groep bomen.

artworks.title: Portrait of Emma Jane Hodges
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 77 cm x width 62 cm
artworks.description:
This portrait of Emma Jane Hodges was painted by her father when she was about 20 years old. The striking contrast between the dark cloudy sky and her white collar draws attention to her face. The Hodges family hailed from England; the open-air setting of the
portrait exudes an English style. Emma Jane took care of her father and bequeathed this likeness together with his self-portrait to the Rijksmuseum.

artworks.title: The Married Couple Abraham Casteleyn and Margarieta van Bancken
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 83 cm x width 106.5 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: The married couple Margarieta van Bancken and Abraham Casteleyn, founder of the Haerlemse Courant (Haarlem Newspaper), operated In de Blije Druck, the city’s printing shop. The books, atlas, and globe refer to their profession and knowledge. After Abraham’s death, Margarieta continued the printing house, taking on the administrative and financial responsibilities. The bust in the background represents the Haarlem townsman L.J. Coster, long credited with having invented book printing.

artworks.title: The Grand Canal with the Rialto Bridge and the Fondaco dei Tedeschi
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 62 cm x width 83 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Studio of Antonio Canale, called Canaletto (1697 - 1768). The Grand Canal with the Rialto Bridge and the Fondaco dei Tedeschi. J.W. Edwin vom Rath bequest, 1941.

artworks.title: Portrait of Philippus Baldaeus and Gerrit Mossopotam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 141 cm x width 176 cm × thickness 9 cm
artworks.description:
Philippus Baldaeus was active as a minister for the VOC on Ceylon (Sri Lanka) from 1654 to 1665. Back in the Netherlands, he had this picture painted to commemorate his years of service overseas. The seated Baldaeus wears clothing he brought with him from Asia. He is probably joined here by Gerrit Mossopotam, who resided with Baldaeus in the Netherlands and may
have assisted him in translating Christian texts.

artworks.title: Kitchen Scene
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × height 92 cm x width 215 cm
artworks.description: Keukenstuk met verschillende personen temidden van groenten, vruchten, brood, gevogelte en vis. Vooraan een hond, op de achtergrond een spinnende vrouw bij de haard.

artworks.title: The Night School
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10 cm × height 64 cm x width 50 cm
artworks.description: Interieur van een avondschool. Een moeder met een lantaarn brengt haar zoontje naar school. In het midden de meester achter zijn lessenaar. Rechts leerlingen bij kaarslicht bezig met lezen. Links twee jongens bij een kachel.

artworks.title: A Hermit
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: width 27.5 cm × depth 4.1 cm × height 34.4 cm x height 33.5 cm x width 28.2 cm
artworks.description: Een kluizenaar. Oude man met een bril mediterend met een kruisbeeld. Op een tafel liggen een opengeslagen boek, rozenkrans en zandloper.

artworks.title: Landscape in Brazil
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.1 cm × height 66 cm x width 88 cm
artworks.description: After a stay in Brazil, Frans Post returned to his native Haarlem. He would spend the rest of his life there producing paintings based on sketches of the landscape and animals he had made in South America. In most of his work the animals appear to live together in harmony, but not in this canvas: a boa constrictor in the left foreground is devouring a six-banded armadillo.

artworks.title: Vanitas Still Life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8 cm × height 107 cm x width 90 cm
artworks.description: Cornelis Brisé (1622 - 1665/70). Vanitas still life, 1665. Presented by Dr A. Bredius, 1885.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman, probably Maria Schuurman (1575-1621)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 114 cm x width 83.5 cm × outer size: depth 4.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Portret van een jonge aanzienlijke vrouw, waarschijnlijk Maria Schuurman (1575-1621). Kniestuk, staande bij een tafeltje waarop de rechterhand met zakdoek rust. Om de middel een ketting met een hanger.

artworks.title: Assault on the Town of Coevorden, 30 December 1672
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.7 cm × height 65.5 cm x width 80.5 cm
artworks.description: Van Groningen uit trok een krijgsmacht met ‘biesbruggen, leeren, mookers, koevoeten, breekijzers, handt-granaaten en ander storm-gereetschap’ eind december naar Coevorden. De vesting werd mede dank zij mist en bevroren grachten in een uur heroverd. Een aantal soldaten dragen bosjes stro op hun hoed als herkenningsteken bij de bestorming.

artworks.title: Old Woman Meditating
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 27.3 cm x width 23.2 cm
artworks.description: An elderly woman sits with a book on her lap, having removed her pince-nez. Perhaps she is taking a momentary pause, or has she dozed off? Her pale, wrinkled face, hands, and the white pages stand out against the darkness. Thus Metsu emphasized the subject: the study of devotional texts, with a focus on the transience of life.

artworks.title: Overschie in the Moonlight
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9 cm × height 22 cm x width 27.5 cm
artworks.description: Rivierlandschap te Overschie bij maneschijn. Rechts een aangemeerde schuit met twee figuren, links een kerktoren.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Officer
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 55.3 cm x width 47.7 cm × outer size: depth 6.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Portret van een officier. Buste naar rechts, met een sjerp en kanten kraag over het borstharnas. Zie ook het portret door Van Ravesteyn: SK-A-4191.

artworks.title: Landscape with Fishermen and Farmers Extracting Peat in a Marsh
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: weight 1 kg × height 28.4 cm x width 37.6 cm × depth 4.4 cm
artworks.description: Here, peat –an important source of fuel –is being extracted from below the water table, a common technique in the west and north of the Netherlands. The man in the little boat dredges the peat from the water; it is then spread out on the ground. The woman in the distance stamps the peat drying in the sun into a hard mass. This is subsequently cut with a spade into easy-to-use blocks, which are then left to dry out fully.

artworks.title: Joyful Entry of the Duke of Anjou in Antwerp on 19 February 1582
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × height 61.5 cm x width 82.5 cm
artworks.description: When Philip II is no longer recognized as the Low Countries’ sovereign, a new ruler is needed. François, Duke of Anjou, and the brother of the French king, is willing to take on this task. He is officially installed in Antwerp at the beginning of 1582. Here he is shown riding under a baldachin, approaching a triumphal arch erected in his honour. He solemnly promises to uphold all of the laws, however his regime is  doomed to fail.

artworks.title: Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 68 cm x width 101 cm
artworks.description: De vlucht naar Egypte. De heilige familie wordt in een boot door een engel een rivier overgezet. Een putto helpt de boot van de kant afduwen, in de lucht twee cherubijnen. De ezel bevindt zich ook in de boot.

artworks.title: God Holds Adam and Eve Responsible
artworks.medium: plant material, paint (coating), biological material, wood (plant material), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 55.7 cm x width 41.1 cm x depth 4 cm x height 68 cm x width 54 cm
artworks.description: God roept Adam en Eva in het Paradijs ter verantwoording. Rechts twee leeuwen, links een konijn.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl, Known as ‘The Little Princess’
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 7.3 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 78 cm x width 62.5 cm x thickness 3.8 cm
artworks.description:
This young girl is portrayed at her most beautiful, in her finest dress and bedecked with jewels, for which she was dubbed ‘the little princes.’ In the 17th century children were represented as small adults. Not only are her clothes a copy of women’s fashion, but her regal pose also makes a very grown-up impression. Paulus Moreelse received numerous commissions from the circles around the stadholder’s court, which
favoured a conservative, classic portrait style.

artworks.title: Portrait of William I. Prince of Orange, called William the Silent
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 47 cm x width 32.5 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Willem I, graaf van Nassau, prins van Oranje.

artworks.title: Old Woman Reading
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.5 cm × height 34.5 cm x width 28.5 cm
artworks.description: Studie van een lezende oude vrouw, gezeten in een stoel. Links een tafel waarop een bril ligt.

artworks.title: Catharina Annette Fraser (1815-92)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.7 cm × height 72.4 cm x width 61.9 cm x thickness 3.2 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Catharina Annette Fraser, gehuwd met Cazaux van Staphorst en daarna met Cornelis Herman Baron van Pallandt. Buste, en face. Op de achtergrond een landschap, rechts klimop.

artworks.title: Old Woman Reading
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.4 cm × height 25 cm x width 20.4 cm
artworks.description: Een oude vrouw lezend in een dik boek (een bijbel?) bij kaarslicht, met een bril op de neus.

artworks.title: The Bookshop and Lottery Agency of Jan de Groot in the Kalverstraat in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 38.5 cm x width 33.5 cm
artworks.description: A group of men fight to enter the lottery agency. It is the start of the sale of the Generaliteitsloterij (Generality Lottery), forerunner of the still  existing Staatslotterij (State Lottery). Hotel guests at either side look on amused, including a Black man (left). His presence was not unusual. More Black people lived in Amsterdam in the late 18th century than in the previous century.

artworks.title: Portrait of Magdalena de Cuyper
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 152 cm x width 118 cm
artworks.description: Magdalena de Cuyper is portrayed as a widow, with a black cap, a prayer book, and a flowering tulip. The latter two objects symbolize her piety, and transience. She and her husband had a successful silk cloth business, which Magdalena continued to run after his death. The style of her portrait is the same as that of those of her son and daughter-in-law. After her death, they hung the portrait along with theirs.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry and Ernst Casimir of Nassau-Dietz at the Siege of ’s Hertogenbosch
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 47.1 cm x width 63.1 cm
artworks.description:
Prince Frederick Henry and his cousin Count Ernst Casimir pose triumphantly on their horses before
’s-Hertogenbosch. Frederick Henry points his commander’s staff at the Habsburg-occupied city now being stormed by Dutch forces. It was not for nothing that he was nicknamed ‘the conqueror of cities’. He captured a series of cites from the Spanish. The retaking of ‘s-Hertogenbosch in 1629 was one of the most important.

artworks.title: Ratification of the Peace of Münster between Spain and the Dutch Republic in the Town Hall of Münster, 15 May 1648
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.8 cm × height 46 cm x width 60 cm
artworks.description: Gerard ter Borch was op 15 mei 1648 in het raadhuis van Munster aanwezig bij de bekrachtiging van het vredesverdrag tussen Nederland en Spanje. Links: de Nederlandse delegatie. Rechts: de Spaanse gezanten. De katholieke Spanjaarden zwoeren met de rechterhand op het kruis en de bijbel. De protestantse Nederlanders staken wijs- en middelvinger omhoog. Op tafel: de kistjes met de vredesverdragen voor beide partijen.

artworks.title: The Music Lesson
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 64.4 cm x width 70.4 cm x depth 6.5 cm × height 47 cm x width 53 cm
artworks.description:
Two women are rehearsing a duet for guitar and voice under the guidance of a music teacher. Given that women were not supposed to become professional musicians at that time, they usually received musical training in the home. Recitals also took place there.
Wind instruments were not considered suitable for women, but singing, or playing the piano, harp and guitar were.

artworks.title: Koeien
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 13 cm × height 40 cm x width 53 cm
artworks.description: Een groepje grazende koeien in een weiland, links een sloot.

artworks.title: Woman at a Window
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 36.8 cm x width 28.7 cm × depth 10.3 cm
artworks.description: Een vrouw zittend aan een raam. Zittend voor een gordijn, naar links gewend, met de handen op de knieën. Door het venster uitzicht op zee.

artworks.title: Still Life with Pig's Head, Pig's Knuckles and Sausage
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 55 cm x width 72 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met een varkenskop op een aardewerken bord, enkele varkenspootjes en verschillende strengen worst op een bord en in een pot.

artworks.title: Portrait of Rutger Jan Schimmelpenninck and Catharina Nahuys with their Children
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 263.5 cm x width 200 cm
artworks.description: For nearly seven years, Rutger Schimmelpenninck promoted the interests of the Batavian Republic in Paris and London. As a patriot, he championed democracy. He and his wife Catharina Nahuys formed a successful ambassadorial duo. The portrait demonstrates their closeness and their love for nature and their children, Catharina and Gerrit. Initially, Catharina leaned on her husband’s shoulder with both arms in a more intimate pose, which the artist adjusted while painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of Feyntje van Steenkiste
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 121.9 cm x width 91.5 cm × outer size: depth 9.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Feyntje van Steenkiste hailed from a prosperous family active in the Haarlem textile industry, a connection shared by her husband Lucas de Clercq and his family. Their union strengthened the business ties between their respective families. Van Steenkiste’s wealth and Mennonite faith are evident in her clothing choices: elegant, yet sober. For example, in contrast to many of her more lavishly attired contemporaries, her wrists are adorned with just a hint of delicate white lace.

artworks.title: The Rapenburg in Leiden
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 94.5 cm x width 125.5 cm
artworks.description: On 12 January 1807 a ship laden with 37,000 pounds of gunpowder exploded in the centre of Leiden. It was a national disaster: 150 people died and many houses were destroyed. King Louis Napoleon, shown at left among Leiden city officials, acted like a true father to his subjects. Three days after the explosion, he visited the scene and organized financial help. This made him very popular with the Dutch.

artworks.title: Portrait of Jan Valckenburgh and an Enslaved Servant
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: length 128.3 cm x width 102 cm
artworks.description: Jan Valckenburgh, married to Dina Lems (opposite), twice served as director-general of Elmina (in present-day Ghana), seen here in the distance. The young man standing behind him is one of the numerous individuals brought to Elmina by African traders in order to be sold to the Dutch. At Fort Elmina, this human trafficking was organized and coordinated by the Dutch West India Company (WIC). In total, the Dutch transported 550,000 Africans to the Americas and the Caribbean.

artworks.title: Ships after the Battle
artworks.artist: Willem van de Velde (I) (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: textile materials, materials by function, canvas, ink
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.7 cm × width 114.5 cm × height 84.1 cm x thickness 3.5 cm
artworks.description: Ships after a battle, by Willem van de Velde I, 1653. Battle-scarred Dutch ships have returned to harbour after an encounter with the English. Torn flags and broken masts bear witness to the engagement. The ship flying the striped flags with a cross in the corner is a captured enemy craft. As soon as they were repaired these vessels would be sent back into the fray.

artworks.title: A spaniel
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 18 cm x width 20 cm × depth 9.5 cm
artworks.description: Een patrijshond, op de achtergrond een landschap met een jager te paard met honden.

artworks.title: A St Bernard Dog
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 187.6 cm x width 256.6 cm x depth 9.8 cm × height 179 cm x width 248 cm x thickness 4 cm
artworks.description: Een sint-bernardshond, staand in een landschap, met in de verte bergen.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry, his Consort Amalia of Solms, and their Three Youngest Daughters
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 263.5 cm x width 347.5 cm × weight 91 kg
artworks.description:
Amalia commissioned this painting for the palace of Huis ten Bosch. It hung next to portraits of her eldest, already married children, William II and his English bride, Mary, and Louise Henriette and Frederick William I of Brandenburg. Judicious marriages of state consolidated the position of the House of Orange among the other European royal families. Their three youngest daughters would marry German princes.
Through them, Amalia’s love of Asian luxury was disseminated throughout Europe.

artworks.title: Church Interior
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.6 cm × height 55 cm x width 42.5 cm
artworks.description: Kerkinterieur. Interieur van een kerk waarin twee werkmannen rusten van hun werkzaamheden aan een grafsteen in de vloer van de kerk.

artworks.title: Vanitas Still Life
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 54 cm x width 71 cm × depth 6.5 cm
artworks.description: Vanitas stilleven. Op een tafel liggen een viool, een kruisbeeld, een schedel, bloemen, een roemer, een document met lakzegels, boeken, een inktstel en een globe.

artworks.title: Self-portrait
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 103 cm x width 83 cm
artworks.description: As a former actor and scene painter, Troost understood illusion. In this self-portrait he gazes from a mirror at himself and at us. The curtain, pedestal, palette and drawing on blue paper create a sense of depth. Every detail testifies to his technical skill. Notice how he conveyed the fine batiste cloth of his fashionable jabot – the frill of ruffles attached to his shirt – with a single stroke of white paint.

artworks.title: View of the Merwede off Dordrecht
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 55.5 cm x width 72 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op de Merwede voor Dordrecht. In de verte de toren van de Grote Kerk en verschillende molens op de stadswallen. Nabij de oever op de voorgrond halen vissers hun netten binnen, op het water varen allerlei kleine roeiboten en zeilschepen.

artworks.title: The Jolly Drinker
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: sight size: height 87 cm x width 81.5 cm × support: height 88.2 cm x width 87.9 cm × outer size: height 107.7 cm x width 103 cm x depth 8 cm
artworks.description: This drinker shows off his empty jug, his cheeks flushed from alcohol. Judith Leyster, Haarlem’s only female master painter, was known for these kinds of paintings. Stylistically similar to the work of her fellow townsman Frans Hals, the painting was long attributed to him. Her monogram was not discovered until 1893, located above the jug on the right: JL with a star.

artworks.title: Portrait of Cornelia Cornelisdr van Esch
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 15.8 cm x width 12.8 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Cornelia, dochter van Cornelis Samuelsz. van Esch en Josina Jansdr. de Carpentier. Ten halven lijve, iets naar links. Onderdeel van een serie van zeven ovale portretten van Cornelis Samuelsz van Esch, zijn vrouw Josina Jansdr de Carpentier, hun drie dochtertjes en twee zoontjes (SK-A-1747-A/G).

artworks.title: Anthony van Dyck wooing his Model
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 58 cm x width 47.5 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: In zijn atelier knielt de schilder Anthonie van Dijck verliefd voor zijn model. Links het schilderij waar de vrouw voor poseert, rechts een tafel met een kruik, kaas en een bord.

artworks.title: Portrait of Willem II (1626-1650), Prince of Orange, and his Wife Mary Stuart (1631-1660)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 302 cm x width 194.3 cm × outer size: height 320 cm x width 212.5 cm x depth 12 cm (support incl. frame) × hanging system: height 299 cm x width 203 cm × overall: weight 110 kg
artworks.description: Portret van Willem II, prins van Oranje, met zijn echtgenote Maria Stuart. Beiden zijn ten voeten uit voorgesteld, staande op een balkon. De prins in wapenrusting met commandostaf in de rechterhand. In het gordijn linksboven spelen vier putti, twee met de helm van de prins, één strooit met bloemen. Behoort bij de portretten: SK-A-874 en SK-A-873.

artworks.title: Self-portrait as St John the Baptist
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, tempera, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 90 cm x width 68 cm × depth 7.5 cm
artworks.description: Willink’s lean body and the bare landscape lend this painting an ominous atmosphere. On the eve of the Second World War (1939-1945) Willink portrayed himself as John the Baptist, the prophet who preached virtue and righteousness and who considered baptism as salvation from all sins. With this internalized selfportrait, Willink seems to want to ward off the menace and turmoil of the times.

artworks.title: Satire on the Trial of Johan van Oldenbarnevelt
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outersize: depth 7.8 cm (support incl. SK-L-1474) × support: height 63 cm x width 85.7 cm
artworks.description: In 1619, Grand Pensionary Johan van Oldenbarnevelt was accused of high treason and sentenced to death by a special court. Prince Maurits was suspected of involvement, with speculation of a sham trial. Saftleven portrayed the judges as ferocious animals menacing the elderly Oldenbarnevelt. Inscribed on the paper is ‘Trucidata Innocenta’ (murdered innocence), referring to a scathing play about the trial by Joost van den Vondel, a supporter of Oldenbarnevelt.

artworks.title: Cisterspelende vrouw
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 58 cm x width 47 cm × height 73 cm x width 58 cm x depth 4 cm
artworks.description: Een zittend vrouw spelend op de cister. Zij wordt weerspiegeld in de spiegel op de muur achter haar. Links het raam, rechts een tafeltje waarop een schaal met fruit staat. Geschilderd in de trant van Johannes Vermeer.

artworks.title: Johanna and the Jewish Merchants
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 68.5 cm x width 86 cm
artworks.description: Troost depicted a scene from the popular farce The Spendthrift or the Wasteful Woman. The central character, Johanna, wastes her new expensive finery on two Polish-Jewish traders, portrayed in a stereotypical manner. In reality, they are Johanna’s father and husband, who have disguised themselves in order to expose her. Perched on the chair at the left, amidst a variety of Chinese valuables, is a ring-tailed lemur from Madagascar.

artworks.title: Birth of Christ
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 45.3 cm x width 34.8 cm × depth 4.2 cm
artworks.description: De geboorte van Christus. Maria, drie engelen en een stichter (of Jozef?) knielen in aanbidding bij het Christuskind dat op de mantel van Maria op de grond van de stal ligt. In het landschap op de achtergrond de verkondiging aan de herders.

artworks.title: Flowers in a Vase
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 118 cm x width 105 cm x thickness 2.5 cm × height 126.6 cm x width 113.6 cm x depth 9.8 cm
artworks.description: Decoratiestuk met een boeket bloemen in een vaas versierd met een portret, staande op een voetstuk waarbij ook wat fruit ligt. Mogelijk een dessus-de-porte.

artworks.title: Huisje aan de zandweg
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 10 kg × depth 12 cm × height 37 cm x width 50.5 cm
artworks.description: Een huis met schuur aan een zandweg bij de hei. Voor het huis staat een man achter een paard met wagen.

artworks.title: Flower Painter Maria van Oosterwijck
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 96 cm x width 77.8 cm
artworks.description: Maria van Oosterwijck is portrayed here as a pious and accomplished artist. The palette and brushes allude to her profession, while the Bible symbolizes her virtue and piety. Van Oosterwijck’s flower still lifes garnered her fame at home and abroad. Her work could be found in the art collections of Emperor Leopold I, Louis XIV, and the English royal couple William III and Mary Stuart.

artworks.title: Old Woman Reading
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 79 cm x width 70.5 cm × outer size: depth 10.5 cm (support incl. SK-L-1266)
artworks.description: Jan Lievens (1607 - 1674). Old woman r eading, c. 1627. Between 1625 and 1630 Lievens worked closely with his friend Rembrandt. They were constantly trying to outdo each other, but each was always ready to borrow the other's new techniques. This painting by Lievens bears a close resemblance to Rembrandt's work dating from the same period. Purchased in 1978.

artworks.title: Self Portrait, The so-called 'Portrait of Jan Fabus'
artworks.medium: paint (coating), paper, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 8.1 cm x width 7.2 cm × height 9.3 cm x width 8.3 cm x depth 0.4 cm × height 8.9 cm x width 7.9 cm x depth 0.5 cm × height 16.7 cm x width 15.5 cm x depth 2.7 cm
artworks.description: Klein zelfportret van Moses ter Borch, bekend als het portret van Jan Fabus.

artworks.title: Shrove Tuesday in the Country
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 72.1 cm x width 93 cm × sight size: height 68 cm x width 90.5 cm
artworks.description: Boerenvastenavond. Een stoet van verklede lieden trekt over een stenen brug in een dorp. Op de voorgrond twee vechtende boeren, links enkele figuren op het ijs.

artworks.title: Corner of a Garden with Nasturtiums
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.4 cm × height 51 cm x width 70.5 cm
artworks.description: Unlike the early 19th-century works in the adjacent display cases, this painting does not show a landscape but rather an impression of nature. In the late 19th century, some painters sought more personal ways of depicting nature. They turned their attention to an intimate landscape, namely the garden. Gardens were associated with well-being and constituted a safe place.

artworks.title: The Garden and Coach House of 524 Keizersgracht in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 53 cm x width 63.5 cm
artworks.description: Nicolaas Doekscheer, the occupant of 524 Keizersgracht, had a lavish Rococo-style coach house built in back of his garden. He and his partner Hendrik Steenbergen, both pictured, financed fifteen plantations in Berbice, Demerary and Essequebo (all three part of presentday Guyana, South America). Their loans enabled plantation owners there to set up their coffee, cotton and sugar businesses. In turn, the interest went to Doekscheer and Steenbergen in Amsterdam.

artworks.title: Frolicking on a Frozen Canal in a Town
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 7 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 47 cm x width 86.8 cm
artworks.description: Jan van de Velde II (1593 - 1641). Frolicking on a frozen canal in a town, c. 1620. The frozen canal beyond the city walls of Haarlem is bustling with activity. It is as if all the inhabitants have turned their back on the city and are busy skating, sledding or playing kolf, a game involving a ball and sticks. Van de Velde has portrayed the various forms of winter fun in great detail: on the right a gentleman is adjusting the skates of his richly attired partner, nearby someone else takes a tumble and, on a lighter note, the man on the left is relieving himself. Purchased in 1884.

artworks.title: Nimf
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 12.4 cm × height 65.2 cm x width 93.3 cm x thickness 3.8 cm
artworks.description: Nimf. Een jonge naakte vrouw, zittend in het gras bij de waterkant, de linkerhand voor de ogen.

artworks.title: Portrait of Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: lijst: height 22.6 cm x width 19.8 cm × support: height 16.4 cm x width 14 cm
artworks.description:
Karel V, 1500-1558. Copie naar een verloren portret door J. C. Vermeyen. Omstreeks 1525.
Karel V aanvaardde als 15-jarige het bewind over de Nederlanden, werd in 1516 koning van Spanje en erfde in 1519 alle Habsburgse bezittingen en werd tot keizer van Duitsland gekroond. Zijn titulatuur noemt hem ook: 'koning van de Indische eilanden, alsmede van het vaste land aan gene zijde van de Oceaan en heer van Azië en Afrika'.

artworks.title: Portrait of Raden Syarif Bustaman Saleh
artworks.artist: attributed to Friedrich Carl Albert Schreuel
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10.5 cm × height 106.7 cm x width 85.3 cm
artworks.description: Raden Saleh, scion of a Javanese regent family, came to the Netherlands in 1829 to study painting. Here we still see him as a European dandy before a Western seascape. However, he soon specialized in oriental scenes, and began dressing as a Javanese prince. Back on Java (1851), Raden Saleh built a small neo-Gothic palace, where he received the European elite. And so he constantly shifted between his Javanese and his European identity.

artworks.title: The Lady Drummer
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 100 cm x width 65 cm × depth 15 cm
artworks.description: De trommelaarster. Een zittende Noord-Afrikaanse vrouw speelt op een trommel die op een stoel staat. Aan de muur hangt een prent.

artworks.title: The quack
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 37.5 cm x width 52 cm × height 59 cm x width 72 cm x thickness 8.5 cm
artworks.description: De kwakzalver. Op een dorpsplein staat een kwakzalver op een verhoging onder een grote boom, hij toont de dorpelingen de kies (of steen) die hij bij een op een stoel vastgebonden man heeft getrokken. Bij de voeten van de man staat een mand met eieren. Op tafel staan allerlei flessen en potjes en een document met een zegel. Rechts op de voorgrond duwt een vrouw haar dronken man in een kruiwagen. Uiterst rechts hangt een viool aan een paal waarop een aap met een pijp zit.

artworks.title: Morning Toilet
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 23.5 cm x width 17.5 cm x depth 6.5 cm x height 35 cm x width 29.5 cm
artworks.description: Jean Frédéric Schall (1752 - 1825). Morning toilet. Evening toilet. Given by Sir Henry W.A. Deterding, 1936.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape with Ferry
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 75 cm x width 90.3 cm × outer size: depth 7.2 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Herders and an elegant couple are about to take a ferryboat. They have no choice, because – as the lady on the grey horse points out – the stone bridge in the distance has collapsed. By including the ferry, Both introduced a narrative element to the landscape. The scene is bathed in a golden evening glow, and the valleys are cloaked in a bluish haze.

artworks.title: Jupiter, Disguised as Diana, Seducing the Nymph Callisto
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 240 cm x width 205 cm
artworks.description: Jacob de Wit specialized in decorative paintings for town and country houses. He designed entire ensembles, with large paintings and overdoors set in panels. He decided where the paintings were to be placed and adapted the compositions and the fall of light accordingly. This painting and its pendant (to the left of the mantelpiece) were made for the country house of an Amsterdam citizen situated along the River Vecht.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Botanist
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 103.4 cm x width 82 cm x thickness 1.6 cm × depth 10.5 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een botanicus. Portret van een man, ten halven lijve, staande achter een tafel waarop een boek met afbeeldingen van planten ligt. In de linkerhand een lelietje-van-dalen, in de rechterhand een strijdbijl. Rechtsboven het familiewapen. Pendant van SK-A-969.

artworks.title: Marketplace, with the Flagellation, the Ecce Homo and the Bearing of the Cross in the background
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 32 kg × depth 10.5 cm × height 126.5 cm x width 182 cm
artworks.description: Marktplein met op de achtergrond scènes uit de passie van Christus: de geseling, Ecce homo en de kruisdraging. Op de voorgrond bieden marktkooplui hun waar aan: groente, vis, fruit, brood, gevogelte en kaas. Rechts bij een waterput andere verkopers bij hun stalletjes. Voorheen beschouwd als eigenhandig. Betere versies in Moskou en Baton Rouge.

artworks.title: Self Portrait with his Wife Sanneke van Bommel and their two Children
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.5 cm × height 37 cm x width 30 cm
artworks.description: Zelfportret van de schilder Hendrik Spilman (1721-1784) met zijn vrouw Sanneke van Bommel (geb. 1741) en hun twee kinderen. De man heeft een tekenpen in de rechterhand en leunt met de linker elleboog op een kunstboek. De jongste dochter heeft een kat in de hand, de oudste dochter een pop.

artworks.title: View of a village
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outersize: depth 9.5 cm (support incl. SK-L-4627) × support: height 105 cm x width 150 cm
artworks.description: Dorpsgezicht. Aan de rand van een dorp staan enkele wagens stil bij een herberg, even verderop staat een groep mensen langs de kant van de weg. Op de voorgrond een kudde koeien bij een plas onder bomen.

artworks.title: Abraham with the three Angels
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × height 50.5 cm x width 120 cm
artworks.description: Abraham knielt voor de drie engelen, links Sara bij het huis. Gebaseerd op een compositie van Tiepolo. Pendant van SK-A-3435.

artworks.title: Frederika Sophia Wilhelmina of Pruissia (1751-1820), Equestrian portrait of the Wife of Prince Willem V
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 86 cm x width 69.5 cm x thickness 4 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Wilhelmina of Prussia on horseback, by T.P.C. Haag, 1789. Forced out by the Patriots who opposed his regime, Stadholder William V found refuge in the east of the country in 1785. He was restored to power in 1787 with the aid of Prussian troops. These had been sent to help, after William's wife, Wilhelmina of Prussia, had been held up by Patriots at Goejanverwellersluis on her way to The Hague. Wilhelmina's brother was the king of Prussia. Court painter Tethart Haag portrayed her on horseback against a background showing The Hague, where the stadholder court returned in 1787. Wilhelmina is wearing the star of the Russian Order of St Anna.

artworks.title: Allegory on the French Invasion of 1672
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 43 cm x width 37.5 cm × depth 8.5 cm
artworks.description: In 1672 the Netherlands was invaded by the French. That disaster is allegorically rendered in the drawing at which the seated man looks: the Dutch lion is defeated, its weapons in pieces, the gate to its enclosure broken; above, the French rooster crows triumphantly. Symbolizing the other side is the standing man with an orange feather in his cap: he is a supporter ofWilliam III of Orange, who would avert the French threat.

artworks.title: The Whale-oil Refinery near the Village of Smerenburg
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 131 cm x width 229 cm x thickness 10.5 cm × height 108 cm x width 205 cm
artworks.description: Smerenburg on the Norwegian island of Spitsbergen was a settlement of Dutch whalers. As the painter never went there, he combined familiar images and stories in this work. The mountain at the left is probably on Jan Mayen Island. Strips of whale blubber are boiled and rendered into train (whale) oil in the numerous try-pots on the beach. The men’s barracks are visible in the right background.

artworks.title: The Island of Onrust near Batavia (Jakarta)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 77 cm x width 110 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op de scheepswerf op het eiland Onrust bij Batavia. Links wordt een oorlogsschip, met op de spiegel het wapen van Amsterdam, opgekalefaterd. Rechts vuurt een oorlogsschip een salvo, op het water enkele sloepen, één voert een vlag met het wapen van de VOC. Achter de gebouwen staan enkele molens en palmen.

artworks.title: Ships in the Ice
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 36 kg × height 115 cm x width 163 cm × height 151 cm x width 200 cm x depth 16.5 cm
artworks.description: Using thick layers of dark paint, Breitner depicted traditional wooden boats. They seem to be robust and indestructible, but are stuck in the ice. Looming up behind their masts are large steel steamships painted in lighter, almost transparent colours. They sail in open water. Old and modern times are thus contrasted.

artworks.title: Self-portrait
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 28.5 cm x width 22 cm
artworks.description: Making a small bow, courtly and courteous, Du Jardin introduces himself with this elegant self-portrait. Painted with flair and precision, the likeness has the air of a calling card, a demonstration of the artist’s skill. And, indeed, Du Jardin received several commissions for portraits from Amsterdam’s elite.

artworks.title: Scene from the Wedding of Messalina and Gaius Sillius
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 6.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 59.7 cm x width 74.4 cm
artworks.description:
The promiscuous Messalina, the bare-breasted woman in the centre, was the wife of Emperor Claudius. She committed adultery by marrying Sillius and they organized an inordinately lavish banquet to celebrate their wedding. The group peering out the window is on to something; Emperor Claudius is approaching the palace to put an end to the infidelity, drinking and merrymaking. Messalina’s frenzied greed ultimately
led to her downfall.

artworks.title: Sugar Factory with Tower House
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 22.5 cm x width 28 cm
artworks.description: This painting and the Brazilian landscape on view next to it are part of a series of landscapes that Frans Post painted on his return to the Netherlands from Brazil in 1644. The foreground figure carrying a basket on her head recurs regularly in his work.

artworks.title: The Battle of the Zuider Zee, 1573
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 229 cm x width 271.5 cm
artworks.description: De zeeslag op de Zuiderzee voor de rede van Hoorn tegen Bossu in 1573. De vloot onder leiding van Maximiliaan de Hennin, heer van Bossu, wordt op 11 oktober 1573 verslagen door de vloot onder bevel van Cornelis Dirckszoon. Afgebeeld is het moment waarop het vlaggeschip van Bossu, de 'Inquisitie' wordt geënterd. De lijst bevat trofeeën, stadswapens en allerlei attributen van de scheepvaart en oorlog op zee.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 91 cm x width 74 cm × depth 4.7 cm
artworks.description: Zelfportret van de schilder Charles Saligo op jonge leeftijd. Kniestuk, zittend aan een tafeltje met een schetsboek en een tekenpen in de hand.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit and a Lobster
artworks.artist: copy after Jan Davidsz. de Heem
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 70 cm x width 59 cm × depth 10.5 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met vruchten en een kreeft. Aan de muur hangt een festoen van vruchten. Op tafel een Chinees bord met druiven, perzik en abrikozen. Links een geschilde citroen. Tussen de vruchten allerlei insecten en slakken. Oude kopie naar het origineel in Dresden.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fowl
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 95 cm x width 78.5 cm × depth 8 cm
artworks.description: Two dead roosters, a water rail, and a kingfisher hang from cords upside down above a marble slab. Are the flies on them painted, or real? Willem van Aelst not only imitated what he saw, but also transformed it into an elegant composition. The subtle grey, violet, and blue hues make this a special painting, which was already a sought-after collector's item in its own time.

artworks.title: Portrait of Johan Rudolf Thorbecke, Minister of State and Minister of the Interior
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 100 cm x width 84 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: Johan Rudolf Thorbecke (1798 - 1872), by J.H. Neuman, 1852. The liberal statesman Thorbecke drew up the constitution of 1848 in which more power was taken away from the monarch and given to parliament. Before entering politics Thorbecke had enjoyed an academic career. After graduating he had spent a number of years in Germany. In 1825 he was appointed professor of philosophy and literature at Ghent. In 1830, following the start of the Belgian revolution, Thorbecke returned to Holland. In 1831 he was appointed professor at the faculty of law in Leiden. His political career began in 1840. He became leader of the liberal faction in the Second Chamber. After 1848 he led three cabinets: 1849 - 1853, 1862 - 1868 and 1871 - 1872. Thorbecke is wearing the commander's cross of the Orde van de Nederlandse Leeuw.

artworks.title: Landscape with Herdsmen and Cattle
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 11 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 105.5 cm x width 102.5 cm
artworks.description: Aelbert Cuyp (1620 - 1691). Landscape with herdsmen and cattle, c. 1655. This landscape with its castle ruins evokes an idyllic atmosphere, reinforced by the contre jour effect. Cuyp never visited Italy, but many of his landscapes have a Mediterranean flavour, with mountains bathed in a golden sunlight. He was inspired by the work of Jan Both, who lived in Italy for a time and painted so-called Italianizing landscapes. Bequest of L. Dupper (Dordrecht), 1870.

artworks.title: Winter Landscape with Skaters
artworks.medium: paint (coating), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 4.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 55.1 cm x width 111.7 cm
artworks.description: Winterlandschap. IJsvermaak met schaatsers bij een dorp en een molen.

artworks.title: The Windmill
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 59.5 cm x width 50 cm x thickness 3.3 cm × depth 12 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op een standerdmolen achter enkele huizen en geboomte bij een vaart. Links op de oever staat een man voorovergebogen bij een platte schuit.

artworks.title: Design for a ceiling painting with the Apotheosis of Aeneas, in the corners the Four Seasons
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 51.5 cm x width 69.5 cm
artworks.description: Ontwerp voor een plafondstuk met de apotheose van Aeneas. De held knielt in de wolken tussen de goden. In de hoeken worden de vier jaargetijden verbeeld door allegorische figuren en putti.

artworks.title: Fire and Light (A Girl Places a Candle in a Lantern and a Boy Blows on the Coals in a Chafing-Dish)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.2 cm × height 46 cm x width 38 cm
artworks.description: Een meisje plaatst een kaars in een lantaarn en een jongen blaast in de kolen in een vuurtest voor een stoof. Pendant van SK-A-371.

artworks.title: Farms on the Fringe of a Wood
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 46.5 cm x width 62 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met boerderijen aan de rand van een bos bij Laren in het Gooi. Tussen de boerderijen loopt een weg waarover enige figuren gaan. Vooraan drinkt een hond uit een grote plas.

artworks.title: De doornenkroning van Jezus
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 192.4 cm x width 221.5 cm × outer size: weight 55 kg × support: depth 7.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Before Christ’s trial, Roman soldiers placed a plaited crown of thorns on his head, dressed him in a cloak and mocked him. After all, was he not the ‘King of the Jews’? The scene is dramatically illuminated by a torch, held by the boy at the left. Honthorst probably made this painting for a clandestine Catholic church (schuilkerk) in Amsterdam.

artworks.title: The Drawing Lesson
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 120 cm x width 159 cm
