artworks.title: At Grandmother's
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 131.5 cm x width 91.5 cm
artworks.description: 'Bij grootmoeder'. Schevenings interieur met een oude vrouw en twee kinderen aan een tafel.

artworks.title: The Calling of Saint Anthony
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 132.5 cm x width 96.3 cm
artworks.description: This many-sided composition represents the moment when the wealthy Anthony, standing at right, answers the priest’s call during his sermon to give away all his worldly possessions. In the right background Anthony is distributing bread to the poor. The lifelike fly on the white cap of the woman at front is an illusionistic joke by the painter.

artworks.title: Brazilian Village
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 20.5 cm x width 26.5 cm
artworks.description: The province of Pernambuco, conquered by the Dutch, was home to a diverse population. Post distinguishes the various groups through the depiction of their distinct costumes. In the foreground, for instance, we see indigenous inhabitants dressed in white attire. Walking towards the veranda is a couple wearing European clothing, and a veiled woman and an African man carrying a basket on his head stand at the fence.

artworks.title: Polar Bears
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.6 cm × height 79.5 cm x width 17 cm x thickness 0 cm
artworks.description: Studie met ijsberen in een poollandschap.

artworks.title: The Grocer’s Shop
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 39 cm x width 33.5 cm
artworks.description: The painter of this scene, Frans II, was the youngest member of the artistic Van Mieris family. He followed firmly in the footsteps of his grandfather Frans I and his father, Willem. Hence, this painting can serve as a pendant to The Poultry Seller painted by his father (on view elsewhere on this wall). The egg basket at the upper right appears to have descended through the generations.

artworks.title: The Artist at his Studio
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 36 cm x width 43.5 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: A little nervously, the painter watches as his visitor reviews his latest painting. To judge from the name on the portfolio, this is Oberman himself. All the attributes an artist might need lay spread about the studio: plaster models, to the left on the table, a pestle to grind pigments, while the powder mixed with oil was preserved in the pig’s bladders on the chimneypiece.

artworks.title: View of a Rocky Coast by Moonlight
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 42 cm x width 51 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op een rotsachtige kust bij maanlicht. Op de rotsen van de kust staat links een vuurtoren. Enkele mannen duwen een boot het strand op, in het water drijft vervallen vissersboot.

artworks.title: Triptych with the Last Supper and Donors
artworks.artist: circle of Jacob Cornelisz van Oostsanen
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), gold (metal), precious metal, inorganic material, glass, oil paint (paint), gold leaf
artworks.dimensions: support: height 45 cm (centre panel) x width 39 cm (centre panel) x height 45 cm (left wing) x width 20 cm (left wing) x height 45 cm (right wing) x width 18.7 cm (right wing)
artworks.description: This triptych is the earliest known and best-preserved verre églomisé painting (a type of reverse painting on glass) from the northern Netherlands. It is still in its original frame. The donors depicted on the wings are Adriana van Rhoon (c. 1450-1527) and Dirck Pietersz Spangert (c. 1465-1549); she was the abbess and he the chaplain and jurist of Leeuwenhorst Abbey in Noordwijkerhout.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape
artworks.artist: Jacob Jacobsz van Geel (signed by artist)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 49 cm x width 73.9 cm × outer size: depth 6 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: In a forest with majestic giant trees, a few tiny figures can be seen conversing. Their insignificance makes the trees, with their fanciful shapes and eccentric foliage, seem even larger. Van Geel stands apart from most Dutch landscape painters. He was not interested in realistic landscapes, but preferred imaginary ones.

artworks.title: Portrait of Louise Christina Trip
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 43 cm × depth 9 cm × thickness 4.1 cm × height 171.3 cm x width 142.3 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Louise Christina Trip (gest. 1733), echtgenote van Gerrit Stichterman. Kniestuk staande met een bloesemtak in de rechterhand, links een doorkijk naar een tuin met een standbeeld.

artworks.title: The Studio of the Haarlem Painter Pieter Frederik van Os
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, paper, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 49 cm x width 61 cm
artworks.description: This painter’s studio was located in the Town Hall of Haarlem. All manner of studio attributes are shown: drawings of nude models, a painted nocturnal land-scape and some plaster casts. A small oil sketch of a goat, a set of deer antlers and a horseshoe indicate that Van Os was mainly an animal painter. A young pupil kneels before the monumental 17th-century fireplace and looks through a portfolio of sketches.

artworks.title: Virgin Annunciate
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, biological material, panel
artworks.dimensions: diameter 23.5 cm
artworks.description: Scenes of The Annunciation were regularly depicted on the upper parts of large polyptychs, and that accounts for this small roundel, undoubtedly one of a pair with another, which would have shown the archangel Gabriel announcing the Virgin’s conception. When such altarpieces went out of fashion, they were often dismembered and the fragments found their way into private collections.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.5 cm × height 52.7 cm x width 44.1 cm
artworks.description: Madonna met kind. Maria en het Christuskind voor een venster met uitzicht op stad met gracht. Het kind zit op een houten bankje en heeft een kralensnoer in de handen. Voor Maria ligt op een vensterbank een opengeslagen boek en enkele vruchten.

artworks.title: View of the Herengracht near the Leidsestraat, Amsterdam
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.5 cm × height 54 cm x width 72.5 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op de Herengracht bij de Leidsestraat te Amsterdam. Op de gracht varen verschillende kleine boten. Op de brug een rijtuig. Links het huis met nr. 436, waar een echtpaar, waarschijnlijk Cornelis G.J. van Wijckerslooth en Geertruida Maria Roest van Alkemade-Blesen, op de trap staat. Beneden probeert een parapluverkoper zijn waar te slijten.

artworks.title: Jan van Speyk steekt de lont in het kruit, 5 februari 1831
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8 cm × height 25.4 cm x width 20.2 cm x thickness 1 cm
artworks.description: Van Speyk putting the Spark to the Tinder on his Ship, 5 February 1831, by J. Schoemaker Doyer, c. 1834. During the Belgian revolution Jan C.J. van Speyk (1802 - 1831) was given command of a Dutch gunboat. Caught in a storm, the ship ended up against the banks of the Scheldt in Antwerp where it was overwhelmed by a crowd of Belgians. Van Speyk blew his ship up: he and his fellow officers had sworn an oath never to let their ship fall into the hands of the enemy undamaged. Almost all the crew, including Van Speyk, as well as several Belgians died in the explosion. Van Speyk's embalmed remains were solemnly interred in the New Church in Amsterdam in May 1832. He was honoured as a national hero. Schoemaker Doyer based his work on an eyewitness account.

artworks.title: Portrait of Aegje Hasselaer
artworks.artist: Michiel Jansz van Mierevelt (signed by artist)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 9.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 69.7 cm x width 60 cm
artworks.description: The half-length portraits of Henrick Hooft and Aegje Hasselaer present Amsterdam's future burgomaster and his brand-new bride in expensive, fashionable attire. Their modern, flat collars are trimmed with lace. Following the latest trend they wear their hair long and loose. Aegje is decked out with costly earrings and a breast ornament, while scores of pearls grace her neck and collar.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 128 cm x width 104 cm × height 127 cm x width 102 cm
artworks.description: Wearing an embroidered Japanese dressing gown, Bol poses as a man of the world here. He probably painted this self-portrait on the occasion of his marriage to the wealthy widow Anna van Erckel, one of his earliest patrons. The gilded, ornate frame was specially made for the painting. Its large carved sunflowers symbolize marriage: they trail the sun just like a person follows their beloved one.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Nobleman in Armor
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.3 cm × height 92.5 cm x width 70 cm
artworks.description: Brescian school, attributed to Giovanni Moroni. Portrait of a man in armour, c. 1550. From the Augusteum, Oldenburg. Presented by a group of members of the Vereniging Rembrandt, 1925.

artworks.title: A Laren Scene
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 132 cm x width 103 cm × weight 35.6 kg × depth 14.5 cm
artworks.description: Laren was one of the Hague School painters’ favourite places. Israëls went there from 1874, when the village of smallholders and shepherds was still entirely authentic. Once the painters had discovered it, Laren became a genuine artists’ colony and subsequently a tourist honeypot. Israëls will have thus painted this charming scene of a girl in a door opening largely from memory.

artworks.title: The Hunter
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: total: weight 48 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 183.5 cm x width 221 cm × outer size: depth 9 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Een jager keert terug van de jacht vergezeld van zijn jachthonden. Hij draagt zijn geweer, waaraan een haas hangt, over de schouder.

artworks.title: Panoramic View of a River with Low-lying Meadows
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 31.3 cm x width 44.6 cm × outer size: depth 4.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Jan van Goyen painted the Dutch landscape in all of its myriad facets: from cities and villages to the sea and rivers, from hilly dunes to sprawling polders and holmes (flat ground near a river submerged in times of flood). Here some people on a hill in the left foreground look across an extensive river landscape. Van Goyen reserved a tremendous amount of space for the imposing cloudy sky looming above the low land.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mary Stuart (1662-95), Wife of Prince William III
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 80.5 cm x width 63.5 cm × depth 5.5 cm
artworks.description: William III and Mary II by Caspar Netscher, between 1677 and 1684. In 1677 Stadholder William III married his niece Mary Stuart, daughter of the heir to the English throne, later James II. The two portraits form a pair. They were painted by Caspar Netscher, a popular portrait artist in The Hague. Mary is wearing an orange dress; the ermine cloak indicates her royal lineage. In contrast to the homely setting in which Mary is shown, William is depicted with acavalry battle in the background. He is wearing armour and beside him is a helmetwith an orange plume. William is carrying his staff of command. The stadholder was captain general of the army.

artworks.title: Arrival of the Boats
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 127 cm x width 95 cm
artworks.description: Waiting for the catch was a daily event on the beach at Scheveningen. Everyone in the village, young and old, came out to pilot the boats to shore, to haul them up onto the beach by horse, and to snap up the freshly caught fish. The format and composition that Maris chose for this painting draws us into the scene; we seem to be queueing up, as it were.

artworks.title: Country Kermis
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 36.5 cm x width 32.5 cm
artworks.description: Boerenkermis. Voor de ingang van een huis speelt een vrouw op een draailier en een jongen op de fluit. Geleund over de onderdeur luistert een man met een pijp naar de muzikanten. Voor het huis spelende kinderen en een hond, in de verte de stalletjes van de kermis.

artworks.title: Street in Montmartre, Paris

artworks.dimensions: depth 5.5 cm × height 21.5 cm x width 16 cm
artworks.description: Straat in Montmartre, Parijs. Rechts voert een straat de heuvel op.

artworks.title: The City Wall of Haarlem in the Winter
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 39.5 cm x width 48.5 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op de stadswal van Haarlem met de Gasthuistoren en de Kleine Houtpoort, in de winter. Links laden mannen biervaten op een slede, rechts twee kolfspelers. Tegen de muur twee duiventillen. Pendant van SK-A-28.

artworks.title: Ducks
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 93 cm x width 116 cm
artworks.description: Van links naar rechts staan een wintertaling, smient, nijlgans, muskuseend en wilde eend. Boven vliegt een albinoduif. Links een doorkijk.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 66.5 cm x width 49.5 cm × depth 7.3 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een vrouw met donker haar, ten halven lijve, in een zwart fluwelen kleed, iets naar links.

artworks.title: The poet crowned by two apes at the feast of the animals
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 56.5 cm x width 82 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: De dichter (Orpheus?) op het feest der dieren gekroond met een lauwerkrans door twee apen. Hieromheen een grote menigte van dieren. Rechtsvoor maakt een groep beesten een ronde dans, links speelt een beer op de doedelzak en andere beesten op fluiten. Verder: hert, paard, luipaard, steenbok, leeuw, hond, hert, everzwijn, vos, kat, muis, rat, kikker, os, kameel, kasuaris, struisvogel, vleermuis, konijn, uil, sprinkhaan, reiger, adelaar, valk, paradijsvogel, slang, armadillo, papegaai en andere dieren.

artworks.title: Landscape near Hilversum
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 81 cm x width 100 cm
artworks.description: Landschap in de omgeving van Hilversum. Weide met grazende koe, schapen en geiten. Rechts hoge bomen.

artworks.title: Judgment of Paris
artworks.artist: circle of Meester van de Vrouwelijke Halffiguren
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, biological material, panel
artworks.dimensions: height 10 cm x width 15.6 cm
artworks.description: Het oordeel van Paris. In een landschap zit de herder Paris op de rand van een fontein en beoordeelt de drie naakte godinnen die voor hem staan. Mercurius staat achter hem. Links Minerva, rechts Venus en Juno.

artworks.title: Ambassador Cornelis Calkoen at his Audience with Sultan Ahmed III
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 10.8 kg × height 90 cm x width 121 cm
artworks.description: The actual audience was held in the sultan’s private living quarters in the palace. After the meal with the grand vizier, Calkoen and his retinue were presented with kaftans as a sign of hospitality, but also to cover the clothing of the ‘non-believers’. Ahmed sits on a throne, with four princes next to him. Calkoen is giving a speech and will afterwards present his credentials to the sultan.

artworks.title: Saint Clare
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 83 cm x width 66 cm
artworks.description: Saint Clare is reading the Bible, bathed in light. Also known as ‘the luminous one,’ Saint Clare was a 13th-century Italian nun who devoted herself to spirituality and renounced all earthly possessions. She gained a vast following and was canonized just four days after her death. The painter Court chose not to depict her in a habit, instead inventing a medievalinspired version of her clothing and hairstyle.

artworks.title: The Housewife
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 56.5 cm x width 49 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: De huisvrouw. Interieur met een moeder zittend bij de wieg van haar kind. De vrouw heeft op schoot een mand met groente. Links in de doek van de kamer staat een pers.

artworks.title: Sandy Track in the Dunes
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 32 cm x width 42.5 cm × height 44.5 cm x width 54.5 cm x thickness 7 cm
artworks.description: A sandy track winds along a dune, at the top of which two people enjoy the view. Ruisdael linked various visual elements together, from the reeds in the foreground to the horizon in the distance. The curve of the path is continued visually in the treetops. In this juvenile work, Ruisdael was already exploring ways of enhancing the palpability of a landscape.

artworks.title: The Vegetable Market
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 67.3 cm x width 88.2 cm x thickness 10 cm × height 51 cm x width 71 cm
artworks.description: De groentemarkt. Twee vrouwen en een man achter een kraam waar fruit en groente te koop wordt aangeboden. Een jonge vrouw met een hoed houdt een kalebas in haar uitgestrekte hand. Tot de waar behoren: kolen, wortels, rapen en knollen, artisjokken, kalebassen, bieten en pompoenen. Rechts ligt een kruiwagen, op de achtergrond marktbezoekers, het zeil van een schip en gevels van huizen aan een gracht.

artworks.title: The Lake of Zurich
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 82 cm x width 145 cm
artworks.description:
Hackaert belongs to the Dutch Italianates, the name given to painters able to capture the golden sunlight of Italy. It is unclear whether he ever actually travelled to Italy. What is certain is that he lived for many years in Switzerland, where he made drawings in the environs of Zurich. He relied on such studies for this panoramic
view – it is one of the earliest topographical renderings of the Alps.

artworks.title: Kenau Simonsdr Hasselaer
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: frame: height 43.8 cm x width 34 cm x depth 2.3 cm × support: height 34.8 cm x width 26.5 cm
artworks.description: Kenau Hasselaer was a widow and owned a shipbuilding business. As the leader of a group of women she helped defend Haarlem during the Spanish siege in 1573. At the time, she was described as a ‘very masculine woman, the bravest of all who relentlessly taunted the enemies.’ And she was honoured with portraits like this one. Later, she became the epitome of a heroic woman in general.

artworks.title: Still life
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.5 cm × height 45.5 cm x width 36 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met een mandje aardbeien, een metalen beker met lepel en een fles.

artworks.title: Interior of a Protestant, Gothic Church, with a Gravedigger in the Choir
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 44.5 cm x width 33.5 cm
artworks.description: The depiction of church interiors was a separate speciality. De Witte was one of the last 17th-century artists to concentrate on these perspectival masterpieces. This painting offers an oblique ‘through-view’ into a church. The columns in the foreground lead the eye into the distance. In the background the light falls on a gravedigger; it was customary for eminent citizens to be buried in churches.

artworks.title: The Children of the Planet Mercury
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 70 cm x width 92.3 cm
artworks.description: Verheerlijking van handel en wetenschap. Landschap met een ruïne bij een stad aan de kust. In het midden zijn drie kinderen bezig met lezen en schrijven, voor hen liggen op de grond stapels boeken en geometrische instrumenten. Links loeren twee vossen naar een groep apen die zich met alchemie bezighouden. In de werkruimte links buigt een groep wetenschappers zich rond een tafel met een globe, tegen de muur staat een boekenkast. Aan een zuil bij de ingang hangt een klok. Rechts op de voorgrond zitten twee apen bij een groep objecten die verwijzen naar plezier en vermaak: muziekinstrumenten, speelkaarten, glazen met wijn, een triktrakspel, maskers, zwaarden, een muziekboek en de torso van een beeld. Op de achtergrond dansende komedianten en publiek verzameld voor een toneelstuk opgevoerd buiten een dorp. Door de lucht rijdt de triomfwagen van Mercurius getrokken door vier hanen. Er voor vliegen allerlei vogels, waaronder een papegaai en een kaketoe. Uit de wagen strooit een aap muziekinstrumenten, dobbelstenen, maskers, kaarten etc.

artworks.title: Kitchen by Lamplight
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10.5 cm × height 50 cm x width 40 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht door een venster op een keuken bij lamplicht. Een keukenmeid vult een ketel met water uit een kraan, zij heeft een olielamp in de rechterhand. Op de achtergrond een staande vrouw met kind op de arm bij een kaars.

artworks.title: De Winkel near Abcoude
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10.5 cm × height 52 cm x width 81.5 cm x thickness 2.4 cm
artworks.description: This painting is a collaboration between two painters. Gabriël was known for his polder landscapes, De Haas for his accomplished rendering of  cattle. The result is a truly Dutch picture with a windmill, willow trees and cows by the small river Winkel at Abcoude, near Amsterdam. Both artists signed at the lower left: Gabriel ft De Haas fig. That is to say that Gabriël painted the picture and De Haas added the figures.

artworks.title: A Dog on a Chair
artworks.artist: Guillaume Anne van der Brugghen (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.1 cm × height 31.2 cm x width 22.4 cm x thickness 0.8 cm
artworks.description: Een hond zittend op een stoel.

artworks.title: Officers and Other Civic Guardsmen of the IIIrd District of Amsterdam, under the Command of Captain Allaert Cloeck and Lieutenant Lucas Jacobsz Rotgans
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 220 cm x width 351 cm
artworks.description: Thomas de Keyser (1596/97 - 1667). The company of Captain Allaert Cloeck and Lieutenant Lucas Jacobsz Rotgans, Amsterdam, 1632. These civil guardsmen were positioned hierarchically: in the centre, on a platform, the captain, the colour-bearer, and the lieutenant. Around them we see three non-commissioned officers, who each have one foot on the platform. The regular riflemen arranged in the background are much smaller than the officers. Despite the fact that the riflemen to the left and right are somewhat crowded together, the composition is animated. The manner in which the three non-commissioned officers appear to be about to step onto the podium suggests a throng beginning to advance. This same solution - a crowd of people moving forward - was chosen by Rembrandt ten years later for his celebrated Night-watch. Painted for the Kloveniersdoelen (headquarters of the crossbowmen's civic guard), Amsterdam. On loan from the city of Amsterdam, 1885.

Why is this company so merry? This painting depicts several of life’s pleasures. On the left, a singing woman plays the lute. The objects on the table and the pearl earring belonging to the woman in the middle both allude to luxury. The toiletries on the
table, including a mirror, likely allude to vanity. The bed and the two gentlemen entering with a hare and a partridge are a nod to another kind of pleasure: ‘chasing the hare’ and ‘birding’ were euphemisms for making love.

artworks.description: The river Medway during the Dutch attack on the English fleet, 1667, by Willem Schellinks. England's principal naval base was at Chatham on the river Medway. After reducing the fort at Sheerness, the Dutch ships sailed upstream and reached Chatham on 22 June 1667. Below left is Fort Sheerness, held by a Dutch garrison. The artist has paused for a moment to point out to the audience his motto: 'Know Thyself and beware of Miserliness.' His wife looks on. The studio is rendered in considerable detail: on the easel we see a Holy Family and on a nearby table the artist's painting equipment; there are books and prints lying on the floor. Comans was not only a painter, but also a calligrapher, etcher and schoolmaster. Purchased in 1967, thanks to a gift from G. Henle (Duisburg)

artworks.title: The Dairy Cow: The Dutch Provinces, Revolting against the Spanish King Philip II, Are Led by Prince William of Orange, The States General Entreat Queen Elizabeth I for Aid
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 69.7 cm x width 84 cm x thickness 7.5 cm × height 52 cm x width 67 cm
artworks.description:
Het melkkoetje. Door onbekende Engelse schilder. Omstreeks 1585.
Na de afzwering van de Spaanse koning in 1581 probeerden de opstandige provincies meer dan ooit buitenlandse steun te vinden. Tevoren hadden zij de souvereiniteit aangeboden aan de hertog van Anjou, zoon van Hendrik II van Frankrijk: dit experiment mislukte. Daarop werd in 1585 een overeenkomst gesloten met koningin Elisabeth van Engeland. Zij zond geld en troepen onder de Graaf van Leicester. Ook deze politiek mislukte.
De koe, die de opstandige gewesten verbeeldt, wordt door Philips II bereden. Hij geeft haar tot bloedens toe de sporen. De Prins van Oranje melkt de koe uit, terwijl Anjou haar aan de staart trekt. Koningin Elisabeth voedert het beest, dat bij de hoorns wordt gevat door de deputatie uit de Staten-Generaal, die op 20 augustus 1585 de overeenkomst met Engeland sloot.

artworks.description: Madonna dell' umiltà, een Madonna van Nederigheid. Maria met het Christuskind staand op haar schoot, zittend op de grond in een bloementuin, een bloemetje in de rechterhand. Maria's mantel is geborduurd met het monogram IHS.

artworks.title: Three Painted Wall Hangings of a Dutch landscape
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 326 cm x width 124.5 cm
artworks.description: The widow Maria Everdina Bolten commissioned these and two more wall-size landscapes to adorn the garden room of her house on Amsterdam’s Nieuwe Doelenstraat. The viewer is transported from the heart of a bustling city to an oasis far beyond it. It is as if one gazes through a window at the river flowing under an opened drawbridge with a bustling farm, inn, and a country house along the banks.

artworks.title: Portrait of Margaret of Austria (1584-1611), Queen of Spain
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 28.5 cm x width 22.4 cm x thickness 0.3 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Margaretha van Oostenrijk (1584-1611), echtgenote van Filips III. Buste naar links. Pendant van SK-A-507.

artworks.title: View in the Woods
artworks.medium: inorganic material, glass
artworks.dimensions: height 34 cm x width 42.5 cm
artworks.description: Jan van der Heyden (1637 - 1712). Woodland scene, glass painting.

artworks.title: The Battle of Bautersem during the Ten Days’ Campaign
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 46 cm x width 60.5 cm
artworks.description: On 2 August 1831 Dutch troops invaded Belgium, which had seceded from the Netherlands in 1830. At the Battle of Bautersem, near Louvain, the horse that was ridden by the Prince of Orange, later King William II, was shot from beneath him. Nicolaas Pieneman recorded this heroic moment. Although the Ten Days’ Campaign enflamed nationalist sentiments, it ended in a truce, and Belgium remained independent.

artworks.title: The Arrival of the Royal Charles
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 68 cm x width 103.5 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: The Royal Charles was the most powerful warship in the English fleet. The Dutch captured the vessel during the raid on the naval base at Chatham in June 1667 and moved it to the Dutch port of Hellevoetsluis. The English ship’s flag is lowered to signify its surrender. The ship’s ornamentally carved counter is on display in this gallery.

artworks.title: Mercury Ordering Calypso to Release Odysseus
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 132 cm x width 96 cm
artworks.description:
During his wanderings, Odysseus encounters the nymph Calypso, who falls in love with him and holds him captive on her island. Jupiter then sends Mercury to command her to let Odysseus return to his wife. Lairesse made this painting, together with several
other works representing exemplary love and devotion, for Mary Stuart’s apartments in Soestdijk Palace.

artworks.title: River in the Ardennes at Sunset
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 138 cm x width 120 cm × depth 10 cm
artworks.description: Rivierlandschap in de Ardennen bij zonsondergang. Enkele figuren met een paard rustend langs de oever bij een stroomversnelling.

artworks.title: A Painter’s Studio
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 71 cm x width 74 cm
artworks.description:
Like so many artists, Sweerts undertook a study trip to Rome. There he painted this scene of a painter’s studio, in which all the phases of artistic training are to be seen. At the left a young artist studies a large
anatomical figure; piled up at the right are fragments of antique statues. In the left background a painter sketches from a nude model; a completed painting hangs on the wall.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit in a Terracotta Dish
artworks.medium: paper, paint (coating), pasteboard, cardboard, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: width 44 cm x width 31.3 cm × height 37.1 cm × height 49.5 cm
artworks.description: Originally, horses were Oberman’s speciality. However, there was little demand for the genre in the Netherlands, so around 1825-1830 he switched to painting still lifes of flowers and fruit. This fruit arrangement includes both native and glasshouse-cultivated varieties which were available around 1830 in the Netherlands, although in different seasons. This harvest includes plums, quinces, peaches and currants.

artworks.title: A Hermit in a Ruin
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 36.5 cm x width 30.5 cm
artworks.description: Een kluizenaar in een ruïne. Een oude man zit met een boek op schoot onder een dorre boom. Aan de voet van de boom groeit een kalebas of pompoen.

artworks.title: Vegetable Market
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.5 cm × height 71 cm x width 91 cm
artworks.description: Groentemarkt. Een groep personen rond een stalletje op een brug waar een oude vrouw groente verkoopt. In een mand liggen grote kolen opgestapeld, op een kruiwagen liggen grote bossen wortelen of rapen. Links een moeder met een kind op de arm en een dienstmeid met een mand. Rechts een vrouw met twee kinderen en een hond.

artworks.title: White Cow
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 27 cm x width 37 cm
artworks.description: Willem Maris may have used this small painting as a preparatory study for several of his large compositions with a cow. From the cow’s contours, it is clear that it was painted in light colours over a dark brown ground. Willem Maris was the only artist in his group who consistently worked in this way. Most Hague School painters used a light ground.

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.medium: metal, wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, inorganic material, panel, oil paint (paint), tempera, gilding (material)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 36.5 cm x width 20 cm
artworks.description: Judith met het hoofd van Holofernes. Judith stapt uit de tentopening met het zwaard in de rechterhand en de afgehouwen kop in de linkerhand. Rechts een schim van de dienstmaagd.

artworks.title: A Poultry Yard
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.1 cm × height 92.3 cm x width 109.4 cm x thickness 3.5 cm
artworks.description: Hoenderhof met een haan omringd door enkele kippen en kuikens. Rechts zit een duif op een steen. Links op de achtergrond een vijver met eenden.

artworks.title: The Home Fleet Saluting the State Barge
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 64 cm x width 92.5 cm
artworks.description: A row of ships lies at anchor. Two yachts fire a salute for the functionaries rowing by in a state barge. The water’s smooth, mirror-like surface reflects the vessel and its passengers. Van de Cappelle superbly captured the grandeur unfolding on the water, with ships as far as the eye can see rendered in perspective, under an imposing cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Rich Children, Poor Parents
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 61 cm x width 163 cm
artworks.description:
The parents have spent all their money on providing their son with a good upbringing. They now turn to him for help, which he flatly refuses because he has to maintain his status. In so doing, he breaks the Fifth
Commandment: ‘Honour your father and your mother.’ But the parents, too, have failed to act according to
the Bible; had they been more mindful of their money, they would not have become destitute.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Couple in a Landscape
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 76.3 cm x height 76 cm x width 61.5 cm x width 62.5 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een echtpaar in een landschap. Links een hondje, rechts een kapiteel met een manskop (een zelfportret van Gerard Dou?). Het stel stond oorspronkelijk in een interieur, dat later door Berchem met een landschap is overschilderd.

artworks.title: Jacob Wrestling with the Angel
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: support: height 48.7 cm x width 68 cm
artworks.description: Almost home, Jacob dreaded the reunion with his brother Esau on the other side of the river. He spent the night on the bank, struggling long and hard with an angel. Jacob finally won the match by daybreak. The angel blessed Jacob and gave him the honorary name of Israel: ‘he who wrestles with God.’ The rosy sky heralding the new day is aptly rendered.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 24.5 cm x width 54.5 cm × depth 8 cm
artworks.description: Vlak landschap. Links een molen, in de verte een dorp.

artworks.title: The Lamentation of Christ
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 35.5 cm x width 42.9 cm
artworks.description: Here the artist ‘zoomed in’ on the faces of the dead Christ and his grieving disciples. The painting is thus both intimate and confrontational. This made it easier for believers to identify with Christ’s suffering and the Virgin’s sorrow. The man on the right holding the nails from the cross is Nicodemus; it is probably also a portrait of the person who commissioned the painting.

artworks.title: The Crane on the Antwerp Quay by the Frozen Scheldt
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 58.3 cm x width 114 cm × outer size: depth 8.5 cm (support incl. frame and climate box)
artworks.description: Gezicht op het ijsvermaak op de bevroren Schelde bij het Kranenhoofd te Antwerpen. Op het ijs vele schaatsers en kolfspelers, aan de rand van het ijs staan enkele tenten. Over de kade lopen veel mensen.

artworks.title: Still Life with Earthenware Jar, Fish and Fruit
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.5 cm × height 23 cm x width 27 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met aarden kruik, drie vissen op een aardewerken vergiet, vruchten op een houten kistje en enkele perziken en bessen; rechts een vlinder en een rups. Pendant van SK-A-1529.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy with a Kolf Club
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 115.4 cm x width 85.3 cm × outer size: depth 8.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Portret van een jongen met een kolfstok in de rechterhand en een bal in de linker. Staand, ten voeten uit, in een lange mantel met zigzigpatroon.

artworks.title: The Regents of the Spinhuis and Nieuwe Werkhuis, Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 225 cm x width 390 cm x weight 97 kg
artworks.description: A servant bringing a letter temporarily interrupts a meeting. The other five men are the regents of the Amsterdam Spinhuis, the female house of correction. The women imprisoned there for theft or begging spent most of their days spinning. Affluent citizens like these gentlemen administered these sorts of institutions. Thus was civic peace maintained.

artworks.title: City Walls in Winter
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 74 cm x width 105 cm
artworks.description:
A canal running alongside a fortified city disappears into the distance, the city walls in ruins and the bridge
collapsed. In the background at right is a glowing furnace, where marble is burned to make chalk. These
motifs, often found in paintings by Dutch Italianates, have here been shifted to a cold wintery day.

artworks.title: Cellar of the Artist’s Home in The Hague
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 39 cm x width 51 cm
artworks.description: On rainy days even a Hague School artist could not work outside. Weissenbruch would then turn to his own house, painting views of the cellar, attic and courtyard. Such paintings allowed him to study the effect of light and the resulting range of colours. A few green cabbage leaves on the tile floor enliven the otherwise subdued palette.

artworks.title: View of Ankara
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 117 cm x width 198 cm × depth 6.5 cm
artworks.description: Op de achtergrond de ommuurde stad Ankara (Angora), op het middenplan een landschap met links mannen te paard, vergezeld door (jacht)honden en rechts een jager, een paardenkaravaan en een kamelenkaravaan die een brug oversteekt. Op de voorgrond worden de verschillende stadia van de wolproduktie getoond. Geheel rechts worden de angora geiten geschoren. Vervolgens zien we van rechts naar links het weven van de wol door een drapenier, het wassen en koken van de wol, het wegen van de wol, het nogmaals wegen (mogelijk de keuring van de wol), het spinnen en de verkoop van de wol en een druk bezochte marktplaats.

artworks.title: Ships at Anchor
artworks.artist: Willem van de Velde (II) (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9 cm × diameter 35.5 cm
artworks.description: Ronde voorstelling met een oorlogsschip (op de spiegel het wapen van Amsterdam) en enkele vissersschepen voor anker, op de voorgrond eendjes.

artworks.title: Reclining Nude
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4 cm × height 22.9 cm x width 29.4 cm x thickness 2.2 cm
artworks.description: Studie van een naakte vrouw liggend op een sofa of bed, op de rug gezien.

artworks.title: Prince Maurice at the Battle of Nieuwpoort, 2 July 1600
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 3.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 80.9 cm x width 116.6 cm
artworks.description: Prince Maurice at the battle of Nieuwpoort, 2 July 1600, by Pauwels van Hillegaert, first half 17th century. It was at Nieuwpoort, on the Flemish coast, that the Dutch won their first major victory over a Spanish army on foreign soil. No advantage could be taken of the success, however. The army was too far from its home base and was forced to return. In the centre foreground: Prince Maurice, the Dutch commander, in armour on horse back. He is wearing an orange sash. The battle is shown in the second plane. Above, a golden sky looms.

artworks.title: A groep of Guardsmen
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 119.3 cm (centre panel) x width 174.4 cm (centre panel) x height 119.7 cm (left wing) x width 75.9 cm (left wing) x height 120.4 cm (right wing) x width 76.1 cm (right wing) × weight 60 kg
artworks.description: In the earliest known Dutch militia portrait, no fewer than seventeen men gaze at us with pride, including, at the upper right, the painter himself holding a paintbrush. The man fourth from the right in the bottom row is probably the captain. The militias were responsible for urban order, public safety and the defence of the city. This group portrait is a textbook example of bourgeois self-awareness and confidence, and typically Dutch.

artworks.title: Philosopher with Mirror
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 113 cm x width 89 cm × depth 8.4 cm
artworks.description: Een filosoof, waarschijnlijk Socrates, die zijn refelectie in een spiegel beschouwt. Staande, ten halven lijve, zijdelings op de rug gezien.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.medium: plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, oil paint (paint), canvas, wood (plant material)
artworks.dimensions: height 162 cm x width 202 cm x depth 4.5 cm × height 160 cm x width 200 cm
artworks.description: During the Last Supper, Christ shared bread and wine, symbols of his body and blood, with his disciples. This was how he announced not only his crucifixion,  but also that he would live on in his disciples, among whom he has traditionally been represented for centuries. Dumas took the liberty of making of him a solitary, empty figure, above whose head new life appears in a ‘cloud’ of foetuses.

artworks.title: The Annunciation to the Virgin
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 128 cm x width 176 cm × depth 6.7 cm
artworks.description: An angel has come down from the heaven with the message for Mary that she will give birth to the son of God. She asks for an explanation: how can she be pregnant when she has never been with a man? Van de Velde portrays the moment of initial disbelief with deep psychological insight. He probably painted this picture for a clandestine Catholic church in Amsterdam.

artworks.title: Young Man in a Study
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.5 cm × height 100 cm x width 76 cm x thickness 1.2 cm
artworks.description: Jongen staande voor een werktafel in een interieur van een studeerkamer. Op de tafel een opengeslagen boek, landkaart, luit, inktstel, globe en een standbeeld van Venus. Tegen de muur planken met boeken en een landkaart op rollen. Op de voorgrond liggen op de vloer een boek, een kaart en een gipsen kop. Rechts een trap naar de bovenverdieping, op de trap loopt een meid met een boek onder de arm. In het midden een zuil waaraan een schilderij met kinderportret hangt. Vroeger werd de jongen ten onrechte geïdentificeerd als Hugo de Groot.

artworks.title: Amsterdam as the Centre of World Trade
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: height 79.4 cm x width 165 cm x thickness 3 cm
artworks.description: This painted harpsichord lid is literally bursting with ambition. Depicted at the left is Amsterdam, personified by the City Maid. The world lies at her feet: in the distance is the African Cape of Good Hope, at the left Asia with the Indonesian archipelago, and at the right America. In the meantime, the Dutch sail en masse to these regions, conquer them, and conduct trade there. In this way the Spanish foe is thwarted, as is inscribed in Latin on the stone at the right.

artworks.title: Warrior with Drawn Sword
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 92.5 cm x width 73 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Krijgsman met getrokken zwaard. Naakt met een mantel in de arm, van voren gezien.

artworks.title: Brazilian Landscape
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 22.5 cm x width 28 cm
artworks.description: Frans Post travelled to Brazil in 1637 as part of the entourage of Governor Johan Maurits of NassauSiegen. Once there, he made paintings and drawings of the landscape. On the artist’s return to the Dutch Republic in 1644, he continued making romanticized ‘Brazilian’ landscapes, like this little panel.

artworks.title: A Musical Company in an Interior
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 7.3 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 40 cm x width 53 cm
artworks.description: Musicerend gezelschap in een interieur. Een man speelt op de cello, een vrouw op de luit en een andere vrouw zingt met een blad muziek in de handen. Rechts staan een man en een vrouw bij een schouw waarboven een schilderij met een zeegezicht hangt. Links op de voorgrond een zittende man op de rug gezien.

artworks.title: Six Wardens of the Drapers’ Guild
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 108 cm x width 143 cm × depth 8.5 cm
artworks.description: Wardens were the supervisors and governors of the Drapers’ Guild. They were responsible for inspecting fabrics, determining the types of woollens and the manner of weaving and dyeing. Pieter Pietersz’s group portrait is still firmly rooted in the 16th-century tradition of static militia company portraits, yet the many hand gestures enliven this somewhat stiff composition.

artworks.title: A Housewife in an inner Courtyard Cleaning Fish
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 45 cm x width 36 cm
artworks.description: Op een binnenplaatsje bij een schuur is een jonge vrouw bezig met het schoonmaken van vis. Links ligt een reeds schoongemaakte vis op een vergiet op een teil.Tegen de wand van de schuur hangen allerlei soorten gereedschap en huisraad. Links bij een bankje eet een kat van de vis. Rechtsonder een koperen ketel met een kool en witte rapen. Op de achtergrond twee kinderen met een hond.

artworks.title: Ships at Anchor on a Quiet Sea
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 47.5 cm x width 60.5 cm x thickness 3.3 cm × depth 8.6 cm
artworks.description: Jan van de Cappelle (1626 - 1679). Ships at anchor on a quiet sea, c. 1655. From the vantage point of an inland harbour, the painting presents a view of open sea. Here the artist was interested in recreating the atmosphere of the scene, rather than depicting a specific place or happening. From the collection of the Empress Eugenie Bonaparte (Paris) and others. Gift of Mr. and Mrs. I. de Bruijn-van der Leeuw (Muri near Bern), 1961.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Farm
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 53 cm x width 66 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met boerderij en schuur onder bomen, rechts een zittende man met een honden die uit een waterplas drinken. Pendant van een schilderij in het Mauritshuis.

artworks.title: Landscape with Cattle
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.5 cm × height 45 cm x width 58.2 cm x thickness 1.2 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met vee. Een koe en een stier in een bosachtig landschap.

artworks.title: Annunciation to the Virgin
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.5 cm × height 103.3 cm x width 93.4 cm x thickness 2.2 cm
artworks.description: De verkondiging aan Maria. Maria knielend voor een lezenaar in haar slaapkamer kijkt op van het boek dat voor haar ligt. Op de achtergrond haar bed. Links staat de engel, in de hemel God de Vader. Waarschijnlijk onderdeel van een altaarstuk met scènes uit het leven van de Heilige Maagd.

artworks.title: A young Woman
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.8 cm × height 46 cm x width 35.9 cm x thickness 2.5 cm
artworks.description: Pietro Rotari (1707 - 1762). Young woman, c. 1760. Edwin vom Rath Bequest, 1941.

artworks.title: The Mill
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 41 cm x width 30.6 cm x thickness 1.5 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Environmental concerns arose in the second half of the 19th century. As people witnessed the increasing exploitation of natural resources, there was also a growing perception that nature could be fragile and that the wilderness should be preserved. In paintings from this era, nature is no longer more powerful than humans. Instead, it actually appears smaller and less impressive. The human presence is more visible.

artworks.title: Misled: The Ambassador of the Rascals Exposes himself from the Window of 't Bokki Tavern in the Haarlemmerhout
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 157 cm x width 104 cm × depth 7.5 cm
artworks.description: 'De misleyden': de ambassadeur der Labberlotten vertoont zich voor het venster van de herberg 't Bokki ('t Bokje) in de Haarlemmerhout (een grap bedreven door Jacob Campo Weyerman en consorten in 1739). Een groep mensen kijkt naar het als een gezicht beschilderde achterwerk, uit het venster van de herberg gestoken. Aan weerszijden twee trompetters met zwart geverfde gezichten. Voor de herberg zitten twee quakers, in zwart geklede man en vrouw, bijbels in de hand.

artworks.title: Still Life with Grapes
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 12.5 cm × height 34 cm x width 54 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met trossen druiven en enkele bloemen.

artworks.title: Landscape with Cattle
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 88 cm x width 119 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met vee. Weide met liggende koeien en schapen. Links zit een herder met een stier aan een lijn. Over een weg komen twee reizigers aangelopen.

artworks.title: Interior of a Protestant Gothic Church with Motifs from the Oude and Nieuwe Kerk in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 122 cm x width 104 cm × depth 7.5 cm
artworks.description: Interieur van een protestantse gotische kerk met motieven van de Oude en de Nieuwe Kerk te Amsterdam. Gezicht in de kooromgang waar een man spreekt met een grafdelver. Bij het geopend graf spelen twee honden

artworks.title: The Sculpture Gallery of the Felix Meritis Society
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 100 cm x width 133 cm
artworks.description: In the sculpture gallery of the Felix Meritis Society, plaster casts of sculptures from Roman museums and the Musée Napoléon in Paris were exhibited against pale blue walls. De Lelie, a member of the society, portrayed himself from the back amidst the commis-sioners and directors of the scoiety’s departments.

artworks.title: The Quay de Paris in Rouen
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 88 cm x width 105 cm
artworks.description: During the Romantic era, the picturesque French city of Rouen in Normandy was a popular destination for artists. They were fond of medieval architecture and considered the great cathedrals to be an expression of pure Christian faith. The houses along the quay in this painting are situated closely together, dwarfed by the cathedral towers rising up behind them.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 61 cm x width 42.5 cm
artworks.description: The marble niche in which the Virgin and the Child are seated is a veritable sample-book of the modern Renaissance style. Pilasters and balusters, semi-circular alcoves, rams’ heads, cornucopias and scrolled acanthus leaves are typical of the new style, which was based on the architecture of Classical antiquity.

artworks.title: Portrait of Petronella Dunois
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 69.2 cm x width 57.8 cm
artworks.description: Petronella Dunois meticulously assembled the dolls’ house displayed here at the right. She commissioned various craftsmen to create each component. When she wed Pieter Groenendijk, her dolls’ house was one of the most valuable possessions she brought into the marriage, alongside customary assets such as securities and an impressive amount of linen

artworks.title: Maria of Hungary, Regent of the Netherlands
artworks.medium: plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint), wood (plant material)
artworks.dimensions: diameter 15 cm x depth 3.5 cm × diameter 9 cm
artworks.description:
Maria van Hongarije, 1505-1558, landvoogdes der Nederlanden, 1531-1555. Vermoedelijk een copie naar een verloren portret door Titiaan. Omstreeks 1550.
Deze jongere zuster van Karel V volgde in 1531 Margaretha van Oostenrijk op als landvoogdes. Toen Karel V in 1555 afstand deed trok ook Maria zich terug. Maria van Hongarije bezat een belangrijke verzameling schilderijen. Zij kende Titiaan, die portretten van haar en haar familieleden maakte.

artworks.title: Last Judgment
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 149 cm x width 175 cm × depth 14.5 cm
artworks.description: Het laatste oordeel. Christus zittend op de regenboog met links Maria en rechts Johannes de Doper. In de hemel engelen met de passiewerktuigen. Lager zitten de discipelen op wolken, boven de aarde waar de doden uit hun graven opstaan.

artworks.title: Portrait of Margaretha van Raephorst (1625-90)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 134.5 cm x width 102.5 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Margaretha van Raephorst, de echtgenote van Cornelis Tromp. Staand, ten halven lijve voor geboomte. Een jonge zwarte 'bediende' hangt een parelsnoer om de pols van de witte vrouw. Pendant van SK-A-284.

artworks.title: Country Road near Laren, (Province of North Holland)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9 cm × height 27.9 cm x width 42.9 cm x thickness 2.1 cm × weight 4 kg
artworks.description: Landweg bij Laren, Noord-Holland. Een landweg met karrensporen leidt door een bos. Een vrouw loopt met een takkenbos op haar hoofd.

artworks.title: Malle Babbe
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 76 cm x width 60 cm
artworks.description: Malle Babbe. Een lachende oude vrouw brengt een kan naar de mond. Geschilderd in de trant van Frans Hals.

artworks.title: Portrait of Eduard Wallis
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: support: height 98 cm x width 76 cm
artworks.description: The Haarlem textile merchant Eduard Wallis presents himself with one arm akimbo, a fashionable pose that was the epitome of self-assurance. Here he wears his own merchandise, very costly black-dyed cloth, the high-quality woollen fabric of the time. Wallis was married to Maria van Strijp, who also hailed from a well-to-do textile family. With their union, they consolidated their standing in the Haarlem cloth trade.

artworks.title: Boat with a Pollard Willow
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, paper, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 23 cm x width 30 cm
artworks.description: This small painting was probably executed en plein air, much as the artist in this boat is doing. A piece of paper is clipped to the lid of his paintbox. He uses a maulstick as a support while painting. The brilliant backlighting creates a powerful light-dark contrast in this painting. A striking element of the composition is the diagonal placement of the pollard willow, which blocks the view of the landscape.

artworks.title: Geertruy Haeck Kneeling in Prayer before Saint Agnes
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 62.4 cm x width 48.3 cm x height 61 cm x width 46.2 cm
artworks.description: This painting is a ‘memorial tablet’, intended to honour the memory of a deceased person. It probably hung near the tomb of Geertruy Haeck-van Slingelandt van der Tempel in the church of the convent of Saint Agnes in Dordrecht. Geertruy kneels in prayer in front of St. Agnes. Although Geertruy was not herself an ordained nun, she is dressed in a nun’s habit as a sign of her piety.

artworks.title: Landscape with Frozen Canal, Skaters and an Ice-Boat
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 47.5 cm x width 91 cm × outer size: depth 6.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Wintervermaak. IJsvermaak op een bevroren rivier, rechts een kasteel, in de verte een stadsprofiel. Op het ijs een zeilende ijsschuit, schaatsers en een slede.

artworks.title: A Farmer standing near a Hay-Stack
artworks.medium: paper, paint (coating), textile materials, pasteboard, canvas, cardboard, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 24.9 cm x width 31.9 cm × depth 1.8 cm
artworks.description: Een boer, op de rug gezien, staande bij een hooiberg. Waarschijnlijk geschilderd in de omgeving van Hattem.

artworks.title: Still Life with Roemer, Beer Glass and a Pipe
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 36 cm x width 32.5 cm × depth 5.5 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met een roemer, een bierglas, een pijp, een vuurtestje en een stuk papier met tabak.

artworks.dimensions: height 38 cm x width 45.5 cm
artworks.description: Studie van enkele pakhuizen aan de Teertuinen op het Prinseneiland te Amsterdam.

artworks.title: Portrait of Jacob Cats (1577-1660)

artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 6.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 67.1 cm x width 57 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Jacob Cats. Raadpensionaris van Holland en West-Friesland en dichter. Buste, naar rechts.

artworks.title: Peasant wedding
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 38.5 cm x width 50 cm
artworks.description: In een herberg wordt een boerenbruiloft gevierd. Aan een tafel zit rechts de bruid omringd door mannen, aan de muur achter haar hangt een wandtapijt. De bruidegom zit links van haar en drinkt zijn glas leeg. Op de voorgrond danst een oude man op de muziek van muzikanten met viool en cello. Links kijken een staande man en vrouw toe. Op de vloer liggen eierschalen, botten, een bord en een lepel.

artworks.title: The Musical Gathering
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 42 cm x width 63 cm × frame: height 58.2 cm x width 78.3 cm × sight size: height 41.5 cm x width 61.5 cm
artworks.description: Een muziekpartij of concert. Interieur met een elegant gezelschap. Links een jongen met een luit en een vrouw met een liedboek, rechts een man met een viola da gamba en een vrouw met een blad papier in de handen. Waarschijnlijk zijn de vrouwen aan het zingen. Hiertussen een minnekozend paar. Op de voorgrond op de vloer een grote metalen koeler met een fles wijn en een glas, daarachter een schalmei met bladmuziek. Op de achtergrond een tafel met een pauwenpastei , kaas en brood.

artworks.title: Wedding Feast of Saint Elizabeth of Hungary and Louis of Thuringia in the Wartburg, inner left wing of an altarpiece made for the Grote Kerk in Dordrecht
artworks.artist: Master of the St Elizabeth Panels
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 127.7 cm x width 109.5 cm
artworks.description: Scènes uit het leven van de heilige Elisabeth van Hongarije. Rechts op de voorgrond de verloving met hertog Lodewijk van Thüringen en Hessen in de tuin. Links het bruiloftsmaal op de Wartburg waaraan ook koning Andreas, de vader van de bruid, en de moeder van de bruidegom deelnamen. Drie muzikanten met fluiten en een bazuin musiceren bij het feestmaal. Op de achtergrond een landschap met kastelen en de gebouwen van een stad. Elisabeth, vergezeld van twee dienaressen Gutha en Isentrudis, belooft aan haar geestelijke leider Koenraad van Marburg gehoorzaamheid en kuisheid. Binnenzijde van het linkerpaneel, maakt deel uit van twee panelen, aan weerszijden beschilderd met voorstellingen uit het leven van de heilige Elisabeth van Hongarije (1207-31) en de Sint Elisabethsvloed 18-19 november 1421 (SK-A-3145/46 en SK-A-3147A/B).

artworks.title: Salome Dancing for Herod
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 176 cm x width 133 cm
artworks.description: Salome dansend voor koning Herodes. De koning zit rechts met enkele anderen aan een tafel waarop een pauwenpastei staat. Tegen de wand en rechts op de voorgrond staat siervaatwerk.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Receiving the Stigmata
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, biological material, panel
artworks.dimensions: height 87 cm x width 61.5 cm × height 88 cm x width 65.5 cm
artworks.description: De stigmatisatie van de heilige Franciscus van Assisi. In een rotsachtig landschap ontvangt de knielende heilige de stigmata van een gevleugelde gekruisigde Christus. Links boven op de rotsen een kerk of klooster. Met geïntegreerde lijst.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fish
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 11.5 cm × height 96 cm x width 128 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met vissen. Op een stenen plint liggen deels in een mand: kabeljauwen, moten zalm, oesters en mosselen, een krab en een paar platvissen.

artworks.title: Rape of Europa
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 31 cm x width 84 cm x thickness 2 cm
artworks.description: De roof van Europa. De koningsdochter Europa wordt door Zeus in de gedaante van een stier ontvoerd over zee. Op het strand links heffen twee dienstmaagden hun armen in wanhoop in de lucht.

artworks.title: Study of an old woman
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, paper, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.2 cm × height 31.7 cm x width 35.8 cm x thickness 1.7 cm
artworks.description: While studying at the Antwerp Academy of Fine Arts, Maris had to practise depicting facial expressions. His model’s face shows the signs of age. She has deep furrows at the corners of her mouth and around her nostrils, sunken cheeks, and grey hair. The woman’s eyes are closed, as if she has fallen asleep, or perhaps she was blind.

artworks.title: Hortensia del Prado (d 1627)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 3 cm × height 68 cm x width 52 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Hortensia del Prado. Ten halven lijve, de rechterhand voor de borst. Op de achterkant een inscriptie met de naam, drie familiewapens en het cijfer 32.

artworks.title: Two Peacocks Threatening a Hen with Chicks, Known as ‘The Threatened Hen’
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4 cm × height 115.5 cm x width 141 cm x weight 21.8 kg
artworks.description: Hondecoeter enlivened his bird paintings with little vignettes. Here the focus is on the hen protecting her chicks from the large and intimidating peacocks.

artworks.title: "Shepherds and Shepherdesses in a Landscape
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 59 cm x width 69.5 cm
artworks.description: Pastorale landschap met een herderin die een krans heeft voor een geknielde herder. Om het paar dansende nimfen of herderinnen, rechts een slapende hond. Vroeger geïnterpreteerd als een voorstelling van Amarilli en Mirtillo.

artworks.title: Pike and Perch in an Aquarium
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 100 cm x width 100 cm × depth 7.5 cm
artworks.description: In this painting a pike can be seen hiding on the bottom while a school of black-grey perch swims overhead. Sunlight shines through the water plants on the surface. Dijsselhof enjoyed studying fish in the aquarium of Amsterdam’s Artis Zoo and specialized in this type of representation. The painting gives you the impression of actually standing next to the artist and peering through the glass.

artworks.title: The Docking Basin in the Barge Canal in Leidschendam
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 39.5 cm x width 49.5 cm
artworks.description: A good public transport system by water existed in the west and north of the Netherlands from the middle of the 17th century. Horse-drawn barges were crucial to this system. An extensive network of canals crisscrossing the flat, watery countryside made it possible to travel easily and inexpensively.

artworks.title: Trekvaart
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 35 cm x width 32 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Twee schuiten langs de wal van een trekvaart. Een vrouw staat aan het roer van de achterste boot.

artworks.title: The Greengrocer's Shop De Buyskool
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 91.5 cm x width 110 cm
artworks.description: De groentewinkel 'De Buyskool'. Voor een winkel staan manden met groente en fruit uitgestald, tussen de manden zit de verkoopster met twee kinderen. Enkele klanten buigen zich over het aangeboden waar. Op straat staat een man gevogelte te verkopen, even verderop een straatverkoper met een mand.

artworks.title: Portret van een meisje
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 26 cm x width 21 cm × depth 10 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een meisje met een rode strik in het haar, driekwart naar rechts.

artworks.title: Fishing Boats on the Beach with Fishermen and Women Sorting the Catch
