artworks.dimensions: height 62 cm x width 84.4 cm x thickness 0.8 cm × depth 10 cm
artworks.description: Vissersschepen op het strand met vissers en vrouwen die de vangst sorteren. Rechts de verzamelde vrouwen met manden, in het midden een man met een jongen te paard, links de vissersschepen op het strand. Rechts in de verte bovenop de duin staat een vuurtoren.

artworks.title: Triumvirate Assuming Power in the Name of the Prince of Orange, 21 November 1813
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 70 cm x width 86.5 cm × depth 11 cm
artworks.description:
Van Hogendorp and Van der Duyn van Maasdam's declaration.
The declaration issued on 20 November announcing the fact that a temporary government had been formed in the name of the Prince of Orange.

artworks.title: Cleopatra’s Banquet
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 74 cm x width 95.5 cm
artworks.description:
Who could throw the most lavish banquet? This was the bet between the Egyptian pharaoh Cleopatra and the Roman general Mark Antony. Cleopatra won the wager by dissolving a pearl in vinegar and then drinking the mixture. In this painting, she is just
removing her earring. De Lairesse painted this story like a scene from a play, with antique costumes and classical architecture.

artworks.title: De koets van Mangkoe Nagoro IV
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: length 80 cm x width 160.7 cm
artworks.description: Haaxman made this painting as a kind of advertisement for The Hague firm of carriage makers Hermans en Co. The coach depicted was ordered by the Javanese sultan Mangkoe Nagoro IV. The Roman numeral IV, a reference to the Javanese ruler, can be seen in the Dutch coat of arms on the door of the carriage. Around 1900, the authority of the local rulers was sometimes closely intertwined with that of the colonial regime.

artworks.title: Portrait of Gerard Cornelis van Riebeeck
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 206 cm x width 122 cm
artworks.description:
The regent Gerard van Riebeeck oozes status. He is portrayed in front of Essesteijn, his country estate in Voorburg, where this painting along with the pendant of his wife Charlotte Strick van Linschoten (adjacent) hung as part of a portrait series that underscored the families’ prestige. Van Riebeeck wears a gold brocade waistcoat and matching cuffs. The abundance of buttons
embellishing his attire, many of which serve no practical purpose, is striking.

artworks.title: Portrait of Jacoba of Bavaria, Countess of Holland and Zeeland (Jacqueline, Countess of Hainaut)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 64 cm x width 50 cm × depth 5 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Jacoba van Beieren (1401-36), gravin van Holland en Zeeland. Ten halven lijve, naar rechts. Om de hals een ketting met het kruis van de Orde van St. Antonius. Linksboven het familiewapen. Zestiende-eeuwse kopie naar het origineel uit ca. 1435. Pendant van SK-A-499.

artworks.title: Church Building in Brazil
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 16.5 cm x width 25 cm
artworks.description: Frans Post spent eight years in Dutch Brazil. 35 years later, he was still painting the same ‘Brazilian’ scenes, including this one. The scene here is set against the backdrop of a meadow and features a cross between a church and a Franciscan monastery, reminiscent of structures found in coastal towns, such as Igarassu and Ipojuca in the Pernambuco region. Unlike the figures and buildings in his earlier works, the ones here are rendered quickly and crudely.

artworks.title: 'Removing the Rocks in the Head'
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 41.3 cm x width 30.9 cm
artworks.description: Het snijden van de kei. Een man zit vastgebonden in een stoel terwijl een man de kei uit zijn hoofd snijdt. Aan een tafel rechts zitten verschillende belangstellenden. Op tafel ligt een uitgesneden kei. Om de centrale ronde voorstelling heen zijn schetsmatige groteske figuren aangebracht.

artworks.title: Children with a Picture-book
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 52 cm x width 66.5 cm x thickness 2.8 cm × height 60.6 cm x width 75.1 cm x depth 10 cm
artworks.description: Kinderen met een prentenboek. Een jongen en een meisje bekijken aan een tafel een boek met plaatjes.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Van Lennep Family, a Merchant Family in Izmir
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 172 cm x width 248 cm
artworks.description: In the centre of this painting we see David George van Lennep and his wife Anna Maria Leidstar seated on a yellow divan. They belonged to the Levantine elite of the city of Smyrna (now Izmir, in Turkey). These were mostly families originally from the Netherlands who no longer spoke Dutch and had adopted Turkish customs and dress. At the far left is Anna Maria’s father, the textile merchant Justinus Leidstar.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.artist: Willem van der Vliet (signed by artist)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 92.3 cm x width 76 cm × outer size: depth 4.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Portret van een jongetje van anderhalf jaar oud. Staande, ten voeten uit, onder een boom bij een stenen bank waarop een mandje met bloemen. In de linkerhand een rammelaar. Op het hoofd een grote hoed met een brede rand, om de nek een kruis aan een lint.

artworks.title: A Mother and her Child
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 36.5 cm x width 30 cm × depth 5 cm
artworks.description: Een moeder zittend aan een tafel met haar kind op de arm drinkt uit een glas. Voor haar op de tafel staan een brood, boter, kaas en een fles. Rechts een haard.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with Merrymakers in a Cart
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 90.5 cm x width 109.8 cm
artworks.description:
A lively party of travellers in a horse-drawn wagon passing farmhouses amid the trees. Figures along the side of the country road respond as they wave exuberantly. When Meindert Hobbema painted this he was at the height of his career, having started as a pupil of Jacob van Ruisdael. While Hobbema’s landscapes often resemble those of his teacher, they are more joyful
and light. His treetops reach high into the sky and the leaves glisten in the sun. Interestingly, Hobbema’s trees are lit from behind, which enhances the sense of depth.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.5 cm × height 33.7 cm x width 44.4 cm x thickness 1 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met koeien, schapen en een paard in een drassig weiland bij een boerderij. Rechts de boerin met melkemmers.

artworks.title: Keizer Napoleon I en zijn staf te paard
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.7 cm × height 30.7 cm x width 39.8 cm x thickness 1 cm
artworks.description: Keizer Napoleon I en zijn staf te paard, in een landschap waar in de verte een veldslag woedt.

artworks.title: The Merry Fiddler
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 22 cm x width 19.5 cm
artworks.description: That this musician is jolly is clear from his large glass of white wine. And that this is not his first drink can be deduced from his dazed expression, red nose and open, dishevelled shirt. These kinds of amusing paintings by Leiden fijnschilders (‘fine painters’), such as Ary de Vois, found a ready public – perfectly executed and highly entertaining.

artworks.title: Seventeenth-century Interior
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 62 cm x width 50 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: Zeventiende-eeuws binnenhuis. Interieur met een man en een vrouw gezeten bij een tafel. De man heeft een pijp in de hand en leest een brief of pamflet. De vrouw zit links te handwerken. Op tafel staan een glazen kan en glas. Links een schouw en een schilderij. Rechts vooraan zit een kat op een stoel.

artworks.title: Flower Still Life with a Crown Imperial Fritillary in a Stone Niche
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 110 cm x width 79 cm
artworks.description:
Flower still-life painting is considered a typical Dutch genre, of which this exceptionally large picture is one of the earliest and most spectacular examples. Jacob Vosmaer painted a riot of flowers, including rare as well as precious specimens, such as the orange 
Crown Imperial (top) from Asia. He created a narrative composition by means of the blossoms’ graceful animation, the cracks in the walls, the fallen leaves and the little mouse.

artworks.title: Neighborhood Street in Rijswijk near The Hague
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, panel, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 40 cm x width 27 cm × depth 10 cm
artworks.description: Buurtje in Rijswijk. Gezicht door een straatje tussen huizen.

artworks.title: Justice
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 12 cm × height 74 cm x width 57 cm
artworks.description: Justitia. Buste van een vrouw met een kroon en een ketting met een hanger in de vorm van een oog. In een inscriptie op de achterzijde aangeduid als 'Giustitia'.

artworks.title: The Waffle Maker
artworks.artist: Alexander Hugo Bakker Korff (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6.8 cm × height 10.9 cm x width 8.5 cm
artworks.description: Bakker Korff’s usual somewhat caustic humour is absent here. The woman making waffles is painted with just as much attention as the copper pans behind her, or the marble floor on which she sits. The result is a kind of still life in which the artist displays his feeling for colour and skill in rendering different textures and materials.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape near Düsseldorf
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 62 cm x width 89 cm
artworks.description: This untamed view of nature anticipates picturesque features of Romanticism. Van Nijmegen, though, was also inspired by 17th-century Dutch painters, such as Jacob van Ruisdael. He had seen the subject of this painting – a landscape with ruins and drovers driving an ox-wagon over a wooden bridge – while travelling along the Rhine in 1788. He described it in his journal.

Het vrijend paar broedt op een nest van eieren waaruit monnikjes kruipen, onder een stoel zit een kat met een mijter op de kop.

artworks.title: Johannes Benedictus van Heutsz (1851-1924). Gouverneur-generaal (1904-09)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 141.5 cm x width 101.08 cm x thickness 4 cm × depth 9.2 cm
artworks.description: Governor General J.B. van Heutsz, by Hannké, Batavia 1909. Van Heutsz (1851-1924) was 22 years old when he joined the Dutch East Indies army. At his own request, he was posted to the rebellious Atjeh principality. Van Heutsz's career was closely tied with the struggle against Atjeh. He returned many times and argued for a more aggressive military strategy combined with administrative measures. In 1898 he was appointed governor of Atjeh. It was his chance to implement these ideas. In a series of quick campaigns he conquered large tracts of Atjeh. His fame spread. He was awarded the grand cross of the Militaire Willemsorde (Military Order of William), the highest military honour: in the portrait he is shown wearing it. Back in the Netherlands he received a hero's welcome. In 1904 he was appointed governor general of the Dutch East Indies. He remained in this post until 1909, the year this portrait was painted.

artworks.title: Portrait of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 75 cm x width 62.8 cm x depth 7.6 cm × height 57 cm x width 44.7 cm
artworks.description: As young artists, Rembrandt and Lievens shared a workshop in Leiden. Lievens painted his friend wearing a metal gorget and a beret. Rembrandt also portrayed himself in the same outfit a number of times during this period. In this little painting Lievens not only recorded his friend’s likeness, but also imitated his style, adopting Rembrandt’s characteristic dark colours, powerful contrasts of light and shade and tiny scratches in the paint.

artworks.title: Apotheosis of the Dutch East India Company (Allegory of the Amsterdam Chamber of Commerce of the VOC)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 59.5 cm x width 85 cm
artworks.description: Allegorische voorstelling met de vrouwelijke personificatie van de Amsterdamse Kamer van de Verenigde Oost-Indische Compagnie gezeten op een troon. Op het hoofd draagt zij een schepenkroon, in de rechterhand een zwaard met lauwerkrans, in de linkerhand boeken en documenten. Achter de troon Mercurius, links een zittende vrouw met een hond en een sleutel, rechts een vrouwelijke personificatie met een roer in de handen. Rechts twee putti, Neptunus en een galei bij twee zuilen. Vervaardigd naar een penning uit 1702 geslagen ter ere van het eeuwfeest van de VOC.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Man, possibly Jacob Francken (1627-after 1656)

artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.4 cm × height 15.5 cm x width 21.5 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op de Koepoort te Delft, over de brug gaan enkele figuren, links zit een jongen op een muurtje te vissen. Op de achtergrond gevels van huizen en de toren van de Oude Kerk.

artworks.title: Putti with Mirrors
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4 cm × height 30 cm x width 35 cm
artworks.description: Wolkenlucht met putti die lijsten voor spiegels of schilderijen dragen. Een putto is aan het tekenen, een ander heeft een palet en penselen in de hand.

artworks.title: The Apotheosis of Cornelis de Witt, with the Dutch Raid on the Medway in the background
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 75.5 cm x width 102 cm
artworks.description: The apotheosis of Cornelis de Witt, by J. de Baen, c. 1668. Cornelis de Witt (1623-1672) sailed with the Dutch fleet that attacked the English naval base at Chatham in June 1667 as representative of the States General. The artist has depicted the successful action in the background. In the foreground, De Witt is portrayed in fictitious dress. He is surrounded by attributes associated with war, such as a cannon and a suit of armour. To the right, a horn of plenty spills out at Cornelis's feet. An angel holds a victory wreath over his head, while Fame, floating above, sounds her trumpet. The frame is decorated with all kinds of weapons. Above: the arms of the city of Dordrecht, where Cornelis was burgomaster. Bottom: the coat of arms of the De Witt family. The painting is a replica of a larger work that originally hung in Dordrecht town hall. It was destroyed in 1672.

artworks.title: Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 31 cm x width 38 cm
artworks.description: Ludovico Mazzolino (1480 - 1528). Massacre of the Innocents, 1528. Purchased by King Willem I, 1821. On loan from the Mauritshuis, The Hague, 1948.

artworks.title: Portrait of Fernando Alvarez de Toledo, Duke of Alba
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 49 cm x width 38 cm
artworks.description: Fernando Alvarez de Toledo, Duke of Alva. Copy after Willem Key, c. 1580. The successful general, the Duke of Alva (1507-1582), was dispatched by the Spanish king to the Netherlands to suppress the insurrection. In 1567 he was appointed governor. His repressive measures led to a mass exodus. From across the frontier groups tried to undermine Spanish authority by piracy and guerrilla warfare.

artworks.title: A Mother with her Children
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.5 cm × height 32 cm x width 25 cm
artworks.description: Interieur met een moeder met haar kinderen. Een jonge vrouw zit met een ontblote borst bij een venster, op haar schoot een kind met een molentje in de hand. Door het venster kijkt een jongen naar binnen. Bij de wieg zit een hond, achter in de kamer bevindt zich een waterpomp.

artworks.title: The Lawyer's Office
artworks.medium: plant material, paint (coating), biological material, wood (plant material), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 57 cm x width 83 cm × outer size: depth 7 cm (support incl. frame and climate box)
artworks.description: Interieur van het kantoor van een advocaat. Voor de lessenaar waarachter de advocaat zit staat een rij van wachtende klanten. Aan de muren van het kantoor hangen allerlei paperassen, boeken en documenten. Tussen de klanten lopen enige honden.

artworks.title: Portrait of Anthonie van Leeuwenhoek, Natural Philosopher and Zoologist in Delft
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 56 cm x width 47.5 cm

Kniestuk, zittend aan een schrijftafel waarop een oorkonde ligt van zijn benoeming tot lid van de Royal Society te Londen door Karel II. Verder ook een globe en een inktstel; hij houdt een passer in de hand.

artworks.title: Diederik Baron van Leyden van Vlaardingen (1695-1764). Burgomaster of Leiden, with his Wife Sophia Dina de Rovere and their Sons Pieter, Jan en Adriaan Pompejus
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 88 cm x width 95 cm
artworks.description: Familieportret van Diederik baron van Leyden van Vlaardingen met zijn vrouw Sophia Dina de Rovere en hun drie zonen Pieter, Jan en Adriaan Pompejus. Het gezin bevindt zich in een interieur met links een tafel waarop enkele boeken liggen, Jan speelt met een hond. Op de vloer staat een boeket bloemen. Op de achtergrond een tuinvaas met een riviergod, rechts een doorkijk naar de tuin. De prentverzameling van Pieter Cornelis van Leyden werd in 1806 door koning Lodewijk Napoleon aangekocht en vormt de basis voor de collectie van het Rijksprentenkabinet.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 50 cm x width 40 cm × depth 10 cm
artworks.description: Attributed to Lorenzo Costa (1460 - 1535). Holy family. From the Augusteum, Oldenburg. Presented by a group of members of the Vereniging Rembrandt, 1925.

artworks.title: The Thunderstorm
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 31 cm x width 39.8 cm
artworks.description: The rapid, powerful brushwork of this landscape makes it look more like an oil sketch than a finished painting. As such, Tavenraat deviated from the path taken by most Dutch painters at the time. Instead of a smooth painting style and restrained sentiment, he opted for bright colours and dramatic effects of light and dark. His work thus more closely reflects international, mainly French, developments in Romantic painting.

artworks.title: The Good Samaritan
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 74.7 cm x width 86 cm x thickness 6.5 cm
artworks.description: Loving one’s fellow man is more important than religious belief, that is the message here: a pious man from Samaria – with turban – comforts a man who has just been violently robbed. The biblical story describes how two Jewish priests had walked past the half-dead victim. By depicting one of these (front right) as a Christian monk, the artist was clearly levelling criticism at the Catholic Church of his own time.

artworks.title: Portrait of Johan van Oldenbarnevelt
artworks.artist: workshop of Michiel Jansz van Mierevelt
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 62.5 cm x width 48.7 cm × outer size: depth 8.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: In this portrait Johan van Oldenbarnevelt is 67 years old. For close to thirty years he has held the highest governmental position in Holland and been the most powerful politician in the Republic. For a long time he is someone to contend with. Maurice is greatly indebted to him, yet after 1610 a conflict arises between them that  gravely disrupts the country. Which of them will determine the future?

artworks.title: Portrait of Philip the Fair, Duke of Burgundy
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 34 cm x width 23 cm x height 31.8 cm x width 20.6 cm × support: depth 4.5 cm
artworks.description: Philip the Fair was the son of the Holy Roman Emperor Maximilian I and Mary, Duchess of Burgundy. He wears the insignia of the Order of the Golden Fleece, a small ram’s fleece on a chain. Only the most important nobles and princes could become members of the Order of the Golden Fleece.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Family of Dirck Jacobsz Bas (1569-1637), Burgomaster of Amsterdam, and Margriet Snoeck (1588-1645)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 134.5 cm x width 248.5 cm
artworks.description: Familieportret van het gezin van Dirck Bas Jacobsz, burgemeester van Amsterdam. In het midden zit Dirck Bas Jacobsz (1569-1637) met zijn tweede echtgenote Margriet Snoeck (1588-1645). De kinderen zijn staand ten voeten uit voorgesteld (van links naar rechts): Machteld Bas (gest. 1681) met haar man Abraham de Visscher (1605-1667) en hun zoontje met een hond, Jacob Bas Dircksz (1609-1656), Agatha Bas (1611-1658), Claes Bas (1616-1635) en Lysbeth Bas (1619-1680). Rechts- en linksboven staan de familiewapens met namen.

artworks.title: The Nieuwe Kerk and the Town Hall on the Dam in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 59 cm x width 73 cm
artworks.description: This painting was made as the pendant to The Sint- Antoniuswaag in Amsterdam. In both, Ouwater plays with contrasts of light and shade in a similar fashion. The cloudy skies set the tone. The imposing town hall in the foreground is in shadow, while the Nieuwe Kerk somewhat further back is bathed in sunlight.

artworks.title: The Smoker Allegory of Transience
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 128.5 cm x width 101 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: De roker; allegorie op de vergankelijkheid. Een oude man die aan een tafel gezeten een pijp rookt, in de rechterhand een roemer, in de linkerhand een pijp. Op tafel ligt een opengeslagen boek.

artworks.title: Saying Grace
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 46.5 cm x width 40 cm × height 37.5 cm x width 30 cm
artworks.description:
Seated at a table in a run-down interior, an elderly man and a young woman pray before their meal. The
painting contains a lesson that many Dutch Protestants learned at their mother’s knee: whether you are rich
or poor, sick or healthy, be grateful for all you have, for it is a gift from God.

artworks.title: Portrait of Andries Bicker
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 93.5 cm x width 70.5 cm
artworks.description: Andries Bicker, a merchant in Russia and dealer in spices, wielded enormous administrative power. He was elected mayor of Amsterdam ten times, represented the city in the States-General, and served as ambassador to the Scandinavian nations, Poland and the Duchy of Brandenburg. When he sat to the celebrated Amsterdam portraitist Van der Helst, the Bickers were the most powerful family in the city.

artworks.title: Portrait of William III, King of the Netherlands
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10.5 cm × height 93 cm x width 62.5 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Willem III (1817-90), koning der Nederlanden. Staande, ten voeten uit, in uniform met hermelijnen mantel. De rechterhand in de zij, de linkerhand op het zwaard. Links op een kussen op een tafel liggen kroon en scepter.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 44.5 cm x width 33.5 cm × depth 6.5 cm
artworks.description: Unfortunately, the identity of this man wearing a ruff and slashed doublet is not known. The inscription at upper left reveals that he was 38 years old in 1581, when this portrait was painted. To judge from his Latin motto Patientia Spe (‘With patience and hope’), he must have been a cautious man – a trait that is certainly conveyed here.

artworks.title: Farmyard
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, paper, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 29 cm x width 28 cm
artworks.description: A solitary figure seen from the back was a frequent motif in Romantic art. Here, he walks away from us, unaware of our gaze. In this way, we are both drawn into and shut out of the picture. Absorbed by his natural surroundings, the man is immersed in his own world.

artworks.title: Moestuin

artworks.dimensions: weight 3 kg × depth 7 cm × height 27 cm x width 35 cm
artworks.description: Een man staat voorovergebogen te werken in een moestuin. Rechts een huis met geboomte.

artworks.title: Hilly Landscape with a High Road
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 28 cm x width 39 cm
artworks.description: In the 1660s Van de Velde worked every now and then with the somewhat older Haarlem painter Jan Wijnants. Van de Velde would paint the human figures and cattle in Wijnants’ landscapes. Here he has imitated such a landscape by Wijnants: a fairly bare hilly landscape with a scattering of trees, populated by tiny human figures and scores of sheep and cows.

artworks.description: Zeeslag tussen Nederlandse, Franse en een Britse schepen in Het Kanaal. Het Nederlands-Franse eskader is links afgebeeld, rechts de aanvallende Britse schepen. Op de achtergrond de duinen met een Franse kustbatterij.

artworks.title: Meisje bij een deuropening.

artworks.dimensions: height 41 cm x width 20.5 cm × depth 10 cm
artworks.description: Een meisje staande bij het venster, geleund tegen de muur, met de armen over elkaar, op het hoofd een witte muts.

artworks.title: Trading posts of the Dutch East India Company (VOC)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, linen (material), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 97 cm x width 140 cm
artworks.description: This series of paintings hanging high in a row here feature various trading posts of the Dutch East India Company (VOC) in Asia. It was a network between which not only products but also enslaved people were transported. The VOC shipped between 660,000 and 1,135,000 people in the 17th and 18th centuries.

artworks.title: View in the Woods

artworks.dimensions: depth 4.5 cm × height 41 cm x width 26 cm
artworks.description: Bosgezicht, op de voorgrond een beek.

artworks.title: A Dog with a dead Goose and Peacock (A Study of Game and Fruit)

artworks.description: Een hond bij een stilleven van gevogelte (dode gans en een pauw) en fruit (druiven, meloen, perziken en appels). Op een balustrade zit een papegaai, in de lucht enkele andere vogels. Op de achtergrond een laan in een park of tuin.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 29.5 cm x width 23.4 cm x thickness 1.4 cm × depth 4.2 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een vrouw. Buste met een dubbele gouden ketting om de hals.

artworks.title: Vrouw bij de wieg
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 33.8 cm x width 28.8 cm
artworks.description: Has the baby fallen asleep yet? A woman carefully lifts the cloth draped over the cradle. Her book of verses rests in her lap. The fall of light and warm red hues of the blanket draw attention to the woman with her child. Maes heightened the intimacy of this scene by incorporating a drawn-back curtain at the right.

artworks.title: The Poultry Seller
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 39 cm x width 32.5 cm
artworks.description: Van Mieris demonstrates his superb artistry in this painting. The dazzling array of materials and textures is a feast for the eyes. The fur of the hare, the feathers of the pheasants and ducks, the stone of the relief –all of this is rendered with the utmost, almost tangible precision. The figures are framed twice, as it were: by the arched stone window and the actual frame around the painting.

artworks.title: Jan van Speijk Debating whether to Set Fire to the Gunpowder
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 89 cm x width 75 cm
artworks.description: During the Belgian Revolution, Jan van Speijk was in command of a Dutch gunboat. When on 5 February 1831 the ship was in danger of falling into rebel Belgian hands, he decided to set fire to a keg of gunpowder. That moment is depicted here: Van Speijk has made up his mind, and his crew take to their heels. Van Speijk’s act of courage made him a national hero in the Netherlands.

artworks.title: Banquet of Eighteen Guardsmen of Squad L, Amsterdam 1566, known as 'The Perch Eaters'
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 120 cm x width 295 cm × depth 12 cm × weight 64 kg
artworks.description: Schuttersstuk met de maaltijd van achttien Amsterdamse schutters van Rot L, 1566, bekend als 'De poseters'. De schutters van de Kloveniersdoelen eten vis met brood.

artworks.title: Stilleven met vruchten en bloemen
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.6 cm × height 32.4 cm x width 24.5 cm x thickness 0.9 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met vruchten en bloemen op een tafel. In het midden trossen witte en blauwe druiven, vooraan een schaal met aardbeien en enkele perziken, abrikozen en wijnranken. Achter het fruit een boeket met papavers en veel groen. Rechts een hoog glas met deksel.

artworks.title: Satyrs Spying on Nymphs
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 37.5 cm x width 46 cm
artworks.description: Startled by the sudden appearance of the satyrs at the left, the nude nymphs flee towards the old maidservant, who is minding their clothes, at the right. The bow and the quiver indicate that these nymphs are from the retinue of Diana, goddess of the hunt.

artworks.title: Interior with Five Women
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.5 cm × support: height 94.1 cm x width 141.8 cm
artworks.description: In a stately interior, five women are making floral decorations. In Dutch, they are known as ‘klopjes’: Catholic women who have taken an oath of chastity. Unlike nuns, ‘klopjes’ participated actively in society and many of them had careers in education. ‘Klopjes’ chose not to marry, giving meaning to their life in a different way

artworks.title: Farm in a wooded dune landscape
artworks.artist: school of Jacob Isaacksz van Ruisdael
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.5 cm × height 24 cm x width 28.5 cm
artworks.description: Een boerenhuisje met een trapgevel in een duinlandschap. Voor het huis staat bij het hek een man, op de voorgrond een herder.

artworks.title: Whirling Dervishes
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 7.2 kg × height 76 cm x width 101 cm
artworks.description: Dervishes occupied a special place in religiously tolerant Istanbul. Through prayer, music and ecstatic dance, they tried to enter into a trance and thus come into contact with Allah. Twice a week they performed this dance ceremony, which visitors were allowed to watch. Vanmour must have regularly sat in the gallery to study the whirling of the dervishes.

artworks.title: Self-portrait
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), pasteboard, biological material, cardboard, paper, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 51.3 cm x width 40 cm
artworks.description: The promising painter Wouter van Troostwijk is said to have died young from a cold he caught while drawing outside at night. An artist’s life could hardly end more romantically! His atelier is pictured in this informal self-portrait, which he made shortly before his death. Grouped together on top of the cupboard are plaster casts of Classical sculptures, the models traditionally used by a painter.

artworks.title: View of an Imaginary Town across a River, with the Tower of Saint Pol in Vianen
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 4 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 64.5 cm x width 96.7 cm
artworks.description: Panoramisch rivierlandschap. Op de nabije oever enkele herders met hun vee; op de tegenoverliggende oever de stad Vianen. Op de rivier meerdere vaartuigen waaronder enkele roeiboten met vissers en een ponteveer met een aantal passagiers en een rijtuig er op. Op de voorgrond herders met vee.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: frame: height 110 cm x width 96.5 cm × sight size: height 75 cm x width 62 cm × support: height 75.4 cm x width 62.9 cm
artworks.description: Maria met kind. Maria zit op een ornamentale marmeren troon en kust het Christuskind dat op een kussen op een voetstuk naast haar zit. Het kind heeft zijn armen om de hals van zijn moeder geslagen. Maria heeft in haar rechterhand twee kersen, op de balustrade op de voorgrond liggen druiven en een appel. Door het venster links uitzicht op een landschap.

artworks.title: Interior of a Peasant Hut
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 11.5 cm × height 60 cm x width 72 cm
artworks.description: Interieur van een boerenwoning. Een oude boer zit op een stoel bij een tafel, stopt een pijp en kijkt toe hoe een kat uit een bakje eet. In de achtermuur hangt een pot boven een smeulend vuur in de haard.

artworks.title: Panoramic View of the River Spaarne and the Haarlemmermeer
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 21.3 cm x width 30 cm × sight size: height 20.9 cm x width 29.6 cm × frame: height 29 cm x width 37.7 cm
artworks.description: Vergezicht over een brede rivier. Landschap, gezien vanaf een hoge rivieroever. Links enige zeilschepen en een windmolen. In de verte een kasteel tussen bomen. Misschien is het schilderij een deel van een groter werk.

artworks.title: Paradise
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 46.6 cm x width 45.5 cm
artworks.description: The mountainous, heavily wooded landscape in this tondo is Paradise. Represented around the fountain, the source of life, are episodes from the story of Adam and Eve, the world’s first couple. The earth is encircled by two spheres, which refer to the creation of the sun, moon and stars, and to the separation of heaven from the sea.

artworks.title: Along the Coast
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 23.8 cm x width 34 cm × depth 6.5 cm
artworks.description: Een schip ligt voor anker langs de kust. Op het strand lopen enkele vissers. In de verte de rotsen van de kust.

artworks.title: Landscape with Travellers before an Inn
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outersize: depth 7.5 cm (support incl. SK-L-6127) × support: height 56.2 cm x width 83.8 cm
artworks.description: Dorpsherberg met reiswagen. Een jachtpartij van vier ruiters met honden en een overdekte reiswagen staan buiten voor een herberg. Links een veehoeder met koeien.

artworks.title: View of a Town
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 36 cm x width 27.5 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: Stadsgezicht. Gezicht door een smalle straat met aanweerszijden huizen. Een vrouw zit op een bankje voor een huis, op straat spreken twee mannen met elkaar.

artworks.title: The Tomb of Michiel de Ruyter in the Nieuwe Kerk, Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 123.5 cm x width 105 cm
artworks.description: Visitors are admiring Admiral de Ruyter’s imposing tomb monument. It occupies the place where the main altar once stood when the Nieuwe Kerk was still a Catholic church. The monumental marble tomb is a tribute to the naval hero, who died in 1667 off the coast of Sicily at the age of 69. It was designed by the sculptor Rombout Verhulst. De Ruyter’s son commissioned this painting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Greyhound and Spaniel
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 13 cm × height 83.7 cm x width 102.7 cm x thickness 3.5 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een staande hazewindhond en een liggende patrijshond, op de achtergrond een balustrade en landschap.

artworks.title: Young Woman under a Tree at Sunset, called 'Autumn'
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.6 cm × height 37.8 cm x width 21.2 cm x thickness 3.2 cm
artworks.description: Een jonge vrouw zittend onder een boom bij zonsondergang, genaamd 'Herfst'.

artworks.title: Portrait of Dina Lems
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: length 128.3 cm x width 102 cm
artworks.description: Dina Lems gestures towards a grein plant, a variety of pepper cultivated on Africa’s west coast. Her father and her first husband, Jan Valkenburgh (opposite), were employed by the Dutch West India Company. Their – and consequently her – prosperity derived from the trade in pepper, ivory, gold, and enslaved people. While Lems resided in Amsterdam, Valkenburgh spent most of their married life at Fort Elmina in Africa.

artworks.title: "Seascape with the Dutch Men-of-War including the "Drenthe" and the "Prince Frederick-Henry""
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, biological material, materials by function, panel, ink
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 70 cm x width 90 cm
artworks.description: Zeegezicht met enkele Hollandse oorlogsschepen, waaronder de Drenthe en de Prins Frederick Hendrick, rechtsvoor een sloep met zeelieden.

artworks.title: Four Regents and the ‘House Father’ of the Amsterdam Lepers’ Asylum
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 134 cm x width 209 cm
artworks.description: The men wearing hats are the regents, or buitenvaders, of the Amsterdam Lepers’ Asylum, which cared for people suffering from leprosy and other ailments. The bare-headed man at left is the binnenvader, or house father, charged with the daily running of the asylum. The relief behind the group illustrates an appropriate biblical scene: dogs licking the sores of Lazarus, a beggar afflicted with leprosy.

artworks.title: Bubble-blowing Girl with a Vanitas Still Life
artworks.artist: manner of Adriaen van der Werff
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 33.2 cm x width 29.5 cm x depth 3 cm × height 15 cm x width 11.5 cm
artworks.description: Bellenblazend meisje bij een vanitas stilleven bestaande uit boeken, een viool en een schedel .

artworks.title: A Woman with a Dog
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 49 cm x width 39.2 cm x depth 5.5 cm
artworks.description: Born in Amsterdam, Van der Mijn found his way via Düsseldorf and Antwerp to London, where he built a successful career with his finely painted portraits and scenes. The latter almost always feature a female figure in a landscape, and sometimes include a reference to a story from the Bible or Classical mythology. Whether this woman is a religious or a mythological figure is not known.

artworks.title: Still life with fish
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 66 cm x width 79.5 cm × depth 9.5 cm
artworks.description: Visstilleven. Stilleven met verschillende soorten vis (vorens, kabeljauw?) uitgestald op een tafel. Links een mand met klossen lijn en een vis als aas aan een lijn. Op de achtergrond een stok met lijn als hengel.

artworks.title: Woman Selling Herrings
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 19 cm x width 15.5 cm
artworks.description: De haringverkoopster. Een jonge vrouw, ten halven lijve, houdt in haar linkerhand een haring omhoog, rechts een houten emmer.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10 cm × height 86 cm x width 114 cm x thickness 4 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met een groep van drie personen naast een zandpad bij een bomengroep. Rechts struiken en een omgevallen boomstam, op de voorgrond drinkt een hond uit een plas.

artworks.title: The Amsterdam Four-Master ‘De Hollandse Tuyn’ and Other Ships on their Return from Brazil under the Command of Paulus van Caerden
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 144 cm x width 279 cm × overall: weight 60 kg × outer size: depth 14 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: The return of Paulus van Caerden from Brazil, 1605, by Hendrick Cornelisz Vroom, early 17th century. Since the late 16th century, as the war with Spain continued, Dutch trade in the Atlantic had increasingly gone hand-in-hand with force of arms. Privateering and plunder of overseas possessions were tried and trusted methods. Admiral Paulus van Caerden commanded a fleet that harried the Brazilian coast. In the bay of Salvador (Bahia) he captured 3,000 cases of sugar. Vroom was commissioned for this painting by the Amsterdam Admiralty. In the foreground Van Caerden is welcomed back, having been brought ashore by barge. The flag ship, the Hollandsche Tuyn, is depicted in the centre. Not long after, this massive vessel was sold off, being unable to negotiate the shallows of the Zuiderzee.

artworks.title: Self-portrait
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 26.5 cm x width 18 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: Moses ter Borch must have been barely fifteen years old when he recorded his features on this small canvas with all the skill of an experienced master. He peers  out at us with the same searching gaze with which he looked at himself in the mirror. A ray of light grazes his young adolescent face framed by golden locks of hair.

artworks.title: Bacchanal
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 63 cm x width 54.7 cm × outer size: depth 8 cm (support incl. SK-L-4263)
artworks.description: Bacchanaal met vrijende naakte paartjes in het bos. Rechts perst een man druiven uit in een drinkschaal, naast hem ligt een vrouw op de grond. Op de achtergrond slaat een vrouw op de triangel.

artworks.title: Figures before a Village Inn
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 62 cm x width 82.6 cm
artworks.description: A storm is brewing. The man at the left has clearly already had too much to drink yet is ordering more. The dangerous dagger of the man in blue signals trouble. The couple at the right makes love half-heartedly. And the portly mendicant friar absorbed in his card game … did he not take a vow of poverty? This will not end well.

artworks.title: A Couple Making Music
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.5 cm × height 49 cm x width 68 cm
artworks.description: Music-making flourished within families during the 18th century. The man here evidently plays the recorder; his wife turns the corner of a page of a music book. Behind them a full bookcase can be seen behind a slightly open curtain. Besides being a sign of refinement, the making of music together can serve as an allusion to a harmonious marriage.

artworks.title: Still Life with Implements of the Hunt
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8 cm × height 62 cm x width 76.5 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met jachtgerei. Trompe-l'oeil met een vogelkooi en verschillende objecten gebruikt bij de jacht (weitas en jachthoorn) hangend tegen een muur. Links twee ballen aan een strik, rechts een kruithoorn.

artworks.title: Ships off IJsselmonde
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 8.5 cm (support incl. frame and climate box) × support: height 42.2 cm x width 80 cm
artworks.description: Een oorlogsschip en kleinere zeilschepen voor het dorp IJsselmonde herkenbaar aan de kerk en het kasteel.

artworks.title: A Satyr
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 8.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 133.4 cm x width 173.8 cm
artworks.description:
In Greek mythology, satyrs – half-men and half-goats – were said to live in the woods and mountains. In
17th-century literature, they dwelt in the pastoral paradise of Arcadia, where one could lead a carefree life. The satyr here is presented as a shepherd of goats and sheep. He looks up from playing his flute to smile at the viewer.

artworks.title: Episode from the Four Days' Naval Battle (11-14 June 1666)
artworks.artist: attributed to Willem van de Velde (I)
artworks.date: in or after 1666 - in or before 1672
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 151 cm x width 235 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: Four Days Battle at Sea, June 1666, by Willem van de Velde I, c. 1673. The Dutch defeated the English in the Four Days Fight of 11 to 14 June 1666. This battle was a test for De Ruyter's newly equipped fleet. The Dutch ships are recognisable by the red, white and blue striped flags. Visible behind the English flagship, (centre) is the stern of the Royal Charles. This ship was captured a year later by the Dutch in the raid on Chatham.

artworks.title: Portrait of Jacoba Bontemantel (1643-?)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 73 cm x width 56 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Jacoba Bontemantel (geb. 1643) als kind. Dochter van Agatha Hasselaer en de Amsterdamse koopman Frederik Bontemantel, die in 1642 trouwden. Kniestuk, iets naar links, in de linkerhand een rammelaar.

artworks.title: Portrait of Maximilian i (1459-1519)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: painted surface: height 34.3 cm x width 24.2 cm × support: height 34.6 cm x width 24.4 cm x depth 0.6 cm × depth 4.5 cm
artworks.description: Maximilian i (1459-1519) was the Holy Roman Emperor. He was married to Mary of Burgundy. Through this marriage, the Burgundian Netherlands came into the hands of the Habsburgs.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 73 cm x width 60 cm × depth 10.4 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een onbekende vrouw, misschien de echtgenote van J.W. Beynen. Pendant van SK-A-2267.

artworks.title: Aan de Oise
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 45.9 cm x width 27.8 cm x thickness 3 cm × depth 7.8 cm
artworks.description: Aan de Oise. Gezicht op een huis met tuin tussen bomen aan de oever van de rivier de Oise. Aan de wal ligt een bootje onder een afdakje van doeken. Op de oever een kind met een geit.

artworks.title: Landscape with two Hunters
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 37 cm x width 34 cm × depth 6.5 cm × weight 3 kg
artworks.description: Landschap met twee jagers. Jagers met honden bij een landweg dat langs een duin loopt. In de verte een boerderij of buitenplaats.

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 103.5 cm x width 86.5 cm × depth 8 cm
artworks.description: Judith is a biblical heroine who saved the Jewish people from oppression by General Holofernes. She did this by entering his army camp and seducing him, after which she decapitated him with his own sword while he slumbered. Judith’s story is one of the few in the Bible in which a woman overpowers a man.

artworks.title: Portrait of Jan, Simon, and Hendrick Verstegen
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 121.5 cm x width 88.4 cm
artworks.description: Catholics in the Dutch Republic were only allowed to practise their faith secretly and formed a minority. The three brothers portrayed here were Catholic. The cross around the neck of the youngest child, Simon, references the Catholic faith. That he is depicted nude was probably to inspire the beholder to imitate Christ in his sobriety and simplicity. He would die shortly after the painting was completed.

artworks.title: A Monkey and a Dog with Dead Game and Fruit
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 121 cm x width 98 cm × depth 12 cm
artworks.description: Een stilleven met een haas en een kalkoen, vruchten bij een tuinvaas, en een hond die blaft naar een aapje dat van het fruit eet.

artworks.title: "Naval Battle between Michiel Adriaenszoon de Ruyter and the Duke of York on the ""Royal Prince"" during the Battle of Solebay, 7 June 1672:  episode from the Third Anglo-Dutch War"
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 112 cm x width 182 cm × depth 8.8 cm
artworks.description: Het gevecht van Michiel Adriaenszoon de Ruyter tegen de hertog van York op de 'Royal Prince' tijdens de zeeslag bij Solebay, 7 juni 1672: episode uit de Derde Engelse Zeeoorlog (1672-74). In het midden vaart het Engelse schip, zonder het bovendeel van de mast. Rond dit schip zeilen enkele kleine schepen.

artworks.title: The Dance
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9 cm × height 41.1 cm x width 31.4 cm x thickness 0.9 cm
artworks.description: De dans. Interieur waarin een jonge vrouw danst en een jonge man viool speelt.

artworks.title: Arcadian Landscape
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 68.3 cm x width 83.3 cm x thickness 2.8 cm
artworks.description: Arcadisch landschap. Herder en herderin met een kudde schapen rustend onder bomen aan de voet van een antiek grafmonument.

artworks.title: Portret van Filips de Goede, hertog van Bourgondië
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: diameter 38.7 cm (incl. original frame) x thickness 3.3 cm (painted surface)
artworks.description:
Philip the Good, the great-great-grandfather of Emperor Charles V, founded the Order of the Golden Fleece in 1430.
This exclusive chivalric order was primarily intended to strengthen the ties between the court and the nobility. The insignia of this prestigious group of nobles is a golden ram’s fleece, complete with head and legs, hanging from a chain. It can be seen here around the sitter’s neck and in the background surrounding the coat of arms.

artworks.title: Portrait of Govert van Slingelandt (1623-1690), with his First Wife Christina van Beveren (1632-1656) and their Two Children
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 100.3 cm x width 86.8 cm
artworks.description: Familieportret van Govert van Slingelandt, heer van Dubbeldam, pensionaris van Dordrecht. Met zijn eerste vrouw Christina van Beveren en hun beide zoontjes Barthoud en Govert Johan van Slingelandt zittend onder een boom in een landschap. De oudste zoon heeft een tros druiven in de handen. De jongste zoon zit bij zijn moeder op schoot en blaast bellen. Rechts een hondje.

artworks.title: The Caulking of Ships at the Bothuisje on Het IJ in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 49 cm x width 64 cm
artworks.description: Caulking the ships on the IJ at Amsterdam by Reinier Nooms, mid 17th century. Wooden sailing ships needed constant maintenance. They had to be examined after every voyage. To close gaps in the ship's outer planking with pitch and old rope(caulking), the vessel was careened on to its side bringing the hull out of water. Big ships only came into the harbour if they were due for repairs or to be laid up. Otherwise, they would remain out in the open water: in front of the line of posts (left) that protected the city and harbour from the IJ. The cargo was transported to and from the quay in smaller boats.

artworks.title: Portrait of Reinoud III of Brederode
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 78.6 cm x width 67 cm x height 77.2 cm x width 67 cm
artworks.description: Reinoud III of Brederode is portrayed here as a high official – with the insignia of the Order of the Golden Fleece, wearing expensive clothes and holding a richly decorated dagger in his hand. The nobleman was one of the chief supporters of Emperor Charles V, serving him in all kinds of important administrative roles.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Venetian Family with a Manservant Serving Coffee
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 60.2 cm x width 48.2 cm
artworks.description: In his paintings, Longhi usually poked gentle fun at the everyday activities of the Venetian elite. This is not, however, the case here. It is simply a portrait of a family drinking coffee, with the lady of the house taking centre stage. The conspicuous inclusion of the servant is noteworthy. He must have been a valued member of the household.

artworks.title: The Wine Connoisseurs
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 7.5 cm (support incl. frame and climate box) × support: height 44.7 cm x width 72.2 cm
artworks.description: De wijnproevers. In een wijnkelder houdt een man een glas met wijn tegen het licht. Rechts een rij wijnvaten, op de achtergrond kijken een man en een vrouw toe. Links op een houten bank liggen allerlei soorten gereedschap: emmers, slangen, blaasbalg etc.

artworks.title: The Impassioned Grape Picker
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 22.2 cm x width 17.3 cm × depth 5.7 cm
artworks.description: De verliefde wijngaardenier. Tijdens het druivenplukken grijpt een man een jonge vrouw om de middel. Zij spreekt hem met opgeheven vinger toe.

artworks.title: The Shelling of ’s-Hertogenbosch by the French
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 47 cm x width 62 cm
artworks.description: At the request of the Patriots, a French army invaded the Dutch Republic in September 1794. After a siege lasting more than two weeks, ’s-Hertogenbosch was captured on 10 October. The city was shelled –even at night –with cannons set up by the French. To keep out the attackers, a large area around the city was flooded.

artworks.title: Two Views of Dutch East India Company Trading Posts: Lawec in Cambodia and Banda in the Southern Moluccas
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, linen (material), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 97 cm x width 140 cm
artworks.description: From 1609 the East India Company was sailing to Lawec, near Phnom Penh. There the company purchased provisions, such as rice, butter, pork, and lard, for Batavia. Banda supplied mace and nutmeg. In 1621, Governor-General Coen punished the island for trading with other countries: all fifteen thousand islanders were killed or driven away. The ‘slaughterer of Banda’ founded nutmeg parcels, heavily guarded by forts.

artworks.title: Tobias and the angel
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4 cm × height 16.5 cm x width 24 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met Tobias en de engel, de engel wijst Tobias op de vis in het water van een meertje onder bomen. Tobias heeft een hond bij zich, links op de achtergrond herders met schapen.

artworks.title: Allegory of Nature as the Mother of Art
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 15 cm × height 159 cm x width 189 cm
artworks.description: A partially nude woman sprinkles milk from her breast on a man’s viol. This enigmatic scene may represent Mother Nature, who inspires and nourishes Art. Van Hemessen was a leading Antwerp painter in the second quarter of the 16th century. His figures betray a marked Italian influence, especially in his use of soft, ‘smoky’ contours, the so-called sfumato painting technique.

artworks.title: Of One Heart
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 102 cm x width 120 cm
artworks.description: Cornelis Kruseman was sometimes called ‘Italian Kruseman’ owing to his love for Italian art. After spending time in Rome (1821-1825), he worked in the Netherlands in the idealized style that he knew from Italy. This trio of young musicians in folk costume is a fine example of this. In contrast to Piety, also in this gallery, by the time Kruseman painted Of One Heart, he had virtually abandoned Dutch realism.

artworks.title: Portrait of Suzanna Cornelia Mogge and her Daughter Johanna Ferdinanda van Collen
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 80 cm x width 64 cm
artworks.description:
This portrait captures the 23-year-old Susanna Mogge on the occasion of her marriage to the banker Hendrik Muilman. Behind her hangs the portrait of her first, deceased husband, the little girl’s father. Upon marrying Muilman, Mogge brought with her Haamstede Castle near Zierikzee and the Zeeland seigneuries of Koudekerke and Welland. Her blue gown and high-coiffed 
hairstyle allude to the festivities surrounding this wedding.

artworks.title: Aert van Nes (1626-1693), Vice Admiral
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9.5 cm × height 139 cm x width 125 cm
artworks.description: Aert van Nes and his wife Geertruida van Dubbelde, by Bartholomeus van der Helst, 1668. (Background scenes painted by Ludolf Bakhuysen). High-ranking naval officers commanded considerable respect in the Republic. Here, Lieutenant-Admiral Van Nes (c. 1625-1693) and his wife show off their status. The couple had their portraits painted by one of the leading portrait artists of the day. Their clothes are obviously expensive, and Geertruida's jewellery is equally costly. She is pointing to her husband, whose position has brought them prosperity. In the background of the portrait, the ships anchored in the safety of the harbour illustrate her role; the battle in the background of Van Nes's portrait refers to his. He is holding a baton, signalling his naval rank. A servant (his hat submissively in his hand) is bringing a message.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Kings

The infant Christ sits on the lap of his mother, the Virgin Mary, while the three kings present him with gifts. It is striking that the figures are shown crowded together and in fairly stiff, static poses. Ter Brugghen’s style was old-fashioned by the standards of his time:
the bright palette recalls Mannerism. The realism, especially in the Child’s face, brings to mind the work of the Italian painter Caravaggio.

De Engels-Nederlandse vloot overmeestert de Spaanse zilvervloot in de baai bij de Spaanse stad Vigos

De pas onder Frans convooi uit West-Indië teruggekeerde Spaanse zilvervloot lag in de baai verschanst. Desondanks slaagden 4000 man erin aan land te komen. The men of Cornelis Bicker served as a guard of honour when Maria de' Medici visited Amsterdam in 1638. They made this proud achievement the theme of their group portrait. The riflemen are grouped around a marble bust of Maria de' Medici. The sheet of paper beneath the bust contains a poem devoted to this painting by the famous 17th-century Dutch poet Vondel. Profits were for the Dutch treasury. The Javanese population, on the other hand, had to work harder and received less money because of this policy.

artworks.title: Poor Folk Drinking in a Tavern
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: inlaid support: height 19.7 cm x width 27.6 cm × original support: height 18.7 cm x height 19.2 cm x width 25.6 cm
artworks.description: Adriaen Brouwer (1605/06 - 1638). Peasant drinking bout, c. 1625/1627. In a miserable room full of peasants, drinking and smoking, depicts the intoxicating consequences of tobacco and alcohol. One group of men are shouting drunkenly, a women lying on the floor has fallen asleep, totally unaware of her howling child. The sleeping man has his hand in his coat, which at the time was a clear reference to sloth, one of the seven cardinal sins. Brouwer employed a modicum of resources to portray these peasant types. Starting with a brown undercoat, he painted the composition in light strokes of grey, reddish brown and pink; a few clear colours served as accents. Acquired together with the Van Heteren Gevers collection, The Hague- Rotterdam, 1809. On loan to the Mauritshuis in The Hague from 1948 to 2002.

artworks.title: Portrait of Elisabeth van Oosten (1660-1714), as a Child
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 118 cm x width 83 cm × depth 7.5 cm
artworks.description: W.J. Ploy (attributed), 1663. Elisabeth van Oosten (1660 - 1714), half-sister of Johannes van Rees, as a child. Oil on canvas. This portrait is traditionally assumed to show a member of the Van Riebeeck family. Jan van Riebeeck (1619 - 1677) arrived at Cape of Good Hope in 1652 and established a supply base for VOC ships sailing to Batavia (Jakarta). The actual identity of the subject is not certain.

artworks.title: "The Groenlandvaarder ""Zaandam"" of the Shipping Company Claes Taan and Son, Zaandam, on a Whale Hunt"
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5 cm × height 99 cm x width 126.8 cm x thickness 3 cm
artworks.description: The Greenlandman 'Zaandam ' in the Whaling Grounds, by Joghem de Vries, 1772 .The Dutch had been hunting whales in the Arctic Ocean since the early 17th century. Oil that was extracted from the whale blubber, was used, among other things, as light fuel. Many Dutch whaling vessels sailed from Zaandam. The painter Joghem de Vries was also from Zaandam. It was there that he painted this picture of the 'Zaandam '. The ship, owned by the Zaan company of Claas Taan and Sons, was one of 38 Dutch whalers that sailed to the Davis Strait between Greenland and the North American coast in 1772. The 'Zaandam' returned with 240 barrels of blubber, taken from five whales. Altogether, the fleet killed 240 whales that year. De Vries painted other ships too. On the left is a vessel carrying the Danish flag. Two Eskimos are rowing in their kayak. And in the foreground, the men of the 'Zaandam ' have just harpooned a whale.

artworks.description: Het laatste oordeel. Krioelende mensenmassa met bovenin Christus gezeten op wolken tussen Maria, heiligen en apostelen. Linksboven engelen met het kruis. In het midden twee engelen, één met een boek en een zwaard, de ander met een weegschaal. Aan de linkerzijde worden de uitverkorenen met hulp van engelen naar boven geleid, rechts tuimelen de verdoemden tussen duivels naar beneden in de vlammen van de hel.

artworks.description: Dorpelingen. Een meisje staat geleund tegen een houten schutting met een breiwerk in de handen. Een buurvrouw met een kind op de arm leunt over de schutting om een praatje te maken. In de verte scheepsmasten.

artworks.title: Pan and Syrinx
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), hardwood, biological material, panel, oil paint (paint), oak (wood)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 49.3 cm x width 36.8 cm
artworks.description: The nymph Syrinx is on the run, with the forest god Pan, hidden among the dense vegetation, in hot pursuit. Van Everdingen captures the dramatic moment of the metamorphosis as Syrinx implores the river nymphs for help. They transform her into water reeds. Her right foot is already turning green. Disappointed, Pan listens to the wind playing through the tall reeds and subsequently cuts his flute from them.

Vervaardigd in 1624-25 als deel van een reeks van acht schilderijen voor de kapel van de sacramenten in de kerk San Paolo fuori le mura te Rome.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit and Flower Garlands
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), wood board, biological material, panel, particle board, oil paint (paint)

artworks.description: Deel van negendelige kamerbeschildering voor het huis Beekhoven, later het Hoogerhuis genoemd, bij Randenbroek bij Amersfoort, het buitenhuis van Jacob van Campen.

artworks.title: Bacchus and Ariadne
artworks.dimensions: height 0 x width 0
artworks.description: De Lairesse painted a classic tale from the Metamorphoses by the Roman poet Ovid. Princess Ariadne is abandoned by her lover on the island of Naxos. There, she meets Bacchus, the god of wine, who instantly falls in love with her and grants her immortality. As a wedding gift, he transforms her crown into the constellation Corona Borealis ensuring that she will be remembered forever. In the painting, her starry crown shines bright amidst the pink clouds.

artworks.title: The Battle of Cadiz
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 40.3 cm x width 83.8 cm × outer size: depth 5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Tijdens de Slag bij Cadiz op 1 juli 1596 verenigden de Hollanders en Engelsen hun krachten in hun strijd tegen de Spanjaarden. Hier wordt de Hollandse viermaster Neptunes van admiraal Johan van Duivenvoorde gesteund door de Engelse Ark Royal in een aanval op de Spaanse San Felipe. In werkelijkheid nam het Engelse schip geen deel aan de slag. Aert Anthonisz gaf het vaartuig weer omdat het zo'n belangrijk symbool was voor de Engelse zeemacht.

artworks.description: Gefantaseerd stadsgezicht, geïnspireerd op de Kolksluis te Amsterdam. Op het water varen enkele boten, rechts wassen vrouwen in het water.

artworks.title: Madonna of Humility

artworks.dimensions: height 100.5 cm x width 60.5 cm x depth 9.5 cm × height 76.5 cm x width 53.5 cm
artworks.description:
Agnolo Gaddi was one of the leading painters in late 14th-century Florence. He worked in the direct tradition of Giotto, the founder of Florentine painting. This panel shows the Virgin seated humbly on a richly decorated cushion while nursing the Christ Child. This scene is
typical of the devotional art of this period.

artworks.title: Odysseus and Calypso

artworks.dimensions: height 125 cm x width 94 cm
artworks.description: The Greek poet Homer recounts how the heroic warrior Odysseus found refuge on the island of the nymph Calypso. The Trojan War is over: Amor, the god of love, now teasingly places the battle helmet on Calypso’s head. Odysseus and Calypso instantly fall in love. This painting hung in the Soestdijk hunting lodge, in the apartment of Mary Stuart, the consort of William III.

artworks.title: Regents and Regentesses of the Lepers' Asylum, Amsterdam, 1834-35

artworks.description: Groepsportret van de regenten en regentessen van het leprozenhuis van Amsterdam 1834-35. Zittend rond een tafel: Ludovicus Hamerster Ameshoff, Jan van der Meer de Wijs, Michiel Abraham van Peene Pietersz, Jacoba Wilhelmina de Meyn, née van der Meulen, Sara Maria Joanna van der Poorten van Vollenhoven, née Berg en Catharina Elisabeth van Vloten, née Bagman. Op tafel liggen boeken en papieren en een inktstel, tegen een tafelpoot meer boeken geleund. Op de achterwand een schilderij van het Stadhuis op de Dam.

artworks.title: The Smoker
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), hardwood, biological material, oak (wood), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 29.7 cm x width 21.5 cm
artworks.description: Slouching in his chair, with his breeches open, the man blows smoke from his pipe through his nose. His eyes are glazed, as though he is in a stupor. In the 17th century smoking had fervent supporters as well as opponents. Some scholars held that tobacco smoke was therapeutic for both body and spirit; others were convinced that pipe-smoking was as harmful as excessive drinking.

artworks.description: Portret van Johan Wolphert van Brederode, op een wit paard, naar links galopperend. Op de achtergrond een landschap met een kasteel tussen bomen.

artworks.description: Maria Magdalena, zittend tussen rotsen, met ontblote boezem en met de linkerhand op een schedel. Boven twee putti. Kopie naar het origineel in een privé collectie te Rome.

artworks.title: Deathbed of the Rich Man, with a Devil Descending to Retrieve the Deceased's Soul
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 208 cm x width 122 cm × height 225.5 cm x width 135.3 cm x depth 7.8 cm
artworks.description: Het rechter zijpaneel van een drieluik met op de binnenzijde het sterfbed van de rijke man. Slaapkamer waarin de rijke man in bed ligt omgeven door dokters, familie en vrienden. Naast het bed wordt geld geteld. Een duivel daalt af om de ziel van de overledene op te halen. Op de buitenzijde van het paneel een terras waarop beelden staan van de heilige Andreas en van de aartsengel Michael die de draak verslaat. Pendant van SK-A-3914. Verso een grisaille. Met geïntegreerde lijst.

artworks.title: Study of Sijtje van Bemmel (1880-1963)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
