artworks.description: Studie van het model Sijtje van Bemmel, een buurmeisje, op zestienjarige leeftijd. Buste naar rechts met een hoed met bloemen.

artworks.title: Pieter Schout on Horseback
artworks.medium: metal, paint (coating), inorganic material, copper (metal), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: frame: height 104.4 cm x width 89 cm × support: height 86.1 cm x width 69.6 cm × sight size: height 82.8 cm x width 67.2 cm
artworks.description: Equestrian portraits were traditionally the reserve of princes. Accordingly, in the Netherlands very few equestrian portraits were made, except for the court. Only a handful of burghers had themselves immortalized on horseback. Pieter Schout was one such citizen who assumed a princely air. He was bailiff – administrative officer – of Hagestein on the River Lek.

artworks.title: Trading posts of the Dutch East India Company (VOC)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, linen (material), oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 97 cm x width 140 cm
artworks.description: This series of paintings hanging high in a row here feature various trading posts of the Dutch East India Company (VOC) in Asia. It was a network between which not only products but also enslaved people were transported. The VOC shipped between 660,000 and 1,135,000 people in the 17th and 18th centuries.

artworks.title: Portrait of Henrick Hooft
artworks.artist: Michiel Jansz van Mierevelt (signed by artist)
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 9.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 69.7 cm x width 60 cm
artworks.description: The demand for portraits in the Netherlands was great in the 17th century. Michiel Jansz van Mierevelt was the most productive and successful portraitist in Delft: according to a somewhat exaggerated contemporary account, the artist painted around 10,000 portraits. His fame extended beyond the city limits. Both in their twenties, Henrick Hooft and Aegje Hasselaer of Amsterdam had themselves eternalized in paint by him on the occasion of their marriage.

artworks.title: A Family beside the Tomb of Prince William i in the Nieuwe Kerk, Delft
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 74 cm x width 110 cm
artworks.description: The tomb of William of Orange became a much-visited attraction from the moment it was completed in 1621. People like this family – a father, mother and two sons, all dressed in restrained, decorous black – even had painters immortalize them standing next to the monument as evidence of their solidarity with the ‘Father of the Fatherland’.

artworks.title: Interior with Woman at the Spinning Wheel
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 9 cm × height 60 cm x width 49 cm
artworks.description: Interieur met een vrouw aan het spinnewiel, naast haar warmt een man zich bij de haard. Kamer met rode tegelvoer en glas-in-loodramen. Op de schouw boven de haard staan enkele borden.

artworks.title: Landschap met de molen van Wijk bij Duurstede
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.8 cm × height 14 cm x width 23.5 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met de molen van Wijk bij Duurstede, rechts een rivier.

artworks.title: Morning Visit
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 53 cm x width 43 cm
artworks.description: The greengrocer has delivered his produce and before moving on has a chat with the maidservant. De Lelie painted this old Dutch kitchen scene in the tradition of 17th-century genre painting. He was interested in rendering the various details as faithfully as possible: the baskets of vegetables, the earthenware jug, the pewterware on the fireplace mantel and the brassutensils against the white tiles.

artworks.title: Winter
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.5 cm × height 101 cm x width 98 cm
artworks.description: Jacob de Wit painted this overdoor, an allegory of Winter, for the house of Cornelis Hop, who later became burgomaster of Amsterdam. Summer and Autumn are also on view in this room. With smoothly executed scenes in white and grey paint (grisailles), De Wit emulated stucco or marble reliefs, thereby imitating sculpture. In Dutch these kinds of paintings were called ‘witjes’, a play on the artist’s surname, Wit (Dutch: ‘white’).

artworks.title: The Bridge
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 11 cm × height 42 cm x width 73.5 cm
artworks.description: Jacob Maris painted this bridge in The Hague, his city of residence. The farmer’s wife carrying two pails of milk with a yoke and the farmer in the sand barge attest to just how rural The Hague was at the time. A sketch of the same motif is also on display in this gallery. Maris captured the scene with powerful strokes. He made the sketch out of doors, and the worked-up painting in his studio.

artworks.title: Soldier Scene
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 30.5 cm x width 24.5 cm
artworks.description: Soldatenscène. Op de voorgrond een zittende soldaat met een roemer in de rechterhand en een trompet of bazuin, tussen de benen omhoog stekend, in de linkerhand. Hij leunt op een tafel waarop een pijp, tabak, kaarten, een testje en een fles staan. Op de achtergrond kust een soldaat een vrouw.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 73.3 cm x width 62 cm x thickness 3.2 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Madonna met het Christuskind staande op een kussen voor zich. Maria heeft in de rechterhand een boekje, met de linkerhand ondersteunt zij het voetje van het Christuskind.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: height 22.7 cm x width 45.3 cm x depth 3.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 14.7 cm x width 37.3 cm
artworks.description: Lente. Op een weg langs een rivier is een ruiter van zijn paard gestegen om een praatje te maken met een elegante vrouw, rechts een bedelaar. Tussen de figuren zitten drie honden, in de verte wandelaars en een rijtuig. Onderdeel van een reeks met de vier jaargetijden, SK-A-1771/1774.

artworks.title: Arcadian Landscape, one of a series of ten murals in the garden room of the main floor of the Amsterdam house Herengracht 524

artworks.dimensions: height 325 cm x width 245 cm
artworks.description: Wandschildering tegenover de schoorsteenmantel. Uit een serie van tien wandschilderingen met arcadische landschappen in de kamer aan de tuinkant op de hoofdverdieping van het huis Herengracht 524 te Amsterdam.

artworks.title: Self-portrait with the Portrait of his Wife, Margaretha van Rees, and their Daughter Maria
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 81 cm x width 65.5 cm
artworks.description: Around 1700, Adriaen van der Werff was the most celebrated Dutch painter. The German elector Johann Wilhelm von der Pfalz appointed him as his most highly paid court painter and presented him with a medallion bearing his portrait on a gold chain. Van der Werff here proudly displays his paintbrushes and palette, together with a gilt-framed portrait of his wife and daughter. The medallion hangs from his neck.

artworks.title: Anchorage at Bremerhaven
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 90.5 cm x width 133 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: Een aantal zeilschepen op woelig zee voor de rede van Bremerhaven. Op de voorgrond een sloep.

artworks.title: Portraits of Sir Thomas Gresham and Anne Fernely
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 88 cm x width 75.5 cm
artworks.description: Sir Thomas Gresham (1519–1579) was the leading English merchant in Antwerp and also the English king’s financial agent in the Low Countries. He and his wife, Anne Fernely, are expensively, yet soberly dressed. Their status is also evident in their choice of painter: Anthonis Mor was one of the pre-eminent portraitists of his day and court painter to the Spanish king.

artworks.title: Landscape with an Oncoming Rainstorm
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 56 cm x width 72 cm × depth 10.4 cm
artworks.description: These shepherds seem to enjoy a simple and peaceful existence in a wide meadow. However, the life of farmers and shepherds was harder in reality. Before 1850, artists did not paint outdoors: paint tubes did not yet exist, so working en plein air was impractical. Therefore, artists used sketches of what they saw to create landscape compositions back in their studio.

Naast de vader luistert een jonge vrouw, links van haar staat een jonge man te gapen. Een jongen kijkt door het venster links naar binnen. Links een spinnewiel, rechts een kat bij een wasmand. Aan de wand hangen een klok en een geweer.

artworks.title: A Bathing Nymph Taken by Surprise by a Satyr
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 58.2 cm x width 50.6 cm
artworks.description:
At the edge of a forest with striking, eccentrically shaped trees, a bathing nymph is surprised by a satyr
(a woodland creature from Greek mythology), who suddenly leaps out at her. In the background is a second satyr playing a flute. Van Wtenbrouck painted mainly landscapes with mythological or biblical subjects, a genre that at the time was in great demand by literate patrons.

artworks.title: The Entry of the French Ambassador into Venice in 1706
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 130 cm x width 260 cm x depth 9.5 cm
artworks.description: Large-scale painted views of Venice were very popular among tourists and collectors throughout the 18th century. In this early example of the genre, the city’s buildings provide the backdrop for an important event, the ceremonial entry of the French ambassador, Henri-Charles Arnauld de Pomponne. His elaborately decorated gondolas are being moored along the quay before the Doge’s Palace.

artworks.title: Conquest of Palembang, Sumatra in Indonesia, by Lieutenant-General De Kock, June 24, 1821
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8 cm × height 75 cm x width 98 cm
artworks.description: The Conquest of Palembang by General De Kock, 24 June 1821 by J.H.L. Meijer, 1857. Britain tried to retain its influence in Sumatra by supporting resistance against the Dutch by the sultanate of Palembang in southeast Sumatra. In 1821 a military expedition commanded by General H.M. de Kock (1779 - 1845) succeeded in capturing the sultan's kraton (palace). The sultan and his family were taken prisoner, their property was confiscated and divided as warbooty. A few years later, the sultanate was dissolved. Louis Meijer (1809 - 1866) was commissioned by the De Kock family to portray the scene thirty-six years later. He used a sketch by P. le Comte, a naval officer who had taken part in the conquest of Palembang.

artworks.title: The Nieuwe Haarlemse Sluis at the Singel, known as ‘Souvenir d’Amsterdam’
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 46.5 cm x width 35 cm
artworks.description: When Jacob returned to the Netherlands, Matthijs had to support himself in Paris. His financial worries explain why he reused an already painted canvas for this work. Beneath this city view is a landscape with a ferry; probably an oil sketch Jacob had left behind. Parts of this underlying composition are still visible. The bright green brushstrokes in the brown foreground at the right are from the overgrown bank underneath.

Rechts een herder met een fluit, links van hem een jonge vrouw die zingt, in haar rechterhand houdt zij een stuk papier waarop een lied (?) is gedrukt. In het midden houdt een vrouw met ontblote borsten een druiventros omhoog, in haar schoot liggen meer vruchten. Links een herderin met een staf en een brede hoed, op de rug gezien.

artworks.title: Travellers at Rest
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 36.9 cm x width 30.3 cm
artworks.description: After 1670, Van Ostade mainly painted outdoor scenes, extolling unhurried, simple country life. The men drink beer and smoke their pipes. In the 17th century, Dutch people smoked so much that, according to foreign travellers, the smell of the Low Countries was the smell of tobacco. The most and best tobacco was cultivated in North and South America by people in slavery and shipped to the Netherlands for resale to other countries.

artworks.title: Portrait of Joris van Egmond
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)

artworks.title: A Woman
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: painted surface: height 62.8 cm x width 48 cm × support: height 64.3 cm x width 49.5 cm
artworks.description:
In Northern Europe portraits were less idealized than in Italy. That is not to say that the women there were more modest. While this lady presents an unadorned face, her clothes are particularly sumptuous. Her gown is made of brown silk damask and the pinkish-red underdress is interwoven with gold thread. She was undoubtedly wealthy and came from the vicinity of Haarlem or from Mechelen, where Mostaert was
also active.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Nobleman, possibly Adriaan van der Borcht
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 8 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 201 cm x width 138 cm
artworks.description: Anthony van Dyck (1599 - 1641). Portrait of Nicolaes van der Borcht, merchant of Antwerp, c. 1634/1635. The coat of arms on the red curtain tells us that this gentleman was a member of the Antwerp merchant family of Van der Borcht, probably Nicolaes, who died in 1658. Nicolaes is pointing to a sea battle to his left. It is a fight between Spanish and Southern-Netherlandish privateers. The city in the background is Dunkirk, which in the seventeenth century was a notorious pirates' nest. His proud gesture suggests that Van der Borcht was himself involved in the lucrative business of pirateering. Anthony van Dyck had an atelier which relieved him of a great deal of work, a fact to which this portrait testifies. Van Dyck painted Van der Borcht's head and hands himself, but left the rest of the work to his associates. Here the vague outlines of two extra feet are just visible beneath the topmost layer of paint, indicating that in an earlier state the legs of the subject were further apart. Acquired through exchange with the Mauritshuis, The Hague, 1825.

artworks.title: The Art Gallery of Josephus Augustinus Brentano

artworks.description: The art collector Brentano had the picture gallery in his Amsterdam canal house decorated in a classical style. The bright colours, fanciful ornaments, and light-coloured figural friezes were inspired by the then recent excavations at Herculaneum and Pompeii in Italy. A company of men, women, and children has gathered to admire Brentano’s new acquisitions. Near the easel at the right is a group of artist friends, while in the middle Brentano himself shows two other guests an Italian painting.

artworks.title: Winter Scene
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 51.5 cm x width 67.4 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: Jan van de Cappelle (1626 - 1679). Winter scene, c. 1653. Jan van de Cappelle is admired primarily for his atmospheric seascapes, but this winter landscape is also impressively rendered. Tones of whitish grey and grey evoke the bleakness of winter. It is cold, the canal is frozen, and dark clouds indicate that there is more snow on the way. Van de Cappelle devoted careful attention to the details: the white frost on the trees, the holes cut in the ice, and the axe left behind. Gift of Mr. and Mrs. I. de Bruijn-van der Leeuw (Muri near Bern), 1961.

artworks.title: Reception of the Dutch ambassador Hieronymus van Beverningk by the Spanish queen-regent Maria-Anna of Austria, 2 March 1671

artworks.dimensions: depth 10.5 cm × height 70 cm x width 79 cm
artworks.description: Reception of the Dutch ambassador Hieronymus van Beverningk by the Spanish queen-regent Maria-Anna of Austria, 2 March 1671, by Caspar Netscher. The expansionist policies of France's King Louis XIV forced the Republic to look for allies. In 1670 a pact was agreed with Spain. Maria Anna of Austria, the Spanish queen regent, received the Dutch diplomat Hieronymus van Beverningk in secret on 2 March 1671 in Madrid. The queen regent is dressed as an abbess (head of a convent). Standing behind the table is one of her advisors. The woman on the right in the foreground is Joanne le Gibbon, wife of Van Beverningk.

Op het rechter zijpaneel snijdt een geleerde in zijn werkkamer een pen bij het licht van de kaars. De pennensnijder symboliseert oefening. (voor het middenstuk en linker zijpaneel zie SK-A-2320-A/B)

artworks.title: Portrait of Helena Fourment (1614-1673), the Artist’s Second Wife
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 75 cm x width 55.6 cm × outer size: depth 12 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: School of Peter Paul Rubens (1577 - 1640). Portrait of Hélène Fourment, c. 1630/1631. This portrait of his second wife Hélène Fourment is quite different from Rubens' state portraits. In Munich there is a painting of her in which Rubens has depicted her standing. This work from the Rijksmuseum, presumably done in Rubens' atelier, is based on the Munich portrait. Rubens married Hélène when she was 16. He wrote to a friend that after the death of his first wife he had no desire to live a celibate life. He chose someone from the bourgeoisie, rather than a noblewoman, so that 'she would not be ashamed when she saw me taking up the brushes.' Bequest of A. van der Hoop, 1854. On loan from the city of Amsterdam, 1885.

artworks.title: Portrait of Arnoldus van Rijneveld
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 91.5 cm x width 72 cm
artworks.description: The painter Louis Tocqué was accepted into the French Académie Royale in 1734. His work was highly sought after at that time. He was much admired for his ability to evoke an informal atmosphere, while nevertheless meticulously rendering his sitter’s sumptuous clothing and accessories. Arnoldus van Rijneveld’s fashionable outfit, undoubtedly from Paris, is made of velvet embroidered with gold thread.

artworks.title: A Hermitin Prayer

artworks.description: Een kluizenaar in gebed. Oude man met gevouwen handen geknield voor een kruisbeeld en een boek, in de handen een rozenkrans.

artworks.title: A Nymph Dancing to a Shepherd's Flute

artworks.dimensions: height 44 cm x width 33 cm
artworks.description: Een nymf dansend op het fluitspel van een herder. Pastoraal landschap met een naakte jonge vrouw die danst op de muziek van een zittende naakte jonge man die op een fluit speelt. Links een Terminusbeeld en een jongetje tussen de struiken.

artworks.title: Benares
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 137 cm x width 117 cm × depth 7.8 cm
artworks.description: In this painting, Bauer portrays life in Benares, one of the world’s oldest cities located on the Ganges River, in an idyllic setting. Bauer’s six- month trip through  India in 1897 afforded him inspiration for the rest of his life. There is no room for suffering and povertyin his works of art.  Instead, he focuses on the beauty of the sunlit city with a bathing woman and child, and rowers pushing off a sloop.

artworks.title: Agatha Petronella Hartsen (1814-78). In bruidstoilet ter gelegenheid van haar huwelijk met Jan van der Hoop op 17 maart 1841
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 107.5 cm x width 89 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Agatha Petronella Hartsen (1814-78). In bruidskleding ter gelegenheid van haar huwelijk met Jan van der Hoop op 17 maart 1841. Ten halven lijve, zittende op een balkon met uitzicht over een landschap. In de rechterhand een parasol, in de linkerhand een lorgon met gouden ketting. Rechts op de balustrade een tuinvaas met bloemen.

artworks.title: Portrait of Constantijn Huygens
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 100.2 cm x width 84.5 cm
artworks.description: Constantijn Huygens was secretary to Stadtholder Frederick Henry and a notable connoisseur. In his autobiography, he described how this painting was executed. Lievens painted the portrait in two stages, first the clothing and the hands, and then the face. This explains why the scale is a bit off: the head is too small in relation to the body.

artworks.title: The Church of St Severin in Cologne in an Imaginary Setting
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.5 cm × height 49 cm x width 65 cm
artworks.description: De stadsgezichten van Jan van der Heyden waren niet altijd helemaal natuurgetrouw. Op dit schilderij lijkt hij gebouwen uit verschillende steden te hebben gecombineerd. Zo is de kerk vermoedelijk de Sankt Severin in Keulen en lijkt de dubbele poort op de Waterpoort van Emmerich. De driehoekige dam met de twee torentjes (rechts) bevond zich in werkelijkheid in de verdedigingsgracht rond Amsterdam.

artworks.title: View of Tivoli
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 49.5 cm x width 68 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op Tivoli. Italiaans landschap met beneden de rivier en boven de ronde tempel en het dorp.

artworks.title: The Disbanding of the ‘Waardgelders’ by Prince Maurits
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 98.5 cm x width 171.2 cm × outer size: depth 8.5 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Attired in black, Prince Maurits watches as (mercenary) soldiers – so-called ‘waardgelders’ hired by the towns – here cast off their armour into a sizeable heap. Army commander Maurits put an end to the practice of hiring mercenaries in 1618. By disbanding them, he further consolidated his control over the municipal governments, quashing their ability to defend themselves

artworks.title: View of Arnhem
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 5.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 26 cm x width 41.5 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht over glooiende korenvelden met korenschoven op de stad Arnhem, rechts de Rijn.

artworks.title: Fish Market
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × height 67.8 cm x width 90.1 cm x thickness 4 cm
artworks.description: In this painting, a woman is busy cleaning fish at her market stall. It was very common for many middleclass women to earn their living by selling goods and food. They even made up the majority in the fish trade. Their jobs varied from selling and delivering fish to supplying fish baskets.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Herdsman, Cattle and Poultry
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outersize: depth 4.8 cm (support incl. SK-L-3895) × support: height 46.5 cm x width 58.8 cm
artworks.description: Landschap met dieren. Rond een plas op de voorgrond bevinden zich verschillende soorten eenden, een haan en een kip en twee kikkers. Daarachter een fluitspelende herder met zijn hond en een kudde koeien, schapen en geiten.

artworks.title: At the Theatre
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 37.5 cm x width 32 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Going to the theatre is about seeing and being seen. Here we look through the eyes of the artist at the spirited profile of a fashionably attired young woman. From a pastel of the same subject we know that she is in the Carré Circus Theatre on the Amstel River, which opened in December 1887. Is the young woman simply mesmerized by what she sees on the stage, or is she aware of the painter’s presence after all?

artworks.title: The Battle of the Boyne, Ireland, between Kings James II and William III, 12 July 1690
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.5 cm × height 110 cm x width 169 cm
artworks.description: Battle of the Boyne between James II and William III, 11 June 1690 by Johan van Huchtenburg When the English king James II fathered a Catholic heir, leading Protestants turned in desperation to Prince William III for aid. The Dutch Protestant stadholder was James's son-in-law. Fearing an alliance between the Catholic French and English monarchs William's response was positive. In 1688 he gathered an army and crossed over to England. Deposed, James II continued the fight with French aid in Ireland, only to be defeated in 1690 at the Battle of the Boyne. Left: the hard-fought bridge over the Boyne in Drogheda. Perhaps the horseman in the centre (on the white horse) is William III.

artworks.title: Vow of the Pheasant (Philip the Good and Isabella at the Feast of the Pheasant in Lille in 1454)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.3 cm × height 39.5 cm x width 85.6 cm x thickness 3.8 cm
artworks.description: 'Le voeu du faisan', het banket of feest van de Fazant. Filips de Goede en Isabella van Bourbon aanwezig op een banket gegeven op 17 februari 1454 door Madame d'Estampes in het kasteel de Rihour te Rijsel ter gelegenheid van hun plechtige eedsaflegging om een kruistocht te maken om het Heilige Land te heroveren. Rechts een gedekte tafel, op de achtergrond twee muzikanten. De genodigden dragen brandende toortsen. Late kopie naar een onbekend origineel

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 114 cm x width 82 cm × depth 15 cm
artworks.description: The woman’s identity is unknown, but her velvet gown and jewellery bespeak her wealth. The long neck and slender fingers are typical features of Italian portraiture from this period. In the 16th century, portraits of this size were usually rectangular. The painting was probably cut into an oval shape in the 17th or 18th century.

artworks.title: Portrait of Maria Rey
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 118 cm x width 96.5 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: Maria Rey and Roelof Meulenaer married in 1649. This may have been the reason for having both of their portraits painted. Maria and Roelof’s black clothing might look sober, but in fact it is made of silk and was thus very expensive. Also costly are Maria’s pearls, rings, and bracelets. The fan in her right hand is equally exclusive, a true status symbol.

artworks.title: Landscape in Drenthe
artworks.artist: Julius Jacobus van de Sande Bakhuyzen
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 24 kg × height 55 cm x width 95.5 cm × depth 16 cm
artworks.description: Europe changed quickly after 1850: technical progress accelerated, cities grew, nature was restricted. The grand and mighty imagined landscape went out of fashion and artists preferred to paint ‘real’ nature. That is why the light in this painting is more realistic than in the works  in the other display cases. The landscape is in shadow, the light just touches the tops of the trees and hardly reaches the ground.

artworks.title: St Jerome and St Catherine of Alexandria, Bruges or Brussels, c. 1480-1490
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), hardwood, biological material, oil paint (paint), panel, oak (wood)
artworks.dimensions: height 84.5 cm x width 61 cm
artworks.description: Jerome and Catherine sit on a grass-covered bench before some rose bushes. The two saints can be identified by their attributes: Jerome with the lion, and Catherine with the sword and the broken wheel. Catherine was the daughter of a king and served as a role model for wealthy courtly ladies. The costly heartshaped book she holds probably contains profane love songs. Are we looking at a portrait?

artworks.title: Portrait of David van Mollen and Son-in-Law Jacob Sydervelt with his Family
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 63.5 cm x width 79 cm
artworks.description: David van Mollem (left) is seated in the garden of his country house Zijdebalen on the River Vecht. He was portrayed by Nicolaas Verkolje, who also designed his garden. Van Mollem was a silk merchant and a major shareholder of the Utrechtsche Compagnie. This Company bought the Suriname Utrecht coffee plantation in 1736 and thus became the ‘owner’ of 37 men, 20 women and 2 children, who  were forced to work on the plantation unpaid.

artworks.title: A Saint Bernard Dog Comes to the Aid of a lost Woman with a sick Child

Rechts knielt de vrouw tegen een rotswand met het kind liggend op haar schoot; de jongen heeft een rozenkrans in de hand. Links zit een hond met om de nek een kruik (gemerkt St. Bern.) en een bel.

artworks.title: Abstract-futurist Composition
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 56.5 cm x width 66.5 cm
artworks.description: In 1912-1913 paintings by Italian Futurists were exhibited in various Dutch cities. Their picturing of movement with ‘lines of force,’ as they called them, was unprecedented. While Futurism became a hype in the newspapers, it found less resonance among Dutch artists. An  exception was the Gouda ceramist and painter Chris Lanooy. His dynamic composition of rays and circles evokes the image of an explosion, or a car racing by.

Boven de engel in de wolken twee putti en een licht uitstralende duif. Vervaardigd als altaarstuk voor de kapel in het Maagdenhuis op het Spui te Amsterdam.

artworks.title: View of a Village along a River

artworks.description: The workshop of Jan Brueghel I must have been a  successful, well-run business. In addition to large paintings made on commission, it  roduced an endless stream of landscapes for the free market. These small paintings were variations on a limited range of models. This landscape is a well preserved, finely executed – and probably autograph – example.

artworks.title: Portrait of Carolina Frederica Kerst

artworks.description: The couple Louis Royer and Carolina Kerst were captured in a portrait after their return from a yearlong sojourn in Rome. Louis is seen in his sculptor’s studio surrounded by his work, some of which is on view in this gallery. One of his sculptures is visible in Carolina’s likeness. A letter and an Italian landscape allude to their Italian trip and the cross around her neck signifies her Catholic faith.

artworks.title: The schoolmaster

artworks.description: Een schoolmeester in zijn klaslokaal kijkt het schrift van een leerling na. Links en rechts schrijvende en lezende kinderen.

artworks.title: Building Site in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: paper, paint (coating), textile materials, pasteboard, canvas, cardboard, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 3.8 cm × height 52 cm x width 71 cm
artworks.description: Excavation work in Amsterdam, by R.N. Roland Holst, 1891. Roland Holst (1868 - 1938) was fascinated by the massive new construction projects that were appearing in Amsterdam at the end of the nineteenth century. The thriving building industry reflected Holland's economic growth during this period and gave the city a new aspect. This is probably the Elandsgracht canal in Amsterdam's Jordaan district being filled in. Roland Holst married the poet Henriëtte van der Schalk in 1896. In 1897 they both joined the Social Democratic Party (SDAP) which had been formed in 1894.

artworks.title: St Jerome in his study
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × support: height 80.5 cm x width 109 cm
artworks.description: De heilige Hieronymus in zijn studeervertrek, wijzend met zijn linkerhand naar een schedel. Op zijn werktafel liggen verder een openstaande boek waarin een miniatuur van het Laatste Oordeel, boeken en paperassen, een bril of loep in een houder, pen en inkt, een kruisbeeld en een kaars. Aan de muur hangt zijn kardinaalshoed. Herhaling naar het origineel uit 1541 in het Prado te Madrid.

artworks.title: The Doctor’s Visit
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8 cm × height 40 cm x width 49.5 cm
artworks.description:
While a doctor takes the young woman’s pulse under her mother’s watchful eye, the playing boy gives away the true nature of her ailment. It is lovesickness, caused by Cupid, god of love, who shoots arrows into people’s hearts. Elisabeth Geertruida Wassenbergh
from Groningen garnered much admiration for her meticulously painted daily life scenes. In this, she chose her own path, because her teacher – her father – specialized in portraits and interior scenes.

artworks.title: Autumn
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: height 22.8 cm x width 45.1 cm x depth 3.2 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 14.6 cm x width 37.2 cm
artworks.description: Herfst. Langs een weg aan de oever van een water spreekt een heer met bediende met een jonge vrouw. Op  het water enkele vissersboten. Op de weg pist een jongen tegen het wiel van een boerenwagen, links een oude vrouw die fruit verkoopt. Onderdeel van een reeks met de vier jaargetijden, SK-A-1771/1774.

artworks.title: Portrait of Jonkvrouwe Maria Francisca Louisa Dommer van Poldersveldt
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: height 47.5 cm x width 36.1 cm
artworks.description: The Belgian painter Fernand Khnopff portrayed his aunt here. Seated in a slightly twisted pose, she looks dreamily away, her right hand gently touching the piano keys. Khnopff applied several layers of varnish to heighten the lustrous sheen of her skin. The piano is no longer being played: the woman is immersed in her thoughts. The artist found inspiration in dreams, music, and poetry.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, biological material, panel
artworks.dimensions: height 70 cm x width 43 cm
artworks.description: De kruisiging, tegen een gouden achtergrond. De kruisberg met soldaten te paard met wapperende vaandels tussen de kruisen. Op de voorgrond Maria, Maria Magdalena, Johannes en anderen.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Painter, perhaps the Artist Himself
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 35.5 cm x width 27 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een schilder, misschien Aert Schouman zelf, in zijn atelier. Een jonge schilder in 'Japonsche rock' en muts rookt een pijp, zittend voor zijn ezel, palet en penselen in de hand. Op de schouw staan gipsbeelden en een schedel, aan de muur hangt een prent op rollen en een schilderij.

artworks.title: Storm on the Meuse River
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5 cm × height 47.3 cm x width 63 cm x thickness 0.8 cm
artworks.description: Vissersschepen op het water van de rivier de Maas bij storm.

artworks.title: January, with the Sign of Aquarius
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 334.5 cm x width 34.5 cm
artworks.description: Josephus Augustinus Brentano had the picture gallery in his house on Amsterdam’s Herengracht painted in a classicizing style. Depicted on the ceiling were heroic scenes from the life of Hercules, framed by grotesques and arabesques, ornaments in the form of imaginary plants, and animals derived from Roman antiquity. Adorning the walls were twelve pilasters decorated in the same style and representing the Months of the Year.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit and Flower Garlands
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), wood board, biological material, panel, particle board, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 104.5 cm x width 156 cm × height 97 cm x width 149.5 cm
artworks.description: Deel van negendelige kamerbeschildering voor het huis Beekhoven, later het Hoogerhuis genoemd, bij Randenbroek bij Amersfoort, het buitenhuis van Jacob van Campen.

artworks.title: Interior with Lace-Worker and a Visitor
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5 cm × height 49 cm x width 38 cm
artworks.description: Interieur waarin een man voorovergebogen leest uit een klein boek. Hij leunt aan een tafel waaraan een jonge vrouw bezig was met kantklossen. Zij lacht naar de man en houdt een roemer met wijn in haar hand. Aan het plafond hangt een vogelkooi, tegen de wand een wandkaart aan stokken.

artworks.title: The Drawbridge
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 36 cm x width 44.5 cm × depth 6.3 cm
artworks.description: Summer light bathes a drawbridge and a row of canal houses. This city view may have sprouted from Van der Heyden’s imagination, but it was based on actual sites in Amsterdam. In the right foreground a dog relieves itself on the column of an antiquated building that resembles the old town hall, which burned down in 1652. The two millstones in the centre foreground are objects that were traded near the Amsterdam harbour.

artworks.title: Naval Battle between Dutch Men-of-War and Spanish Galleys
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 5.3 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 39 cm x width 73 cm
artworks.description: Zeeslag tussen Hollandse oorlogsschepen en Spaanse galeien (voor de Vlaamse kust op 3 oktober 1602?).

artworks.title: Interior of the Church of St Bavo in Haarlem
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 52 cm x width 67.5 cm
artworks.description: Interieur van de Sint-Bavokerk te Haarlem. Rechts het kleine orgel achter de preekstoel.

artworks.title: Triptych with the Virgin and Child, and Saints Mary Magdalene and Ansanus
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, tempera
artworks.dimensions: height 91 cm x width 47.5 cm × height 82 cm x width 24.5 cm × height 82.5 cm x width 30.5 cm × height 146 cm x width 119.5 cm x thickness 8 cm
artworks.description: Orcagna was the leading Florentine painter of the mid-14th century. This altarpiece, which has survived almost intact, was commissioned in 1350 by a promi-nent citizen for a side-altar in a church. The depiction of the figures of the Virgin and Child and two saints reflects the rather stiff, hieratical style of the period. The frame is reminiscent of Gothic architecture.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man, perhaps Rembrandt's Father, Harmen Gerritsz van Rijn
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7 cm × height 62.5 cm x width 49 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een man, misschien Rembrandts vader, Harmen Gerritsz van Rijn. Buste van een oude man met een baret met pluim op het hoofd en een halsberg. Kopie naar het origineel in het Getty Museum te Malibu.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Cock Blomhoff Family, their Wetnurse and two Enslaved Servants
artworks.medium: plant material, textile materials, biological material, silk, paint (coating), wood (plant material)
artworks.dimensions: height 95.7 cm x width 173.3 cm x depth 3.3 cm
artworks.description: When the director Jan Cock Blomhoff travelled to Japan in 1817, he did something highly unusual: he took along his family. Western women were not allowed onto Deshima. Titia, her young son and the wetnurse thus had to leave the country a few months later. A Japanese artist portrayed the family. From left to right are: Jan Cock Blomhoff, the wetnurse Petronella Munts, Titia Cock Blomhoff-Bergsma, her son Jan and two enslaved Javanese servants: Maraty and an unknown boy.

artworks.title: Old Woman Spinning
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 63 cm x width 55 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Van Rembrandt kennen we geen schilderijen met huiselijke taferelen. Zijn leerling Nicolaes Maes schilderde daarentegen veel deugdzame vrouwen die bezig zijn in huis. Hier spint een oude vrouw wol. Zij heeft zich teruggetrokken in de hoek van een kamer, waar het laatste restje daglicht valt. Deze wijze van belichten nam Maes over van zijn leermeester.

artworks.title: Portrait of Lucas de Clercq
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 121.6 cm x width 91.5 cm
artworks.description: Lucas de Clercq and Feyntje van Steenkiste were Mennonites, a movement within Protestantism known for its sober character. This explains why they had their likenesses painted in such a plain manner. De Clercq’s pose, however, is anything but modest. With his arm akimbo, he exudes self-assurance. This quality is further emphasized by his right arm, which is not in a sling, but stylishly swathed in costly fabric.

artworks.title: Supper at Emmaus
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 134 cm x width 104 cm × depth 8.5 cm
artworks.description: On their way to Emmaus, two Disciples unexpectedly encounter Christ. At first they do not recognise him. As they sit to eat and they break bread, they realise who he is. And at that moment, he disappears. That is the moment Jan Steen depicts here: Christ’s shade is just visible on the left beneath the arbour.

artworks.title: Crucifixion
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 123.6 cm x width 107.7 cm x thickness 3 cm × depth 8.7 cm
artworks.description: Kruisiging. Christus aan het kruis, links Maria die in zwijm valt, Johannes, Maria Magdalena en de heilige vrouwen, rechts Pilatus en soldaten. Onderdeel van een groot altaarstuk uit het voormalige Augustinerchorherrenstift Rottenbuch. Drie van de andere panelen bevinden zich in de collectie van de Bayerische Staatsgemäldesammlungen te München (tentoongesteld in de Staatsgalerie Burghausen im Palas der Burg). Een ander paneel bevindt zich in het Musée Grobet-Labadié in Marseille, en wederom vier andere in privébezit.

artworks.title: Four Women making Music
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.2 cm × height 57 cm x width 101.5 cm
artworks.description: Luca Giordano (1634 - 1735). Four women making music, c. 1690. Purchased by King Willem I, 1821. On loan from the Mauritshuis, The Hague, 1948.

artworks.title: Prince Maurits Astride the White Warhorse Presented to him after his Victory at Nieuwpoort
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 4.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 37.3 cm x width 33.2 cm
artworks.description: Prins Maurits in wapenrusting gezeten op de witte strijdhengst hem geschonken na de overwinning in de Slag bij Nieuwpoort. Op de achtergrond het optrekken van de legers.

artworks.title: A Packet-Boat Sailing before the Wind

artworks.dimensions: outersize: depth 6 cm (support incl. SK-L-5957) × support: height 38.5 cm x width 60 cm
artworks.description: Een wijdschip zeilend voor de wind op een binnenwater. In de verte nog enkele kleine vaartuigen.

artworks.title: View of Dordrecht seen from Papendrecht
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 77 cm x width 102 cm × depth 11 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op Dordrecht over het water vanaf Papendrecht. Rechts enige vissersschepen.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Death of William V, Prince of Orange, 1806
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.6 cm × height 52.5 cm x width 41.2 cm x thickness 1.2 cm
artworks.description: Allegorie op de dood van Willem V, prins van Oranje, 1806. De Nederlandse Maagd staat treurend bij het graf van de prins. Zij wordt getroost door een engel. Op het graf staat een portretbuste, twee putti dragen het wapenschild. Rechts onder de Nederlandse Leeuw, slapend op gebroken wapens.

artworks.title: Enjoying the Ice
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 61 cm x width 83.5 cm × depth 8.5 cm
artworks.description: IJsvermaak. Wintergezicht op het ijs bij een dorp. Links bij een grote tent staat een groep mensen, voor de tent een slede getrokken door een paard. Op het ijs schaatsers en sleden. Rechts in de verte de molens van een dorp.

artworks.title: The Hermit
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 16 cm x width 14 cm × depth 5.3 cm
artworks.description: Een kluizenaar met gevouwen handen geknield in een rotsachtige omgeving voor een kruisbeeld, schedel, boeken en een papier met Hebreeuws schrift.

artworks.title: A Sperm Whale Washed up on the Beach at Noordwijk, 28 December 1614
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 7.5 cm × height 53 cm x width 85 cm
artworks.description: Een aangespoelde potvis op het strand bij Noordwijk, 28 december 1614. Op het strand zijn veel nieuwsgierigen gekomen om de walvis te zien. In het water en op het strand liggen meerdere vissersboten, linksvoor staat een groep personen rond een aantal vaten en manden met vis.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Brak Family, Amsterdam Mennonites
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 67.5 cm x width 84 cm
artworks.description: Familieportret van de Amsterdamse doopsgezinde familie Brak in een interieur zittend rond een tafel voor een schoorsteenmantel. Van links naar rechts: dominee Jan Brak (1717-61), zijn broer Pieter Brak (ca. 1714-na 1778), zijn vader Harmen Brak (overl. 1768), zijn schoonzuster Margaretha Hasselaar (1726-80/83) met haar echtgenoot Cornelis Brak (1724-82). Staande op de voorgrond is hun oudste dochter met een pop, Margaretha (geb. 1752) zit op haar moeders schoot. Links een doorkijk naar de bibliotheek.

artworks.title: Water Terrace with Statues and Fountains in a Park
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.5 cm × height 130 cm x width 160 cm
artworks.description: In this idealized, symmetrical garden, your eye is led past a pond with sphinx-shaped spouts and majestic triumphal arches to a fountain with the sea god Neptune seated in his chariot pulled by four horses. The painter De Moucheron created this work for Amsterdam’s Hortus Botanicus. The plants in the foreground near the balustrade are from South Africa and the Canary Islands and could be found as well in the botanical garden.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.artist: copy after Michiel Jansz van Mierevelt
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 7 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 71.5 cm x width 60.7 cm x thickness 1.7 cm
artworks.description: Portret van een onbekende oudere man. Buste naar rechts. Om de schouders een met bont gevoerde mantel.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fish

artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 8.5 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 74 cm x width 87 cm
artworks.description: Stilleven met vis. In een mand dat op een tafel staat liggen verschillende soorten vis, waaronder schelvis, platvissen en een moot zalm. Daarnaast mosselen, een mes, een houten vat en een bruine aardewerken kan.

artworks.dimensions: height 24.5 cm x width 32.5 cm
artworks.description: Amsterdams stadsgezicht. Schets van een man staande bij een paard, waarschijnlijk een paardentram op de Dam.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with a Ruin
artworks.artist: Joris van der Haagen (mentioned on object)
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: weight 54 kg × support: height 174 cm x width 232 cm × outer size: depth 13 cm (support incl. frame)
artworks.description: Bergachtig landschap, wellicht de St Pietersberg met het kasteel Lichtenberg bij Maastricht. Op de voorgrond een gevelde boom, daarachter een rustende geitenherder. Over een landweg gaan een man en een vrouw gezeten op en ezel.

artworks.title: Man and Woman at the Breakfast Table
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), textile materials, biological material, canvas, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 35.5 cm x width 29 cm
artworks.description: On the table is a plate with a ham, cheese, and bread. For the average family, this was a typical breakfast, sometimes supplemented by fish. The woman is about to pour some beer into her flute glass. In those days, people hardly drank any water, however beer was quite popular and drunk all day long. Women dominated the trades of breadmaking and beer brewing.

artworks.title: Triptych: Allegory of Art Training
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: height 80 cm x width 36 cm × depth 8 cm
artworks.description: Drieluik met een allegorie op het kunstonderwijs. Op het middenpaneel een kraamkamer; een vrouw geeft een kind de borst. Zij is gezeten aan een tafel, de wieg en een mand voor haar op de vloer. Van het plafond hangt een kroonluchter, aan de muur de opgezette kop van een hert. Op de achtergrond een tandarts. De kraamkamer symboliseert de natuur. Het linker zijpaneel toont een avondschool waar bij het licht van kaarsen en een lantaarn schrijven wordt geleerd. De school symboliseert het onderwijs. Op het rechter zijpaneel snijdt een geleerde in zijn werkkamer een pen bij het licht van de kaars. De pennensnijder symboliseert oefening. (voor het middenstuk en rechter zijpaneel zie SK-A-2320-A/C)

artworks.title: Circe Punishes Glaucus by Turning Scylla into a Monster
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 3.8 cm × height 64 cm x width 53.3 cm
artworks.description: The unsightly, but good-natured sea god Glaucus was in love with Scylla, but this was unrequited. To win her over, he sought the help of the sorceress Circe. This was a mistake, for Circe was herself in love with him. In a fit of rage, she changed poor Scylla into a monster. Van der Neer set the story from Ovid’s Metamorphoses in sinister surroundings. Gesturing theatrically, the sorceress performs her vengeful deed.

artworks.title: Louis Jacques Veltman (1817-1907).  Actor
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 10.5 cm × height 81.7 cm x width 61.4 cm x thickness 3.3 cm
artworks.description: Portret van Louis Jacques Veltman, toneelspeler. Buste, naar links.

artworks.description: Portret van Dieuwke Fontein, sinds 1834 de tweede echtgenote van Adriaan van der Hoop. Kniestuk, zittend in een stoel, een waaier in de rechterhand, handschoen in de linker. Pendant van SK-C-169.

artworks.title: The Foot Operation
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: depth 6.5 cm (support incl. SK-L-2360) × support: height 29.6 cm x width 41 cm
artworks.description: De voetoperatie. In een interieur bekijkt een chirurgijn de voet van een oude man. Rechts staan op de vloer een metalen kan en scheerbord. Links laat een man een kei uit zijn hoofd snijden, naast hem zit een vrouw. Links op de voorgrond een boek waarop een schedel ligt. Op de achtergrond een kast met een heiligenbeeld.

artworks.title: The Alchemist
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: support: height 43.6 cm x width 38 cm × outer size: depth 10.8 cm (support incl. SK-L-4108)
artworks.description: Een alchemist zittend schrijvend aan een lessenaar in zijn werkplaats. Voor hem staat een jongen met een grote kom. Op de werktafel en op de grond staan stapels boeken en paperassen, potten, ketels, een vijzel en een globe. Van het plafond hangt een opgezette krokodil. Op de achtergrond zit een vrouw met een kind naast een fornuis.

artworks.title: Fish Market
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 47.5 cm x width 65 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op een vismarkt. Links een zittende visverkoopster met manden met vis, ook op de grond liggen verschillende soorten vis. Links een overdekte stal waar twee personen vis schoonmaken. Rechts verkoopt een oude visser mosselen vanuit een kruiwagen. Uiterst links staat een ooievaar.

artworks.title: Stadsgezicht

artworks.dimensions: height 51 cm x width 42 cm × depth 11 cm
artworks.description: Stadsgezicht. Gezicht op een grachtje achter huizen in een stad. Een vrouw staande op de kade maakt een praatje met een man in een boot.

artworks.title: Worshipping the Christ Child
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, tempera
artworks.dimensions: depth 10.1 cm × diameter 88 cm x thickness 3.3 cm
artworks.description: De aanbidding van het kind. Maria knielt in aanbidding bij het Christuskind dat op de grond ligt. Links zit de slapende Jozef, rechts staat Johannes de Doper als kind.

artworks.title: Gezicht op de Ooijpolder, gezien vanaf de Belvédère te Nijmegen
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: height 49.5 cm x width 64.5 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: Gezicht op de Ooijpolder, gezien vanaf de Belvédère te Nijmegen. Links Het Meertje, rechts een heuvelrug en een boerenhoeve. Op het erf van de hoeve en langs de oever veel figuren met hun dagelijkse bezigheden.

artworks.title: Arcadian Landscape with Setting Sun
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, oil paint (paint), canvas
artworks.dimensions: depth 5.9 cm × height 54 cm x width 70 cm
artworks.description: This painting is a pendant to the adjacent work, View of Civita Castellana. As the setting sun colours the sky pink and purple, two people in classical robes gaze at an ancient temple. Dupré painted a tableau suffused with the impressions he had gained during his study trip in Italy: the southern landscape, the golden light and the remains of classical antiquity.

artworks.title: Venus and Mars

artworks.dimensions: height 29 cm x width 38 cm × depth 6 cm
artworks.description: Venus en Mars gezeten op een rustbed, Mars wordt door Cupido ontwapend. Links twee dienstmaagden, één met een bord met etenswaren, de ander houdt het gordijn op. Linksonder een kind met een glas wijn, op de achtergrond ruïnes en de smidse van Vulcanus.

artworks.description: Maria met het kind aan de borst, ten halven lijve voor een draperie van goudbrokaat.

artworks.title: Woman at the Hearth

Now it is thought to be by a pupil in Rembrandt’s Leiden workshop.

artworks.description: Paulus Potter (1625 - 1654). Herdsmen with their cattle, 1651 Paulus Potter, whose specialty was animals, portrayed cows, goats and sheep in precise and accurate detail. Here he has placed them against a hilly background. This was unusual for Potter, who generally painted flat Dutch landscapes. The hill on the left has a special function within the composition. Together with the tree on the right, it creates the effect of stage wings, adding depth to the composition. Purchased in 1808, from the collection of G. van der Pot van Groeneveld (Rotterdam).

artworks.title: Portrait of Roelof Meulenaer
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 118 cm x width 96.5 cm × depth 7 cm
artworks.description: Roelof Meulenaer, an Amsterdam postmaster, commissioned portraits of himself and his wife from Rembrandt’s pupil Ferdinand Bol around 1650. At this time, Bol was developing his own, more elegant style based on the work of the Flemish artist Anthony van Dyck, while continuing to avail himself of Rembrandt’s warm palette. Meulenaer’s portrait, thus, unites the best of these two exemplary models.

artworks.description: The widow Maria Everdina Bolten commissioned these and two more wall-size landscapes to adorn the garden room of her house on Amsterdam’s Nieuwe Doelenstraat. The viewer is transported from the heart of a bustling city to an oasis far beyond it. It is as if one gazes through a window at the river flowing under an opened drawbridge with a bustling farm, inn, and a country house along the banks.

artworks.title: Cornelis de Witt (1623-1672), Burgomaster of Dordrecht and Lord Lieutenant of Putten
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 6 cm × height 124 cm x width 97 cm

Cornelis was representative of the States General in the field. This meant being present at military engagements on behalf of the government. In 1667, for example, he took part in the raid on Chatham in England. In the background is the English man-of-war, the Royal Charles, which was captured during the raid. Cornelis, who was known for his vanity, is wearing his robe of office.

The architectural style of the cylindrical building in the distance situates the scene in Italy. Such southern pastoral and peasant idylls were Du Jardin’s speciality.

artworks.title: Stadtholder Prince Maurice Lying in State

artworks.description: Prince Maurice died on 23 April 1625 at the age of 57. Rumour had it that he was poisoned. However, an autopsy proved that his death was due to an abscess on his liver. Shortly afterwards, he was embalmed and laid in state, dressed in a fur-lined tabard, as seen in this small portrait. The burial took place in Delft on 20 September

In de rechterhand een tekenpen, in de linkerhand een blad papier met een tekening (een portret van Abraham Bloemaert). Op de tafel een anatomisch model, een gipsen kop en een medaillon aan een ketting. Voorheen beschouwd als een zelfportret van Gerard van Honthorst. Pendant van SK-A-1480.

artworks.title: Harbour at Sunrise
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 74 cm x width 98.3 cm × height 106 cm x width 130 cm x thickness 11 cm
artworks.description:
An imaginary harbour, at the first light of dawn. On the right, a Roman triumphal arch catches the early rays of the sun. Claude Lorrain – a Frenchman who worked in Rome – was a master at capturing the atmosphere of each particular time of day. His poetic, Italianate landscapes
influenced many of his contemporaries, including the Dutch Italianates.

artworks.title: Coastal Mountains
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 46 cm x width 62 cm × depth 9 cm
artworks.description: Monticelli painted Le Promontoire here, Cap Canaille near Cassis on the French coast southeast of Marseille. The painter came from Marseille and so knew this region like the back of his hand. This light, impressionistic landscape is exceptional within his body of work. He specialized in dreamlike scenes with figures in a garden or forest, painted in dark and glowing colours. Monticelli’s work was very popular among European collectors.

artworks.title: Officers and Other Civic Guardsmen of the IVth District of Amsterdam, under the Command of Captain Jan Claesz van Vlooswijck and Lieutenant Gerrit Hudde

De kapitein en de luitenant zijn gezeten, om hen heen staan de schutters, in het midden de vaandrig. Vermoedelijk bevinden zij zich voor de brouwerij 'De Zwaan'. De schutters zijn: Jan Witsen, Hillebrant Bentes, Andries Dircksen van Saane, Jan Bentes, Willem Simonsz Moons, Jan Huybertsen Codde, Roelof Roelofsen de Lange, IJsbrant van de Wouwer, Johannes Looten, Ulrich Petersen, Jacob Bleyenberch, Pieter Harpertsen, Pieter Tonneman, Evert Huibertsen Krieck, Hendrik Jansen van As en Nicolaes Kuysten. De schutters zijn bewapend met pieken, hellebaarden, lansen en geweren.

artworks.title: Portrait of Antoine Perrenot, Cardinal de Granvelle, Minister to Charles V and Philip II
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 4.6 cm × height 47.8 cm x width 35.7 cm
artworks.description:
Kardinaal Antoon Perrenot de Granvelle, 1517-1586, raadsheer van landvoogdes Margaretha van Parma, 1559-1564. Vermoedelijk oude copie naar een verloren origineel door Willem Key. Gedateerd 1565.
Granvelle werd in 1538 benoemd tot Bisschop van Atrecht; in 1550 nam hij de diplomatieke functies in dienst van het Habsburgse hof over van zijn vader. Hij was de voornaamste adviseur van de landvoogdes, sinds 1561 als kardinaal-aartsbisschop van Mechelen bovendien de invloedrijkste kerkelijke autoriteit.

artworks.title: Gerard van Honthorst Showing Amalia of Solms the Drawings of his Pupil Louise of Bohemia
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 48 cm x width 39.5 cm × depth 9.1 cm
artworks.description: Amalia of Solms and Louise of Bohemia were very active in the 17th-century art world. Louise was taught by the then famous painter Gerard van Honthorst and mainly painted portraits. Amalia was the most important female patron in the 17th century. As the wife of Prince Frederick Henry of Orange, she had several palaces built and decorated by prominent artists such as Van Honthorst. Here we see her admiring the work of Louise of Bohemia

artworks.title: Trading posts of the Dutch East India Company (VOC)

artworks.title: The adoration of the shepherds
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 53 cm x width 64 cm
artworks.description: Jan Steen (1626 - 1679). The Adoration of the shepherds, c. 1660.Tenderly Mary shows the newborn baby Jesus to the shepherds. They have come to the stable in great numbers, bearing all sorts of gifts. They gaze in reverence at the radiant child in the manger. The stable, in which an ox and a donkey occupy a prominent place, is shrouded in darkness. But outside, the dawn is nigh, a reference to the era heralded by the birth of Jesus. Jan Steen has transformed this biblical tale into an eminently human event. There is the same warmth and humour as in the scenes of everyday life: Joseph accepts a bowl of eggs, while on the left a child is warming up some porridge. From the collection of H. Witsen (Amsterdam), the Lord of Tabley, and others. Purchased in 1947.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, tempera
artworks.dimensions: height 40 cm x width 41 cm
artworks.description:
The style of the Master of Badia a Isola is closely related to that of Duccio, the founder of the Sienese school of painting. This Virgin is a variation on a prototype by Duccio. Although the bottom of the panel has been cut off, it is still an excellent example of the refined linear
style that Duccio passed on to his followers in Siena.

artworks.title: Friedrich Christian, Prince-Elector of Saxony, Prince of Poland

artworks.dimensions: depth 8 cm × height 144 cm x width 113 cm
artworks.description: The court painter Gottfried Boy portrayed Friedrich Christian of Saxony in full regalia. The likeness conceals the fact that he had a physical disability and used a wheelchair. Against the wishes of his mother, who wanted one of his younger brothers to ascend the throne, he became Elector of Saxony in 1763. He began instituting major administrative reforms, but died of smallpox after a reign of only 74 days.

artworks.title: The Heath near Wolfheze
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 102.5 cm x width 152.5 cm × depth 13 cm × weight 29 kg
artworks.description:
Bilders was the leading figure in the artists’ colony of Oosterbeek, in the province of Gelderland. While he initially painted landscapes in the Romantic style, his execution became increasingly looser, his brushstrokes broader and his palette more monotone like that of the Hague School. The traditional composition of this painting features a towering stand of trees at the right and a distant view at the left. In spite of this 
division into two parts, the moderate transitions of colour and the overall grey tonality ensure a harmonious whole.

artworks.title: Portrait of Abraham de Potter, Amsterdam Silk Merchant
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)

artworks.description: At first sight, this portrait appears fairly conventional. The sitter is dressed in sober black, and the stiff pleated ruff was no longer particularly fashionable in 1649. However, the background is unusual: Potter stands before a weathered plastered wall. Above his signature, Fabritius painted a small, deceptively real nail, which seems to stick out of the canvas.

artworks.title: Joan Ketelaar’s Embassy to the King of Udaipur

artworks.dimensions: length 150.5 cm x width 273.5 cm
artworks.description: In 1711 the VOC sent a delegation to India’s most important ruler, the Mughal emperor. Joan Josua Ketelaar, an expert in the Hindustani and the Persian language, was in charge. En route the mission passed through the city of Udaipur and was received by the local ruler. Here Ketelaar and the Indian king sit in a pavilion. For decades to come, Indian painters in Udaipur continued to paint the exotic Dutchmen based on this visit.

artworks.title: Portrait of Ottavio Strada

artworks.dimensions: height 128 cm x width 101 cm
artworks.description: Seventeen-year-old Ottavio Strada is portrayed in an unusual – allegorical – manner. He receives a cornucopia filled with ancient coins from Fortune, while turning away from a statue of Venus. The gold and silver signify not only his future riches, but also allude to his study of ancient coins, a pursuit in which he was trained by his father, the antiquary Jacopo Strada.

artworks.description: Born in Ukraine, Marie Bashkirtseff grew up in Nice and Paris. She studied at the Académie Julian in Paris and subsequently exhibited her work frequently. Concurrent with painting this portrait of her sister-inlaw, she played an active role in the French women’s movement. Bashkirtseff was only 25 when she died of tuberculosis. The intimate diaries she kept since the age of 12 propelled her to fame as a writer as well.

artworks.title: Prince William I nursed by his Wife Charlotte de Bourbon after the Abortive Attempt on his Life by Jean Jaurequi in Antwerp in 1582
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: depth 8.3 cm × height 39.2 cm x width 46.8 cm
artworks.description: William of Orange (1533 - 1584) nursed by his wife Charlotte de Bourbon(1546 - 1582) after a failed assassination attempt, by N. Pieneman, 1840. Jean Jaureguy struck Prince William in the jugular when he attacked him in Antwerp in 1582. According to the story, Charlotte remained by William's bedside for a week and died herself, two months later, of exhaustion. Pieneman emphasized Charlotte's sacrificial role, like the poet cleric J.J.L. ten Kate. In an address commemorating Pieneman in 1861 he pictured her, on the base of this portrait, as 'the representative of that heroic Dutch sense of loyalty, in which Woman in her more confined circle is no less noble than Man in the wider sphere when it comes to rigid determination and selfless love'.

artworks.title: Saint Elizabeth of Hungary Tending the Sick in Marburg, Death of St Elizabeth, inner right wing of an altarpiece made for the Grote Kerk in Dordrecht

artworks.description: Scènes uit het leven van de heilige Elisabeth van Hongarije (1207-31). Links op de achtergrond: Lodewijk vertrouwt voor zijn vertrek naar het Heilige Land Elisabeth toe aan zijn zwager. Links op de voorgrond: Elisabeth, na de dood van Lodewijk in 1227 uit de Wartburg verdreven, ontvangt in het door haar gestichte ziekenhuis te Marburg een gewonde man en verpleegt de zieken. Rechts Elisabeth op haar sterfbed bijgestaan door Meester Koenraad en een biddende non. Twee engelen dragen haar ziel naar de hemel. Boven wordt de heilige door twee Franciscaner monniken begraven. Binnenzijde van het rechterpaneel, maakt deel uit van twee panelen, aan weerszijden beschilderd met voorstellingen uit het leven van de heilige Elisabeth van Hongarije (1207-31) en de Sint Elisabethsvloed 18-19 november 1421 (SK-A-3145/46 en SK-A-3147A/B).

artworks.title: Portrait of Gerard Pietersz Hulft (1621-1656), First Councilor and Director-General of the Dutch East India Company
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: outer size: depth 8 cm (support incl. frame) × support: height 128.7 cm x width 102.2 cm
artworks.description: Gerard Pietersz Hulft by Govert Flinck, 1654. Gerard Hulft (1621-1656) was in command of the VOC fleet that attacked the trading town of Colombo on Ceylon (Sri Lanka) in 1655, driving out the Portuguese. By forming an alliance with the ruler of the kingdom of Kandy in the interior, the Dutch managed to defeat the Portuguese, although Hulft was to die in the final days of the siege of Colombo. Before leaving for Asia, Hulft had this portrait painted. He is surrounded by attributes that befitted a Company official: a 'factuerboeck' for the accounts, legal works by Grotius (Hugo de Groot), treaties with England, plans of fortifications and navigational instruments.

artworks.title: Johannes Wtenbogaert
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 122.5 cm x width 98 cm
artworks.description: During his long life – he died in 1644 at the age of 87 – Wtenbogaert wrote pamphlets, religious treatises, and, of course, numerous sermons. Backer depicted him in 1638 with his 1619 discourse on ‘the Lord’s Prayer’ on the table. This treatise on one of the best-known prayers, published in the year in which the Remonstrants were under pressure, is a public manifestation of his profound faith.

artworks.description: By copying a classical bust, a woman is refining her drawing skills. The room’s decor is inspired by classical antiquity and the woman’s attire, too, is reminiscent of a Greek or Roman robe. Accompanying this painting is The Music Lesson, also shown here. Both works highlight the importance placed on art education for affluent women in the 19th century.

artworks.title: The explosion of the powder magazine in Delft, 12 October 1654
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 37 cm x width 62 cm
artworks.description: The Explosion of the Powder Magazine in Delft, 12 October 1654, by Egbert Lievensz. van der Poel, 1654-1660. On Monday 12 October 1654, at eleven-thirty in the morning, 90,000 pounds of gunpowder exploded at the powder magazine in Delft. Among the hundreds who died was Van der Poel's own daughter, Lysbeth. Most of the pictures Van der Poel (1621-1664) painted after that were nocturnal scenes of fire and smoke. The explosion took place in the northwest of the city. In the background, from left to right: the New Church, the town-hall tower and the Old Church.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 65 cm x width 81 cm
artworks.description:
It is not certain whether Berchem ever travelled to Italy, but he excelled in rendering idealized scenes of the Italian countryside. His paintings were in great demand precisely because they included all the popular clichés: mountainous landscapes, warm light, hazy blue distances, bright skies and, of course, herders and
shepherds with their cattle and sheep at watering holes or resting in the cool shade.

artworks.description: This is a typical example of the kind of landscape produced in large numbers in the workshop of Jan Brueghel I. It was probably made by his son Jan Brueghel II. The execution is freer and at the same time harder. Typical of the work of Jan Brueghel II is the way in which details, such as the church tower, are delineated with the tip of the brush.

Young women made their own trousseaux and embellished pillows, clothing, towels and napkins with beautiful embroidered floral motifs. In The First Day at School –on view in this gallery –the girl’s embroidery frame is brought along to school.

De prins staat op een strijdwagen getrokken door vier witte paarden en wordt gekroond door de Vrede. De wagen rijdt door een triomfpoort of ereboog een stad binnen. In de lucht Faam en engelen met een hoorn des overvloeds en het wapen van de prins. Langs de kant de dankbare inwoners en soldaten met vaandels en standaarden.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, oil paint (paint), panel
artworks.dimensions: support: height 64.3 cm x width 54.5 cm
artworks.description: Cardinal Erard de la Marck was one of the most powerful men in the Low Countries. He was the confidant of Charles V and of Margaret of Austria, who was governor of the Netherlands. His portrait and the accompanying painting of The Holy Family deviate from the traditions of the time. The cardinal is not depicted in devout prayer, but gesturing with his hands as though speaking. Even more exceptional is the fact that he, and not the Holy Family, occupy the heraldically most important position on the left side.

artworks.title: Arrival of Charles II, King of England, in Rotterdam, 24 May 1660
artworks.medium: paint (coating), textile materials, canvas, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 124 cm x width 225 cm
artworks.description:
As a prince Charles was forced to live in exile for a long time because in England, his homeland, his father had been beheaded and the monarchy abolished. However, the monarchy was restored in 1660: the parliament in London summoned him to return as King Charles II. On this triumphal journey from Breda to London he stopped off in Rotterdam. We see him on the state yacht in the middle being honoured by
many burghers and cannon salutes.

The viewer is transported from the heart of a bustling city to an oasis far beyond it. It is as if one gazes through a window at the river flowing under an opened drawbridge with a bustling farm, inn, and a country house along the banks.

artworks.title: February with the sign of Pisces
artworks.medium: wood (plant material), plant material, paint (coating), biological material, panel, oil paint (paint)
artworks.dimensions: height 332 cm x width 30.4 cm x depth 3.2 cm
artworks.description:
Zoals het opschrift onderaan vermeldt is het onderwerp van deze schildering de maand februari. Het teken van het sterrenbeeld vissen is afgebeeld op een reliëf met een zwart fond. De boot is mogelijk ontleend aan door Claude III Audran (1658-1734) omstreeks 1709 ontworpen tapijtenserie Le Douze Mois Grotesques, die door Jean Audran (1667-1756) in prent is gebracht. Op de prent met de eerste twee maanden is bij februari een vergelijkbare boot te zien. In plaats van Neptunes, de beschermgod van februari, toont de schildering de zeegod Okeanos. Hij is te herkennen aan zijn lange baard en horens en is zoals gebruikelijk omringd door de slangen en vissen.    
Deze schildering maakt deel uit van een serie pilasterpanelen (sk-a-4142 t/m sk-a-4150), gemaakt in opdracht van Josephus Augustus Brentano (1753-1821) voor zijn huis Herengracht 544.
